name: A lawyer in São Sebastião-SP reported flying on a UFO and interacting with extraterrestrial beings [1956]*
description: * with video below, "radio style". TRANSLATION June 16th, 1956. "In an interview with channel 13 of Rio de Janeiro television, on the night of August 27th, 1957, João de Freitas Guimarães, lawyer and professor at the Catholic Faculty of Law in Santos, São Paulo, reported the strange adventure he had with a flying saucer and its crew members. He was also Interviewed by the Brazilian Society for the Study of Flying Saucers, SBEDV, and confirmed his statements which can be summarized as follows: On June 16, 1956 he went to São Sebastião for work. Finding the forum closed, he stayed at the hotel and after dinner went for a walk on the beach. It was 19:10 or 19:15 when, looking at the sea, he saw a jet of water rise in the stretch between Ilhabela and São Sebastião. He immediately thought of a whale, but it was a bulky device that emerged from the waters and took the direction of the beach, where, when it arrived, it launched a landing gear with balls and, through an opening, two men went out to meet him. They were tall, white, blond hair, clear and serene eyes. They wore a kind of green jumpsuit that narrowed on the neck, the wrists and ankles. At first he was startled when they stopped in front of him but, as they looked so human, he asked them if there had been an accident with their machine or if they were looking for someone. Having no answer, he repeated the question in French, English, Italian, but to no answers. However, although they did not speak, the lawyer had the impression that they were inviting him to enter the device. It seemed to him that the crew were communicating by telepathy. Knowing that the invitation was insistent, Dr. Freitas Guimarães felt an irresistible urge to see the interior of the object. One of the men walked to the ship, turning his back on him. He followed the man reluctantly, and the other one came after him. Inside the flying saucer The individual who led the way reached the bottom of the ship and climbed it easily, holding the ladder with one hand, while he, the lawyer, needed the help of both hands. A third crew member was waiting for them. With the door closed, the object took off. At that moment, even though he was slightly ill, the teacher noticed that there was water on the portholes. - "Is it raining?" he asked. He was told, telepathically, that it was not rain. That water came from the "rotation in the opposite direction of the parts that made up the ship". They explained to him that, around the ship, there was a ray filtration device, which had the property of making the semi-vacuum in any of its parts. He noted that during the entire trip they only remained in one compartment, but noted that there were others, also lit. Through the windows, Dr. Guimarães saw that they passed through an intensely dark area, where the stars shone in an extraordinary way. Successive regions filled with stars sparkled with incomparable brilliance. New dark areas followed. They then passed through a glowing violet layer and on that occasion, he felt that the device was shaking strongly. As he showed fear, he was told that the ship had just left the earth's atmosphere. During the trip, the lawyer asked several times where they came from, but got no answer. He doesn't know why they didn't want to identify themselves. He noticed that there was a circular shaped panel in the compartment, in which three very sensitive needles oscillated. He saw that when they left the earth's atmosphere, those ‘clock-hands' started to vibrate intensely. As explained to him, "the device was driven by the direction resultant of the composition of the magnetic forces in that place". When they returned, he noticed that his watch was stopped, but he calculated the time they were in flight in 30 or 40 minutes. New meeting Still inside the ship, they agreed to meet again on August 12th the following year, 1957, in the same place and at the same time. The date was marked by 12 constellations that were arranged on the Zodiac. A wheel indicated the year and the repetition of 12 times the number eight gave an idea of ​​the month of August. Professor Freitas Guimarães also declared that he did not attend the new meeting because, as the case was widely publicized, a caravan had been organized by curious people to attend the interview, which would certainly cause great turmoil. In addition, the Air Force would send jet fighter planes to the scene. In an interview subsequently granted to the SBEDV researchers - the lawyer declared that, a few days before the date agreed for the meeting, Colonel Av Coqueiro, in the presence of Dr Gabriel Alca, his brother and a clerk at the fifth notary of Santos, had said: - "If I were you, I wouldn't go to that meeting. I will have two jet fighter squadrons there to receive the flying saucer". In this last interview, Dr. Guimarães added that he had heard from people who gave public testimony on TV Tupi in São Paulo that, on the scheduled date, the flying saucer appeared behind Ilha Bela, passed over São Sebastião and went towards Praia da Barraqueçaba. (Extracted from the Special Bulletin, 1975, of the Brazilian Society of Studies on Flying Saucers./Luiz do Rosário real Presidente Pelotas, April 1976 ) ." Watch the video with the "Radio Report" of this case (radio style)

name: The "Duas Pontes Case": UFOs sightings and a fatal abduction in Diamantina-MG [1962]
description: THE "DUAS PONTES" CASE TRANSLATION OF THE REPORT: "In August 1962 , the report of a poor, illiterate and shy boy caused a huge stir in the city of Diamantina, with repercussions throughout the state of Minas Gerais and beyond its limits. Raimundo Aleluia Mafra, 12 years old, motherless, helped her father Rivalino Mafra da Silva with his hunting and mining activities, also taking care of two of his younger brothers. Located in Duas Pontes district of Diamantina, State of Minas Gerais, the Mafra family residence was a completely isolated hovel. For dozens of times, the boy repeated his report to Lieutenant Wilson Lisboa, the city's police chief, the Judge of Law, doctors, journalists and countless people, who, despite refusing Raimundo's version, were impressed by his consistency and quiet conviction. He claimed that Rivalino, his father, had disappeared before his eyes, surrounded by a swirl of yellow dust raised by two small objects, posted at the door of the hovel. And he wept softly, convinced that his father would never return Soon after his father's disappearance, Raimundo looked for traces of himself in the neighborhood and went to call Mr. João Madalena de Miranda, employee of a distant factory. When this friend arrived at the place of the disappearance, a clearing of dirt, he noticed what he seemed to have been carefully swept, in an area whose radius measured 5 meters. The searches, already under the direction of the Diamantina police, began on the same day, and would continue for a long time. The military Police trained dogs arrived from Belo Horizonte, but found no trace of the ‘garimpeiro'/gold miner. The flights of the birds of prey were closely monitored as a possible clue to the location of Rivalino's body. Mr. José Ávila Garcia, the vicar of Diamantina, despite not believing in the boy's version, revealed that in the week prior to the disappearance of Rivalino, an employee of the Post and Telegraph department, Mr. Antônio Rocha, spotted two fireballs flying in circles at great speed and low altitude, exactly over the location of DUAS PONTES, where the ‘garimpeiro' resided. Mr. Antonio Rocha confirmed this communication to the Diário de Minas reporter. After a clinical examination of the boy Raimundo, the doctor Dr. João Antônio de Oliveira revealed that he had discovered nothing unusual, just the state of malnutrition. The boy appeared to be in good mental condition. With the initiative of the juvenile court, Raimundo was taken to Belo Horizonte by Commissioner Antônio Cruz. In this capital, he repeated the story with the same details, including for CICOANI. Before admitting him to "João Pinheiro", an Institute for the protection and instruction of underprivileged minors, the Court provided psychiatric examination and psychological tests. The results did nothing to resolve the issue. Testimony of the young Raimundo Aleluia Mafra to CICOANI, on August 30th, 1962 - summary: Raimundo says that around 8 pm on August 1st of that year, 1962, he met his father Rivalino in a room in his residence, where two of his four younger brothers slept. He and his father were around a small fire that they made on the dirt floor in the bedroom, next to one of the doors leading to the kitchen. His father drew his attention to a dark, undefined shadow, which slid silently across the kitchen, towards another room. This silhouette was described as having four legs, but the boy could inform more, merely stating that it had some resemblance to a crawling man. Recalling the story, the boy described a "tuft" in that shade, meaning some projection, which would have turned towards the room when passing through the door, giving Raimundo and his father the impression of having been observed. Then Mr. Rivalino got up, going to the door where the shadow had shown itself, or a little further, unable to see anything. The boy admited that fear could have prevented his father from conducting a complete search in the rest of the dark house, but he ensures that the internal locks - of the only two doors, one in the kitchen and the other in the living room - were frimly closed. Returning to the room, Mr. Rivalino found himself unable to sleep, as did his son. At one point, they both heard human voices, "thick and coiled" quoting Rivalino's name and saying that ‘they would kill him as soon as he left home'. They also heard a noise similar to an alarm clock coming from the outside of the house. The gold digger and his son went through the night without sleep. At 6 am in the following morning, August 20th, Monday, Raimundo was about to leave the house and prepare his father's horse from the attached tereno. He opened the kitchen door leading to the grounds, and found two small and strange objects lying on the ground, a few meters away. Differing in color, they were identical in shape and size. Both were oval in shape and measured between 40 and 50 centimeters in the largest diameter. The existence of a small appendix at one end of each object, combined with their shape, reminded Raimundo of the armadillo figures. These finger-sized appendages were tubular in shape, according to the boy's description. And, like "little tails", they protruded from the backs of the objects, which were slightly suspended from the ground. At the moment when Raimundo noticed them, that addendum pointed to the door, where he was. Then, when Mr. Rivalino arrived at the door in response to his son's call, the tubes pointed in the opposite direction, indicating that the objects would have overturned. One of the objects was entirely black, matte; the other was streaked in white and black, with stripes equal in width, and drawn across the larger diameter of the object. This description was made patiently with the aid of a "sketch". When Mr. Rivalino noticed the two objects placed side by side, one meter from each other, he marveled by releasing the phrase: "What is this?". He recommended to his son not to go out the door, and still holding the knife and the tobacco with which he prepared his straw cigarette, Mr. Rivalino approached the objects slowly, and his son said that he did not seem to show fear. With the approach of Rivalino, the two objects joined laterally, with a dull sound and began to rotate together, quickly and immediately raising a swirl of "yellow dust", which enveloped Rivalino without reaching his son. The boy had declared that, in addition to the dull noise during the collision of objects, the only noise he heard was the hum of the wind that raised the dust spiral, which prevented Raimundo from seeing both the objects and his father, who did not reappear when the swirl stopped." BELOW - Sketch of the house of Rivalino and Raimundo: Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: In Niterói-RJ, UFO sightings in the same spot where a fatal contact happened [1968]
description: TRANSLATION OF THE REPORT: SEPT 11th, 1968 . An attorney of Rio de Janeiro named João Abud, his wife, an official of Finance of the State of Rio, as well as other people, confirmed the testimony of Professor Hilton Ribeiro, of Colégio Plínio Leitte, and the couple of students Regina Lúsica de Oliveira and José Carlos, who saw a flying saucer on Sunday night at Itaipu beach in Niterói. The teacher and the students were on the beach, contemplating the sea, when they came across a spaceship, totally illuminated and emitting jets of orange light and spinning on its own axis with a translucent top, without touching the ground and only 2 meters from the beach sand. The lovers, frightened already by the series they had been watching on TV - "The Invaders" -, hurriedly left the place. Later they declared that they were afraid of having any dialogue with the visitors, whose silhouettes they could see through the luminous walls of the disc. The Professor declared that the spacecraft was the size of a VW, emitting colored lights, prevailing orange, and that it remained stationary without touching the ground, rotating slowly around its own axis. The Professor was waiting for the moment to contact the occupants of the ship, but the UFO ended up gaining height and disappearing. The student couple said the disc looked like the one described by a lady resident in Icaraí when the two radio technicians who were found dead - with lead masks in their eyes - on top of Morro do Urubú, disappeared when they tried to contact beings from another planet. The men were found dead, with noboby finding out the cause. At the time, the aforementioned Mrs. and several others saw a flash in the sky and the object described as a flying saucer. On September 13th, 1968 , following the example of what happened at the beginning of the week at Itaipu beach, a flying disc over Niterói appeared again. The object was photographed when it hovered over Morro Vintém, the same place where the two radio technicians, found with lead masks in their eyes, mysteriously appeared dead (?). The photographer who surprised the flying saucer was Mr. Ari Pereira, immediately taking the photos to the Rio de Janeiro authorities interested in the subject. The photographer reported that when he arrived at his apartment window to escape the heat in his room, he was surprised by a strange colored light that appeared in the sky. After standing still for a few minutes, he began to move at an impressive speed, traversing space. Due to the strong light it emitted, the photo was obtained with a yellow filter. - Walter Buhrer - Largo do Machado - Rio de Janeiro ". Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: The crew of a cargo plane reported a luminous object between Porto Alegre-RS and Guaratuba-PR [1954]
description: TRANSLATION OF THE REPORT " August 6th, 1954 . The VARIG plane, VBF, taking extra flight, freighter from PA to RJ [Porto Alegre to Rio de Janeiro], with the following crew: Commander Nagib; Co-pilot Ruthildo, Radio-telegraphist Rafael, witnessed what is reported below: We take off from PA at 17:17 hrs (local) with PLN approved 2,100 meters. VD-1 FL 2250 FA ST 2100 VD-3 RJ. After the passage of FL (18:18 hrs local time), I saw a strong light to the left of the aircraft, which soon disappeared, not paying attention to the fact. At the time we passed by Guaratuba-PR, I again saw strong light still to the left of the aircraft, disappearing again. After passing through Paranaguá-PR, what happened at 18:55 hrs (local time) I saw again the same light (apparently yellow) still to the left of the aircraft, approximately 3,000 meters between my aircraft and the VD-3. I caught the attention of the crew and we all observed the following: Variation in speed, height and brightness; the speed and height being very intense. Sometimes it was lower in front of me, sometimes higher in the back, always to the left. We turned off all the onboard lights and communicated with the VBX that was at that time near JV, the object was not seen by the VBX. I transmitted to the VBX all the evolutions of the object consisting of the following: rapid vertical ascent, backward movement maintaining height; after a quick instant, it appeared in front of me lower (since the light was weaker, but constant) the object was not lost sight of until the Atlantic position, when we penetrated below an AS layer (height approximately 2,400 meters) it disappeared, and was not seen anymore. The variation in luminosity, height and speed were very different and impressed us a lot, so we decided to land in São Paulo. What was said here was observed by the crew. The shape of the object could not be identified. I compare, looking from the Control Center, with a track light. At most, it was shaped like a balloon. / Commander Nagib, Co-pilot Ruthildo, Telegraf. Raphael /. " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. As he made the rounds, he noticed a small light in the direction of the field. He went there (the field is at the top of the hill) and saw the UFO. The beam of light in the middle of the UFO did not illuminate around, where there were trees." ] ". CI-003. Item "8 - synthesis: Upside-down bowl-shaped object. Aluminum color."   CI-004. With a piece of conduit already in his hand, he tried two strikes, without hitting the individual, who, aided by another, who came from inside the central - passing through the window - helped the first to dominate the witness. Now dominated, he was suspended and released, several times, to fall to the ground, abandoned by the two; he received a slap on the back from the individual in the yellow shirt, followed by the following words: "go away, you tramp, that we will return when this work is over. Her husband saw the UFO and shivered. Still, he continued to watch it calmly. The UFO was observed until it disappeared." ] "   CI-006. Item "8 - synthesis: Small hat-shaped object; with rounded dome and a circular platform at the bottom. The witness would have heard a noise similar to tires braking on gravel; the object lit up all over, cleared the courtyard and went upwards amazingly." She correctly guessed that the woman wanted water and went with her to the water cooler, always trying to talk to the woman who answered nothing. After the bottle filled with water, the woman held out a small mug that was filled and the water was drunk. Both returned to the exit door. The woman said goodbye to the witness saying, "Umbaura" three times. After that, the woman went to the UFO (and here Mrs. Maria was astonished) and it took off with great light. Mrs. Maria was very scared. After a few hours, Army officers and the Director of the Sanatorium observed footprints at the entrance to the Sanatorium." ] ". CI-007. Item "8 - synthesis: Light source with the shape of a windshield; internally dark; on the periphery there was a very red strip of light. After a few minutes, it went out. It was seen from a distance". [More information from ARX.0.0.20 -When leaving the house with a friend, around 23:00, the witness looked at the clock of the Church of Santa Terezinha and observed a UFO, as if it were on top of the Church. The UFO was stopped and then started to move and then back again, stopping at the previous position at the beginning of the displacement. Then it went up vertically with incredible speed."]".   CI-008. " [More information from ARX.0.0.14 -The witness was going to work, when he came near the tractor to examine the differential oil, and noticed the UFO, on the other side between the tractor and a ravine. name: Five girls from Agudos-SP reported a shape-shifting UFO [1970]
description: Report from the Security Information Division [of the 4th Air Zone Command] to the Ministry of Aeronautics. AUG 21st, 1970. Time: 23: 00hs. Five university students from Agudos-SP, who "used to travel every night to Bauru-SP" to attend classes at Faculdade Educacional de Bauru, saw "a strange light on the night of August 21st, 1970, at 23:00 hs. The five students were traveling in the same car, and one of the girls in the back seat on the left side noticed a red light on Marechal Rondon highway, on the stretch "shortly after the YY Farm". According to this witness, "the light was opaque, did not emit light rays, and had a biconvex shape". The girl warned the other four in the car to see the object too. The driver then parked the car to observe. "They noticed with surprise that the light decreased in size and changed in shape, presenting itself as a small sphere and then growing, as if it were going to approach the vehicle". Naturally scared, they insisted that the driver should "put the car in motion", but she "wanted to stay there, to see what that object was". However, after the insistence of frightened colleagues, she decided to continue traveling with the car at a slow speed. All of them noticed "that the light went parallel to the vehicle, keeping a certain distance and at a low altitude because [the girls] could see it without having to lift their heads". The moment they arrived at the entrance to the Agudos-SP, they "parked once more. According to witnesses," the object has become very close thisa time. Its shape elongated, giving the impression to be now a rectangle. Terrified, they turn towards the road that leads to Agudos and the object followed, in parallel, the Marechal Rondon highway. Bel. O.G." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: An oval shaped UFO was sighted by most of the population of Varginha-MG [1971]
description: VARGINHA-MG. Year: 1971. Report from the Security Information Division [of the 2nd Air Zone Command] to the Ministry of Aeronautics. TRANSLATION "A few months ago, most of the population of Varginha, in the State of Minas Gerais, at approximately 19:00h had their attention drawn to an oval shaped object, predominantly silver, which not only circulated over the city but also it also hovered above certain points and districts of that city. In Vila Mendes, on Rio de Janeiro street, the strange object remained stationary near the roof of a residence, which made one of the residents lose her senses due to the deafening noise. Circling over the city, and observed by numerous witnesses (including doctors, traders, farmers, etc.), the luminous object went to the vicinity of COMA (Companhia Mineira de Alimentos) and the Campestre Club, from where, at a relatively low height, it emitted bright flashes (beams of light), a fact that was also witnessed. Then it took the direction of the city of Três Corações, having remained hovering over the Army's ESA (Sergeants of Arms School) where some militaries also witnessed the fact." Cf. name: A large flying saucer with round windows was spotted in Guaratinguetá-SP [1954]
description: Guratinguetá-SP. Year: 1954. [Reported in December 6th, 1971]. TRANSLATION OF THE REPORT "That night, around 9 pm, we were, as usual, two colleagues and I, talking by the sidewalk of a house on Vasco da Gama Street, which is where we lived at that time, that is, in 1954. The night was cold, without moonlight. There was a stillness in the air that was vividly evident by the emptiness of the deserted streets, a natural fact, because, with the cold, everyone retreats earlier. We, however, despite the cold, persisted there, next to the sidewalk, from where we could see a vast visual field, with a very starry sky. At 1,500 meters from where we were, there is this hill ‘Morro do Passarinho', which is bordered by the Presidente Dutra highway. Standing between us and the hill, there was a colleague's house. So, in that glacial atmosphere, my attention was drawn to something: the reflections of lights that were outlined in various colors, outlining the contours of a large flying saucer . This, however, instead of coming towards us, stopped in the air and, spinning almost imperceptibly, it evolved over the hill for about 20 meters, and then, on a sudden move, headed towards the city of Cunha. In the meantime, before it disappeared on the slopes of the hill, I tried to show it to my colleagues Mário and Francisco. However, due to a house I already mentioned, both saw, however, only the reflections of its light that were then extinguished on the slopes of the hill. As can be seen from what was previously written, the procedure of the strange device, that is, the flying saucer, was very strange. However, it seems that this procedure is due to the presence of light, that is, the city lights which the flying saucer sought to avoid. THE OBJECT FEATURES Based on the distance and sharpness with which I saw it, it must have been about 14 meters in diameter, having in its upper part a large dome, which had a line of round windows around it, from which a mild light poured. Notwithstanding the external colors of this light over the entire outline of the strange device, I had the distinct impression that inside the flying saucer a single yellow color with intense brightness shone. As for the metal that covered it, it had a coffee brown color. From what I deduced, the strange device, that is, the flying saucer, headed towards Cunha-SP, as it disappeared on the slopes of the hill. However, without saying, I must add that there is a great possibility that it landed on the slopes of the hill. Inspired by the Truth, and with God's help, I conclude this report. Guarantinguetá-SP, December 6th, 1971. " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: A plane was followed by a luminous object near Londrina-PR [1965]
description: On May 10th, 1965 , the Convair-340 plane, registration PP-YBJ, took off from São Paulo-SP, at 19:33 bound for Londrina-PR, piloted by Commander Orlando Ferreira Costa - Co-pilot B. Brigandeni Filho and Radio Operator José Carneiro Lavor. The crew reported being followed, from Itapetininga-SP to Londrina-PR, by a luminous object that constantly changed course. It flew first on the right, then on the left of the aircraft, even crossing its bow. As they approached Londrina Airport, Commander Orlando, calling the Control Tower, asked the service operator, 2 Sgt Jaime Correia, to observe the area and report if he found any abnormalities. The operator immediately drew the Commander's attention to the luminous object moving around the airport, declaring that it was not an airplane. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: 2-meter-tall beings in tight green clothes landed on a football field in Belo Horizonte-MG [1967]
description: On September 24th, 1967 , in Belo Horizonte-MG, 2-meter-tall beings with tight green clothes, similar to that of divers, emerged from a mushroom-shaped object, landed on a soccer field, leading the young Fábio Diniz to despair. Fábio said that the men had two wide round eyes, with thick triangular eyebrows. Their clothes and nostrils were protected by a dark and protruding screen. Covering the base of this bulkhead was a tube that ran down the chest to the right heel, then up the back of the neck. On the head, an antenna and an unknown weapon in his hand. The disk was about 20 meters in diameter, with a row of portholes [windows] and a steady upper triangular part. Fábio ran to the Police and [...] with technicians from the Civil Investigation Center for Unidentified Aerial Objects , who filmed, photographed and collected carbonized material for analysis. They found a depression in the place where the ship was landed. The recorded testimony lead to a case reconstruction and a sketch of beings. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: UFO sightings, contacts with beings and paranormal experiences in Alexânia-GO [1967 and 1969]
description: ‘Vale do Rio do Ouro' Farm, in Alexânia-GO, owned by Mr. Wilson Plácido Gusmão. Occurrences of UFO sightings, contacts with beings and paranormal experiences reported between the years 1967 and 1969. The report translated below brings some of these occurrences witnessed by a select group of people of good reputation and credibility in the societies of Brasília and Goiás at the time, such as high-ranking militaries, a lawyer, an employee of the city hall of Brasília-DF, and the owner of the Farm himself, a civil servant from the State of Goiás. The following excerpt shows the interaction between some of these witnesses and their impressions about the observed and reported facts. " General Uchôa* always said:" Look, people - this guided fog [?] brings a change of the sins."/ "The case is: a very interesting hat-like fog appeared on the farm. It comes down, surrounds us and holds us. They trap us even inside it . It has done this several times. After " it " left, we went home and left [...]. Soon after, another car arrived with Dr. Tuffi, from the Office of the Mayor of Brasília-DF, with four ladies. Soon after I started to mentalize [?], Having "he" returned and disappeared back in the car. From the hill, an immense mist descended as if it were a wave, lodged in the meadow, and from that mist a tail came out, a kind of jet and it is approaching. The women started to get scared, but I calmed them down. When the tail was about 4 meters from us, do you know what happened? (that's why, Maj Jacob, I say it was the most important fact) Music and perfume. Soft music and perfume invading our environment . In the meantime the light, a small shadow (there is a shadow similar to a bomb that [...] has passed around us several times) moved from the hill at high speed and when it was about 10 meters from us, it lit a beacon (like a searchlight) so strong and over that tail. The tail shrank and entered the fog. The shadow came, deflected and left. - MAJ JACOB: "They" collect that cloud. - Mr. Wilson: The great fog took off, returned to the hill and from the hill passed over our heads again with a distance of approximately 3km and took off towards the variant. - MAJ JACOB: This cloud is something extraordinary. - Mr. Wilson: On the 20th, MAJ JACOB came and it "did" the same thing. It did not send the tail, but covered the ground. We looked through the binoculars and saw the ground below, on the grass. - CEL BASTOS FILHO: And did the phenomenon of music and perfume happen again? - Mr. Wilson: No. It was not repeated, but we have already heard a noise similar to that of a helicopter. - CEL BASTOS FILHO: In this group, besides you, who are assiduous, has it constantly appeared to other people? - Mr. Wilson: Yes, it appeared to my employees. On the 1st of March, I went to Alexânia and left Dona Geralda with her children at the farm, and told her before leaving: "if some of my friends from [...] lia arrive in a silent device, you ask them to go down, serve them a coffee and tell them that I will be back soon. I arrived in Alexânia and had the intuition that "they" were going to appear and had something to talk about. When I returned, Dona Geralda said: "Mr. Wilson - You were up there on the hill all the time and your friends stayed here. It was a large device and cleared everything. "They" (there were three) opened a door and watched. I left with the lamp in my hand but they didn't want to go down. They stayed a long time, closed the door and left ". - CEL BASTOS FILHO: Were you in the farm yard? - Mr. Wilson: Yes. They stayed there waiting a long time. Then the boys arrived. Chico and Ronaldo and they confirmed everything. On the 26th of March, "he" appeared immediately turning on the blue light and I mentally said "Mr. Commander: I am willing to not go to the meeting any more. There is no way I am going any further. It is not fair. You can come in, you can even taste our food, because I am [...] already entitled to demand that". After a while I felt that my head was getting smaller and I said: "Sir, Commander - you know what - it is very cold and I am going to lie down" and I left. Then I looked out the window, "he" took flight and left. " * General Alfredo Moacyr de Mendonça Uchôa [1906-1996] was a Brazilian Army military officer, civil engineer, professor and one of the pioneers of Ufology in Brazil. He wrote 6 books on the topics of Ufology and parapsychology: "Além da parapsicologia – 5.ª e 6.ª dimensões da realidade" (Editora Horizonte, 1968); "A parapsicologia e os discos voadores – O caso Alexânia" (Editora Grupo de Expansão Cultural, 1973); "Cristo para a humanidade de hoje" (Editora Horizonte, 1980); "Mergulho no hiperespaço – Dimensões esotéricas na pesquisa dos discos voadores" (Editora Horizonte, 1981); "Muito além do espaço e do tempo" (Editora Thesaurus, 1983); "Uma busca da verdade – Autobiografia" (Edição do autor, 1995). name: Pilots, controllers and hundreds of people spotted a UFO squad in Belo Horizonte-MG [1972]
description: JULY 27th, 1972. Time: 10:25 pm. Report by J.F.S. - Head of NPV SBBH [Belo Horizonte Airport Flight Protection Nucleus] TRANSLATION "At 21:01:25Z, the pilot of plane PP-VJO reported Cleusa FL 190 VMC NOT position, and shortly after he asked TWR-BH if we were observing unidentified objects moving in the East sector of Belo Horizonte, as he was seeing them in a different way. We immediately observed [the sector] through the binoculars and we could see a streak of whitish light disappearing towards Nova Lima. We asked PP-VJO if the object was disappearing and this confirmed it. At this moment, SC 107 called BH and reported Curió position 01.16Z FL 330 and informing that he also saw the luminous objects, right after I called TWR and the S1 V. of the Fire Dept that said he was on duty at the station and saw the objects. TWR called us claiming to have seen the objects from his car on the road, perfectly, the amateur radio user P.C. prefix PX4A-0057, called saying that he had seen the objects. Just after ACC BR reported that VASP 234 making the route Goiânia-Brasília had spotted the objects inside the TMA de BR and asking the TWR BR colleague to report the phenomenon in his LRO (for future reference). We also inform that hundreds of people spotted this UFO here in Belo Horizonte and I send narratives of two people that coincide with the general one. According to 1S Q AT TG E. A. R., it had the appearance of a squadron of jet plane s and it was as if everyone had their headlights on, illuminating each other, forming a reasonable area. At the rear, this clarity diminished, until it ended in a luminous filament. It was possible to distinguish fixed points of light, maintaining distances between them. 2S Q AT CV D.L.P. he also spotted the objects outside the city on a highway. He stopped the car to get a better look at them. He said it looked like a shoal of fish, keeping constant distances between them, all with a luminous trail. They moved with great speed, taking about thirty seconds in their trajectory, with an altitude of approximately 10 to 15 meters, without any noise, in a northwest to southeast direction. /J.F.S. - Head of NPV SBBH / " Cf. name: A Ret. General reported a UFO sighting near Realeza-MG [1972]
description: JULY 26th, 1972. Time: 10:15 pm. A Retired General's report on the sighting of a UFO during a trip on highway BR-116, near Realeza-MG. TRANSLATION "Event: We were going on a journey, my family and I, from Rio de Janeiro-RJ to Vitória da Conquista-BA, when it was first seen by my wife and soon after by me, a flying object at an approximate distance of 2 km, on the left from the highway and at an estimated height of between 600 and 800 meters. The object, that my wife thought it was a comet, flew from West to East, at a speed that I considered average for this type of aircraft, as I will explain later. In the 20 or 30 seconds that the object spent from the point at which it was initially observed until it passed over the bus, it first showed up its side, like a large concave-convex plate, of a diaphanous blue and intense shine, with a flaming tail, whose variable size reached up to the diameter of the device. Then I had the impression that it was spinning on its own axis and then it stopped instantly above the bus, descending to 400 or 500 meters of height. It presented before my astonished eyes all its ventral (concave) surface. My wife did not see this second phase, because she diverted her attention to alert the other passengers about what was happening. Accustomed to long years of working with a microscope and, therefore, to distinguish well the details of the images presented to me, I observed the whole and each of its parts in perfect detail. The aircraft or spaceship (difficult to say with certainty) then appeared in that position as a big and amazing chrome (something out of this world, which I don't believe much), giving the feeling that it had stopped for a moment above the bus, having I evaluated measure the whole fuselage between 80 and 100 meters in diameter, with a slightly larger diagonal than the transversal side. If it were an image seen under a microscope, I would say it was an artifact of coloring. It also gave the impression of a great and fantastic cinematic projection on space. The structure of the apparatus was relatively simple: it consisted of four large dark disks, as if they were engine rooms, apparently immobile, each with a dome above it; corresponding to the fifth part of the disk size, intensely brilliant, of a characteristic diaphanous blue, with each of the discs openings in the lower external lateral angles, through which jetted black and reddish particles appeared, looking like a shower of fire, and suggesting perhaps the existence of solid fuel. Despite the power of the jets, there was no noise. The four discs, arranged in squares of close and square formation, seemed connected by a cohesive zone similar to a thin layer of air or gases of a red and orange color . In the horizontal position, the four jets appeared separately, while in profile we saw a single thick jet. We present an attachment in a rustic sketch of the disks seen in profile and from the front. GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS I said earlier that I thought the speed developed by the disk squadron was average, because one afternoon in 1961, when I was returning from the Ministry's hours, driving my car down Avenida do Mangue, I saw in the sky of Tijuca, at great height and distance, a ball with the same specific blue color, perceived by all who saw such objects, and which is really the color of the dome that crowns the disc, as we saw before. This ball moved in space with incredible speed, to the point of disappearing in the path from one place to another. As I was only in the car, I didn't comment much on the event. When I arrived in Rio back [after returning from Bahia], I was a little reluctant to make this communication. [...] But, as there are doubts about the origin of these flying devices, I thought it was my duty to report everything I saw. Because if this is a secret artifact from a friendly and sensible power like the U.S.A., we have nothing to fear. The newspapers of Bahia reported on the following day, 27-JUL-1972, the passage of these objects through a district in Minas Gerais, not far from Realeza-MG, where ‘sportingly' it landed on a football field, in full operation. However, if they come from other planets, they can be one of the reconnaissance patrols that have been watching us for a long time and that are getting closer and closer (like the descent and the climb they made above our bus, with the obvious intention of showing off to be seen) it is best to seek, by all means at our disposal, contact with these space travelers, and make the best possible deal, or else to continue on our way and imitate the ostrich, hiding our head under the wings and wait for the events. Rio de Janeiro, Guanabara, August 14, 1972. J.V. F. Gen DIV MED. R / " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: A pilot and AT controllers reported a UFO near Pirassununga-SP [1972]
description: DEC 14th, 1972. TWR / APP-RADAR SBSP [Control Tower and Approach Control of the São Paulo Airport] Translation of the report [by J.V.R.F. 2TEN ESP CTA / Head of ACC / TWR / APP-RADAR SBSP] "At approximately 16:20Z, TWR-KP [Control Tower of the Campinas-SP Airport] warned that it spotted an unidentified object in the western sector of Campinas-SP. At 16:42Z, the VP-232 aircraft B-111 prefix PP-SRT, having taken off from SBSP / SBBR FL 280 [from Congonhas-SP Airport to Brasília-DF Airport, at 28,000 altitude level] was consulted by APP SBSP [São Paulo Airport Approach Control] on the possibility of diversion in order to fly over the west sector of the Airport Campinas-SP for the verification and possible identification of the object. The pilot of the aircraft agreed. When the object was spotted by VP-232, the pilot reported that it was apparently a balloon at FL 200 [20,000 ft]. Later, he rectified the initial information, saying it was not a balloon, as it had its own movement. He identified it as an object with a rounded shape, white in color, and it was not possible to have a more perfect identification since the object apparently was at level 4000 [40.000ft] above, and due to problems of autonomy, he would be forced to abandon the identification mission of the object, following his landing at the SBBR [Brasília-DF], the pilot detailed, however, that the object was on the VCP radial 260 [Viracopos Airport - Campinas-SP] in the vicinity of the TIETÊ vertical. He also reported that at a given moment, when the aircraft was already leveled at FL 280 [28.000ft], the object tried to approach the VP-232, having then moved away from the aircraft, heading northwest in an apparent ascension. Later, at the station's frequency, he heard from TWR SBK with TWR SBYS [Aerodrome of AFA - Brazilian Air Force Academy, in Pirassununga-SP], consulting the possibility of some jet aircraft from the SBYS Cadet School taking off with the purpose of verifying and possibly identifying the metallic surface object (provoked reflection of sunlight), with a triangular or conical shape, in the vicinity of TIETÊ approximately on the radial RDL 250/260 of VCP with an approximate altitude of 40,000 ft. At 17:32Z, we heard contact from TWR SBYS with TWR SBKP, reporting that the object was near Pirassununga-SP. At 21:30Z, SBSP reported that an aircraft spotted an unidentified object (allegedly the same) in the vicinity of Avaré-SP, having reported to APP SP that it was to send a report to ACC SBSP. The PP-SRT VP-232 pilot, after returning from the flight made by SBBR, he also contacted RADAR SBSP and the supervisor / class leader Commander JSA, informing that he had the opportunity to take two photographs of the object, making himself available to the authorities for any further clarification that may be necessary as well as the photographs after they are revealed./ JVRF 2TEN ESP CTA / Head of ACC / TWR / APP-RADAR SBSP /" Cf. name: ‘Strange lights' on Ubirajara-Galia road - SP [1972]
description: AUG-NOV 1972. Testimonials from EZALDIVAR HUMBERTO BORGHI and CATARINA CARVALHO TEIXEIRA. EZALDIVAR HUMBERTO BORGHI testimonial summary: In August 1972 , on a Saturday night when he was returning from the city of Ubirajara-SP to the city of Galia-SP, at around 9:30 pm, Mr. Borghi was driving his car along the Intermunicipal Road Ubirajara-Galia, near the Figueirinha Farm about 2 km from the bridge over Ribeirão Vermelho, when it "saw a light on the road". Mr. Borghi was surprised by the fact that, according to him, there was no traffic on the site, mainly because it was a little rainy and it was "very dark" night. He decided to stop the car, and leave the engine running. After he looked everywhere he saw "an object of circular shape appear on the road" with an apparent diameter of 60 cm at that distance, emitting a "light that is not very intense, but a little opaque, orange-red in color. The following Wednesday, again in Ubirajara-SP, Borghi commented on the fact with fellow teachers and they did not give much attention to his story. A month after the sighting on the same road at night, passing by the same spot near the Ribeirão Vermelho bridge in Galia-SP, Borghi saw it again, on his right, but this time he did not pay attention to the fact, nor did he stop to verify, as the object remained there this time only for a few moments. Borghi reported that, on another occasion, taking the same route, he saw the phenomenon again. This time, as he knew there was one more car with other teachers coming right after him, on the same road, he decided to wait for their car, with Professor Lourdes with three other people with her. Borghi parked his car and stood outside "seeing the ball of light" and waiting for the car with his colleagues to approach. They arrived, got out of the car and witnessed the phenomenon with him. On this day, the object was with the most intense light and with the largest diameter, making movements more slowly horizontally and vertically, and "producing flashes". The object was about 3,000 meters away. Next to this object, another one appeared, with a smaller diameter, moving towards the large object and merging with it. Then the larger object disappeared too. Mr. Borghi reported that "the lights are not constant, but appear and disappear in a few moments". After witnessing the phenomenon, Professor Lourdes told her colleagues in the city of Ubirajara-SP that the fact had really happened, confirming Borghi's previous statements. On October 28, 1972 , almost two months after the first sighting, when Borghi was making the same path, and when he was 100 meters from the same bridge over Ribeirão Vermelho, he saw the object, this time closer than the other times before and at a height of 20 meters from the ground. This time the UFO had "a larger diameter, approximately 1.5 m and a much more intense light, with the same orange-red color, completely brightening the bridge, because its focus was from top to bottom". According to Borghi, the object came to be "1 meter from the bridge", making "horizontal movements". The witness states that he left his car's engine and lights on and that the UFO's lights were even brighter and brighter than those of the car. There was no interference or interruption in the engine or in the car lights. At a certain point, Borghi stated that the UFO did seem to go in his direction, which left him "terrified" and made him maneuver the car and quickly return to Ubirajara-SP. In the days that followed, more people from the city of Ubirajara found out and looked for the spot on the road to also try to see the phenomenon. A city priest said he saw the same light as Borghi, confirming his story. One of Borghi's fellow teachers at school, Mr. Durval, who still doubted the UFO story on the Ubirajara-Galia Road, was convinced by Mr. Borghi to go see it with him after work to the place so that Durval could also see the phenomenon too. They did so and after 20 minutes waiting for the light to show up, the UFO appeared about 60 meters from them, with the same characteristics as always. Mr. Durval, this time, declared: "It is true!". Mr. Durval had the ‘idea' to take a gun and point it the object, but at the same time the UFO got away from them. Then, the two teachers continued with the car with its headlights off, going slowly along the road and "following the object from a distance". At that moment, a red Ford Corcel vehicle, which Borghi recognized as Professor Catarina's car, stopped over the bridge. The UFO then emitted a spotlight on the car and then an intense light clearing the entire region of the bridge, and disappeared moments later. Borghi and Durval drove to the bridge and met Father James and Professor Catarina who "claimed that they had seen nothing at that time". The light object appeared next "on the horizon, on the side of Fazenda Paraíso" and "this time everyone saw it", turning on and off in different places and moving with fast speed. CATARINA CARVALHO TEIXEIRA testimonial summary: Upon hearing comments from Professor Borghi and others about the sightings of an object of light on the Intermunicipal Road Ubirajara-Galia, Professor Catarina Teixeira initially did not take the fact very seriously. One night, she and another colleague, Lourdes, were going home and, when they arrived near the Ribeirão Vermelho bridge, they noticed a light that was about 6 meters from the bridge. Catarina was terrified with the object, showing it to her colleague. Catarina tried to maneuver her car, but as the place was narrow, she couldn't. She then looked at the object and saw that it was an unidentified flying object, never seen by her before. Fearful, Catarina finally managed to make the maneuver with the car and return to Ubirajara, where she spoke with the School Director and Borghi. At that moment, these two decided to go see the phenomenon with them. Catarina stated that when everyone arrived, in two cars, at the sighting place, the UFO was already gone. They waited for about 15 minutes and decided to leave. According to Professor Catarina, on the way back, she "noticed that the same object was following her car, because besides her car and the Professor Borghi's car behind, there was another one [between them] as she was able to notice in the rearview mirror." She said that she suddenly noticed that the "third car" was no longer behind her. She asked Borghi "where did that vehicle come from?", and he replied that he had not seen any vehicle". Catarina then stated that "the light from the third vehicle was very strong, out of the ordinary" and that this made her even more terrified. This was the first time that professor Catarina saw this type of phenomenon. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). name: Three men reported a close encounter with a UFO in a quarry in Votorantim-SP [1974]
description: MAY 28th, 1974 . In the Pedreira da "Placa" region, in Vila Santa Helena, in the city of Votorantim, State of São Paulo, three people reported the sighting of a UFO. Witnesses: Jaime Belizário. Salvador Pinto da Silva. Mauro Bulgari. Translation of the 3 Reports given to the local Police Department: Jaime Belizário: "When he was "working as a truck driver in the "Placa" Quarry in Santa Helena, about 11:10 pm, his colleague Rafael asked him to come see a strange object. Later, his colleague Mario was also warned and then the three of them began to wait for the object to appear. The witness was with his truck standing on top of a ravine and when the object appeared, he shouted at Rafael to stop the machine. The three men went down on the ground and started to appreciate the object. Four or five times it passed over them. On one occasion, the object stopped over where they were; the object floated in the air; the witness noticed that the object had the shape of a "Ferris wheel", with green, red and yellow lights on the edges. It was noticeable that it had a small volume at the bottom, and the vision was impaired because of the spotlights in the quarry. The color of the object's body could not be ascertained. When the object floated, it made no noise. The witness ‘yelled at it' to come down, then they heard a turbine noise and the device took the course of Inhaíba-SP. The lights or even the sound had no effect on the deponent; the lights were identical in intensity to the reflectors, but in different colors, as he said; the device never landed on the floor and left no trace; the first time you saw the object, it was about 100 meters from the ground; when it floated on top of the witness and his colleagues, it was at a height of 100 meters, or less; he has been working in the same quarry for three years and has never seen anything like that. He said nothing more. Read and found compliant, it will be signed. I, A. B. Registrar who typed it." Salvador Pinto da Silva: "He was on duty at the "Placa" Quarry, when around 01:40 am he went up with the loaded truck, bound for the crusher, and when he reached the end of the climb, he noticed a strange object, about 100 meters high, which came in the direction of the cement factory towards the television towers of S. Francisco Farm. He only noticed that the object had several lights, in green, red and yellow colors, one of which blinked a lot. He did not notice the shape and if the device made any sound. As the truck was moving, he could not observe the object very well. In the next morning he was informed that other people working in the quarry had also seen the same object. That was the first time he noticed the object in that vicinity. He said nothing more. Read and found to be in compliance, it is signed. I, AB Registrar, typed it." João Bulgari: "During the night, I was working with the truck at the "Placa" Quarry, in Vila Santa Helena, when about 01:00 am, Rafael told João that he had seen a strange object above the Quarry around 10:00 pm. The declarant, in addition to Rafael and "Paraná" [Jaime], tried to observe the object. Three times the declarant saw the object pass over the Quarry, and the last time it stopped right above the Quarry. He noticed that the object was circular in shape, with lights on the edge, but he was unable to distinguish which side that was the front and which one was the back side. The object had several lights, and the witness couldn't tell how many. On both sides they were yellow, green and red. The device emitted a turbine hum, very soft and when it came out it increased the sound volume. The witness and the others were on the floor, because they had stopped working, when "Paraná" [Jaime] jokingly shouted at the object to appear and come down. At that moment, the device increased the noise of the turbine, going off towards Votorantim. The sound of the turbine or even the lights, did not have any effect on the reporting witness and his companions. The witness has no clue on how high the object was above the ground and he didn't even notice if the object was manned. The lights on the device were weaker than the spotlights used to illuminate the quarry. He has been working there for three and a half years in this same quarry, and has never noticed this fact before. He said nothing more. Read and found compliant, it will be signed. I, A. B. Registrar who typed it." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: A ‘huge' shape-shifting cloud-like UFO was spotted in Belo Horizonte-MG [1974]
description: APRIL 7th, 1974. Time: 18:10. Duration: 3 to 5 minutes. In Carlos Prates, region of Belo Horizonte, State of Minas Gerais. TRANSLATION "Observers: Group 1: M.M. and 4 children Group 2: 9 people of G.L.'s family Researchers who interviewed the witnesses: Húlvio Brant (CICOANI) and Pierre Doransart, from the group "Lumière dans la Nuit", from Paris-France. 1) Telephone interview: M.M .: His wife arrived at the kitchen door to observe the sky in the direction of BR-135 and called him afterwards. Upon arriving he had the impression of seeing a moving cloud , but soon he noticed something strange . He checked his watch at 18:10 hs. He saw a shapless cloud, without light, darker than the nearby rain clouds. Looking like a giant bird, with swallow-like movements: to the left, to the right, rising, falling within a narrow angle. During the evolution, only one figure was seen, until, in a brief stop, the object presented the shape of a bowl or a deep dish, seen from the side, with the mouth upwards. After calling the neighbors he continued to observe, but he did not see how the object disappeared, because he lost sight of it. The hypothesis of an airplane was excluded due to the sudden movements and the object's stops. The observation was made at Araruama Street, in the Carlos Prates neighborhood. In the final part of the observation he noticed that the object was in the direction of the 12th Infantry Regiment. He clearly marked the angle of the view, taking as reference the roof of a neighboring house. Estimated duration: 3 to 5 minutes. During its evolution, the object gave the impression of losing balance. It seemed to be very low and, and about to fall down, but it stayed below the Serra do Curral line, to the right of the TV repeater. He thinks the object was over the city, possibly in the vertical of the 12th R.I. 2) Personal interview, at the observers' residence: a) Mrs. Maria da Glória confirms that she was at the door of the kitchen, facing the Serra do Curral [south], observing the weather, when she saw a kind of dark cloud with different movements, looking like it was going to fall. During its evolution it presented varied and poorly defined formats, due to rain clouds. The size was "huge". The speed of the movements removed the initial impression of the cloud. The observer called her husband and he alerted the neighbors. At a certain point, the object was sharper, shaped like a plate . He believes that the changes in shape were due to movements. The object did not emit luminosity and was not confused with clouds, as it was darker and more consistent. It gave the impression that it was going to fall towards the Belvedere neighborhood, but then it went up. Mrs. Maria da Glória thinks that someone else in the city must have seen it. b) Ms. Maria José, 24, student, said that the neighbor would. Mario called his father and he saw the object together with 8 or 9 people in the family. At first she noticed a dark spot, towards the neighborhoods of Cidade Jardim and Santo Antônio, just above the contour of Serra do Curral. The black spot began to make wavy movements, rising and turning and showing different contours at every moment. Sometimes it looked like a bird , sometimes like a very clear saucer . The sky, around the object, was lighter than on the opposite side. The object stood out in the clouds. Its movements were fast, but they could be followed. It gave the impression of a flock of swallows, but it seemed to be a single object , with oscillating movements made in a restricted range. At one point, it ‘threatened' to descend, even having distant houses as a background. During the descent it took a vertical and the same position rose vertically, then disappeared. (Maria José places a saucer upright to explain the position of the object). The sharpness of the contour occurred in a short period. It was estimated that the object was at the height of 12th R.I." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: Animal mutilation in Santa Vitória do Palmar-RS [1975]
description: "The udder is extracted from a strangely shaped cow" [SPIPDV Research] TRANSLATION On July 13th, 1975. "Another strange and unprecedented fact happened to one of the animals from Mr. Osman Rodrigues' Farm, located in Santa Vitória do Palmar (RS). At dawn that day, the employees found a Polled-Angus cow dead in strange circumstances. The udder was extracted from the animal by means of a perfect circular incision, completely covering it, so that it came out entirely, including, with all its branching of blood vessels, milk ducts, breasts, etc. There was no bleeding and the udder was completely clean. This cow was in the most perfect health, as was verified at the time of the daily inspection made on the previous day, in the afternoon. It would have suffered a quick death during the night, because, in the place, where the animal was lying, there was no sign that he had kicked scratching the ground. The udder was extracted at night in a very strange way, and with such perfection, that is, the circle cut was made, at once, without suffering any deviation. Such a feat is unprecedented, according to the experts, because no man "no matter how experienced he was, would hardly be able to execute that perfect cut. After realizing the strange fact, Mr. Osman's employees removed the animal's skin, as usual, and buried the rest. This curious episode happened just 150 meters from the farm houses, and nobody noticed anything, not even the animal's screaming. What strange "thieves" could only be interested in the cow's udder and didn't take away its precious meat?! For what purpose? SPIPDV Research." STRANGE DEATH OF A LAMB [SPIPDV Research] TRANSLATION Between July 27th and 31st, 1975. At Mr. Osman Rodrigues' Farm, in Santa Vitória do Palmar (RS), another strange case was repeated with one of his sheep. According to Mr. OSman's own report, a sheep from his property, of the Corriedale breed, gave birth to a lamb, apparently in normal birth, during the night. However, shortly after dawn, the little animal was found dead in strange circumstances. On its muzzle, something like a "suction cup" had been placed, and it seems that, by this means, all the blood was extracted. This was verified, when removing the respective skin, as usual. The bones of the muzzle and around it were completely broken or dented, possibly due to the strong compression suffered. Also an interesting detail: from the tip of the tongue, which was retracted into the mouth, a piece was removed, using a sharp instrument or something like that. Both Mr. Osman and his employees are of the opinion that it would be impossible for such a thing to be the work of a dog or even any other predatory animal, since they did not notice any scratching of the claws in the lamb, or teeth mark on the lamb's body. Such an episode happened in the same area where in 1973 those others were recorded, in which the sheep appeared dead, in the middle of the flock, with "strange holes in the neck" and completely without blood. (See SPIPDV Bulletin no. 03). And, following the example of that occasion, strange luminous objects that have not been identified can also be seen in the same area during the night. / SFIFDV research /. " Cf. name: A woman reported a close encounter with an extraterrestrial inside her house . Pelotas-RS [1973]
description: TRANSLATION "Mrs. Maria Farias Leivas, 66, married, resident of Balneário dos Prazeres (Laranjal), in Pelotas, Rio Grande do Sul, told us the following and extraordinary fact she witnessed." "It was about 10:00 am, on October 7th, 1973. She was alone at home, and her husband had left for work. Mrs. Maria, was frightened when she noticed strange noises inside a room in the back of her residence, as if someone was walking around there. She could clearly hear footsteps on the floor. In this place of the house, groceries are stored and there are also some objects, including sleeping hammocks and fishing nets, belonging to his son, a married man, who lives in another house. Mrs. Maria Leivas, despite her fear, went to check what was going on, but she didn't see the intruder. After that, she reached the front door of the house, and was surprised when she looked. There, standing, was a "strange boy", a type of student, but very similar to a Japanese man, mainly his eyes. He would be about 1.50m to 1.60m tall, skinny, and his clothing was very similar to that of a "hippie, but his blue-gray blouse had designs that were totally strange for the witness, similar to a rhombus. The belt had an unknown buckle type. Maria approached the visitor and, of course, she asked who he was and what he wanted. To her surprise, the "boy" told him that moments earlier he had been inside the residence looking for a type of net that his son knew how to make. He added that he was not from Earth, but from another planet far beyond in the Space, and that his main objective when he was there was to learn how to make such a net, which would be used in baskets through which they would descend from their ships to the ground. Then, Maria thinking that she was being fooled, told him that he had to leave, since she had no time to lose with someone who wanted to have fun at her expenses. Faced with this impasse, the "young man", to prove he was serious, pointed up and told the lady to watch as "they" descend from the ship that was not visible. Maria noticed, then, that suspended by a rope, came down towards the ground, a large and empty basket, made of ropes or similar material (see case of Canada, in 1971, SS&S Bulletin No. 63, 1973, p. 17) . She couldn't see where the rope ended up there, only that it held the basket (about 2 meters high, approximately) which stopped when it touched the ground and then flattened it out, a few meters from the point where Maria and the "boy" were. During the contact with extraterrestrial, which lasted about 5 minutes, he told the witness that "they have the ability to be among us humans without being noticed", including with university students. For that they are characterized, or better, they take our human form, with the same clothes that we commonly wear, and so they walk easily among us without being perceived ". One thing that really caught Maria's attention, since the beginning of the encounter with the strange character, was a thin, silvery-yellow, shiny, but very beautiful rope that the "boy" carried with him under the arm. Asking about the uses of that rope, he replied that it was intended for making the net, whose type of weave he intended to learn to make with his son. Maria remembered to ask the "young man" for a piece of the rope, but he surprisingly denied, saying that he was not allowed to do so. But, he said, the humans ahead will still have this material from which the rope is made, which using just a small piece, if diluted in water and taken three times, can cure our diseases, including cancer . After that, the strange "boy" called Maria's attention so that she could look at the way he was going to leave. Then, afterwards, she almost fainted, having to lean on the gate so as not to fall, and when she recovered, the strange visitor and the basket were no longer present. The lady immediately went looking for him, trying to see where he and the basket were, but as much as she looked, she saw nothing else. It was as if they had evaporated. COMMENTS It should be added here that the extraterrestrial said to the witness, that he would return at another time when his son was working in the making of the net but that he would probably not be seen. And this really happened, after approximately one year, after that memorable day on October 7, 1973, when the extraterrestrial appeared in front of Maria Leivas. Mr. Manoel Leivas, 44 years old, married, son of Dona Maria, in an interview we had with him, told us the following: on a certain night, between 22:00hs and 23:00hs, after having obtained a piece of a rope for mooring ship, unraveling it, he managed to elaborate with that piece of rope, another part of the net. Manoel Hugo told us that, on that occasion, he felt a strange sensation, as if he were being watched closely by someone invisible! With that in mind, he tried to work as quickly as possible and within an hour his task was over, having left the needles stuck in his own net, something he had never done before. After that occasion, he never resumed his work. As for the authenticity of the present case, we have no doubt in accepting it as such, since other facts exist that corroborate this. Here in Brazil, for example, several cases of this nature have already occurred. SBEDV Bulletin no. 94/98, has printed on one of its pages, an article under the title "Observations of Discos Voadores no Pará", by Ester C.L., in which she mentions cases of witnesses who saw extraterrestrial beings disappear in front of them. One fact mentioned by Ester C.L. deserves a special observation. The case Brigadier Commander of the Val-de-Cãs Air Base [in Belém do Pará] himself reported to her: " My soldiers also saw this couple. Because they found him very surprising, they decided to follow them on the road and, likewise, the" couple suddenly disappeared. "I am very grateful for this testimony, which is valuable to us, asking you to keep secret to all of this. " Now, a statement like that, coming from a high-ranking military man, such as this one, logically we must accept it without any major restrictions. This is because this officer certainly would not risk the position that he occupies of high responsibility, also the high reputation that he enjoys within that population, he would not report an unfounded fact. The renowned researcher from Paraná, Carlos Varassim, our dear friend, through correspondence that addressed us, informed that when he traveled to Belo Horizonte, MG, in 1973, the illustrious colleague Prof. Guilherme Wirz confessed to him, that after many years studying the UFO problem, he came to the conclusion that "the beings that man the DVs [flying saucers] can present themselves to our eyes in different ways (and suits), this being not their real form". And this, too, according to Wirz, was communicated by "them" telepathically to the tractor driver Toríbio Pereira, when he was told that "they presented themselves as they pleased in our eyes, and this is not their final, real form". Analyzing this aspect of the enigma presented by extraterrestrial beings, Carlos Varassim concludes: "Now, in the face of this fact (to be true), what advances all the immense work of Jader Pereira, classifying types, etc., if they are only appearances , not real beings?" Maria Leivas is a person who should be classified as "sensitive", because, in addition to this fact, she has seen strange things on many other occasions and even received communications from beings she says are from the "astral" [dimension]. In the Bulletin no. 03, from SPIPDV, pgs. 2 or 3 are dedicated to the first case lived by Mrs. Maria, that is, the one that occurred in 1952, when she was face to face with an alien crew member of a DV, with whom she had a quick dialogue, which tried "take her to another planet". Furthermore, to corroborate what we think about Mrs. Maria Leivas, it is interesting here to mention the article under the title "Are psychic people more likely to see UFOs?", written by Janet Bord and published in the English Bulletin FSR of May / June 1972, on page 20, 21 and 22. In the initial text of her work, the columnist says: " Now that UFO researchers are more and more considering the possibility of correlating UFOs with a whole range of hidden phenomena, it is interesting that a deeper investigation of those who spotted UFOs, reveals that each witness spotted a UFO more than once, and also experienced what is commonly called psychic experience. It seems that there is a certain "sensitivity in operation, and those who have it are more likely to see all sorts of strange things, invisible to most human eyes. " "A man who falls into this category is Charles Jones. He lives in a pleasant rural area of ​​Indiana-USA, and has seen UFOs frequently for the past 24 years." Now, regarding Mrs. Maria Leivas, we found a very significant coincidence. She also resides in a "pleasant rural area", which is located in the Balneário dos Prazeres and, like Charles Jones, the area where she lives and where all UFOs and other phenomena have been observed, is generally flat and also limited by a big forest that is on the margins of Lagoa dos Patos (where the Balneário dos Prazeres is located). Our opinion, therefore, is that both Mrs. Maria Farias Leivas and the american Charles Jones, are psychic people, which is why they are endowed with an extraordinary extrasensory perception, a faculty that, certainly, conditions them to experiences and communications dictated by highly evolved extraterrestrial beings, interested for one reason or another on our planet Earth. / Luiz do Rosario Real - Pelotas, October / 75 " Cf.
