name: "Luminous phenomena" observed in  Capão do Leão, Pelotas-RS [1975]
description: "Luminous phenomena observed in a Farm located in Capão do Leão, Pelotas-RS". TRANSLATION On June 28th, 1975 , based on the information we had obtained previously from Mr. H.S., a radio transmission technician at Rádio Universidade de Pelotas, our group ( consisting of the following people: L.R.R., President of SPIPDV, W.S.S. and P.L.M.C., also from SPIPDV, plus L.A.C., C.M., F.L.S., and H.N., all from the Astronomy Society of Colégio Municipal Pelotense ) went to the farm owned by Mr. C. A. located in the rural area of ​​Pelotas, in the district of Capão do Leão, and 35 km from the headquarters. We left the city in two cars at 3:10 pm and arrived there at 3:40 pm. Unfortunately, we did not find Mr. C.A. on the property, because he had traveled to Pelotas in the morning. The foreman was also not present. With them we would have obtained information about the disappearance of animals on the farm , and even about the strange disease that has been observed in some animals . Therefore, we tried to talk to the foreman's substitute. At first, he was a little afraid to say anything about the facts that have been happening on the farm. However, encouraged by us, he assured us that the reports we had about the existence of luminous phenomena and problems with animals, were correct , because he, although not having witnessed the events, knew through his service companions, of everything that happens in the farm. Due to the late hour (it was already 4:00 pm), and as we would have to walk another 7 km until we reached the place of the events - this before dusk - and through a terrible path, we said goodbye to the man and continued our journey. We finally arrived in the area and we split into two groups, each one taking their own equipment, consisting of radio transmitters with a range of up to 27 km, compasses, battery, lanterns, binoculars, cameras and even a telescope. However, before we arrived at this place - which is located next to some woods along the Piratini River, some 3 km before that point - we stopped at the last house of the farm, and met a person in charge of its machinery, Mr. AG with whom we talked for a few minutes. We asked him if he had seen a strange luminous object at night in that sector, and he promptly answered the following - this we recorded on magnetic tape - : " A few days ago, last week, me and my family, we saw three saucers at night, between 8:00 pm and 9:00 pm, flying close to that bush by the Piratini River. They were round in shape, like two dishes one up another one down over the other, and they made no noise, they were about 10 meters from the ground, and had an orange color ". The man also added that, next to the bush on the banks of the Piratini River, more precisely in Ilha das Uvas, there is a strange and curious "jeep" that occasionally "walks above the ground", and also "over the trees "... (!?) This is what some of the workers told him. But also that " when they were alone, they were invited to take a ride in that strange vehicle, but they ended up throwing themselves from the vehicle to the ground, scared, when they realized how the "jeep" - instead of driving down the road - was "flying" (!?) Some of these workers also told us that " sometimes a "strange knight" also appears, and once he rushed at them and when he was very close, he simply "disappeared as if by magic". Well, after arriving at the place indicated to wait for the appearance of the luminous phenomena, we split into two groups, and then we started looking for traces or footprints, which could denote the presence of aliens or even some strange vehicle. One thing, right away, caught the attention of us all. There was no bird to be seen in the vicinity, not even to hear its song, something common when in the woods. The silence was total. We had a strange feeling, as if something invisible was watching us. LIGHT FOCUS ON EUCALYPTUS FOREST It would be between 5:00 and 5:30 pm, when the first fact happened: the young girl C.M., who had stayed with the first group, at the base point of operations, a little nervous, warned us over the radio that she had just seen, in a quick moment, the appearance of a bright white light, over an eucalyptus grove located on the northeast side and at 10° above the horizon. We were all atentious, watching that sector, but we saw nothing after that communication. However, it seemed to us that a sixth sense warned us that something extraordinary was about to happen. SPECTACULAR LIGHT PROJECTION, LIKE A HUGE "FIREPLACE" Right after nightfall, it would be between 6:00 pm and 6:30 pm, the second fact came across us, and in the same direction as C.M. had seen that light close to the ground, about 800 meters from where we were standing, a red light was projected. Then it gradually increased in size, and suddenly, it expanded upwards, like the flames of a huge fire, up to a height of about 10 m. From there, the color changed to an orange tone in the upper part, and below it had a rotating bright red color, as seen from binoculars. In the meantime, we noticed "flashes" of white light, which sometimes stood out from the larger light, that was orange. This spectacle of rare beauty, such as the projection of light emitted there, lasted approximately 5 minutes. After that, we saw the transformation from orange and red light to an opaque white tone, and its size decreased a lot, becoming a triangular shape with the vertex upwards. Moments after the curious projection had dimmed, I urged the companions to get closer to where the "light" was. Returning up to about 200 meters, along the same path, where we had passed before, we parked the cars and went to stand on an elevation of the terrain. From there we were able to observe better and with more vision the strange luminous phenomenon. We signaled several times, towards that point, with the battery lanterns, even blinking and describing angles with the beam of light, so that they would understand that we wanted them to approach us. For a moment, it seemed that its light was flashing. In the meantime, the orange light had already changed to a matte or opaque white, and at its side, about 20 meters away, another identical point of light appeared". RADIO TRANSMISSION CAPTURED We were all in that natural euphoria and extremely agitated, with that dazzling spectacle that we had just witnessed, that we even forgot to set up the telescope, with which we could have better identified that light source. But, I'm not sure why, I came up with the idea of ​​trying to communicate over the radio with those intelligences that would certainly be maneuvering that light projection. And so we did. Followed by the other two in the group, we started by speaking more or less in this way: "Attention! If you really are astronauts from another planet who are here, try to give us an affirmative sign. We are here on a peace mission and we would like to contact you personally". More than once, we repeated this without getting any answer. But, when fellow W.S.S., spoke to him more or less in these words: "Gentlemen astronauts, brothers from another planet, please, so that we are sure that you are there and it is not an illusion of ours, erase the lights, please ... turn off the lights ..." And at that very moment, we saw ourselves with the most vivid emotion, when those two points of white light were completely extinguished, extinguishing from top to bottom, giving us the understanding that whoever was there had picked up the radio broadcast. Through the binoculars, I could see that at the point where the first luminous spot was located, there was only a tiny ball of red light, not perceived by the naked eye. The reaction among the group was soon noticed. Some of the companions, perhaps because of their little knowledge of these facts, they were very nervous and quite agitated, with the intention of showing their desire to return immediately to the city, alleging problems with the car. Therefore, as the coordinator of the group, I suggested that we waited just a few more minutes, to see if they would move towards where we were and, as it did not happen, we all started to come back to Pelotas, where we arrived at 21:00. It is also worth adding the following: after that extraordinary light projection, we began to observe other points of white light, such as flashlights, over the bush to our left, to our rear, and also towards the right. A very interesting fact: during the initial projection of that red and orange light, when we were still more distant, we heard over the intercom radio that we carried, as if there were several people speaking in Spanish, similar to the transmission of radio amateurs. However, we were so excited to observe the light phenomenon, that we did not remember to try to find out what they were talking about and where the transmission came from. Still one more detail: the companion P.L.M.C., when the extraordinary red and orange light appeared, he took 3 photos with a film of 125 w., but, unfortunately, after developed, it was found that, in the film, he captured nothing, perhaps due to the little sensitivity of the film, which was a shame. name: A tractor driver reported strange beings around him in PELOTAS-RS [1976]
description: Pelotas, RS, April 18, 1976. In a letter addressed to the Ministry of Aeronautics, the president of a UFO research group in the city of Pelotas, State of Rio Grande do Sul, [Pelotense Society for Investigation and Research of Flying Saucers] reports a close encounter of a tractor driver with humans unidentified. TRANSLATION [...] "About, the phenomena observed at Fazenda Triângulo Azul", in Capão do Leão, City of Pelotas, we have been there for the last 3 months, and in one of those days we could still see the repetition of the luminous phenomena. On that occasion, a tractor driver from the farm told us the following: he and another companion - on a Saturday afternoon, when they were plowing the land in a property, they saw 3 strange beings appear around the tractor, through a kind of fog, sometimes they disappeared and appeared at different points, but always close to the tractor, watching the work that was being done. The tractor driver told us that those curious figures represented him as "a saint in a light blue dress", although they could not observe their features and body details. We have and complete testimony of this case, including a recording. [...] /L. R. REAL - President of Sociedade Pelotense de Investigação e Pesquisa de Discos Voadores ./" Cf. name: "They had a red light, very beautiful" - in Pelotas-RS, people spotted several UFOs [1976]
description: SEPT 16th, 1976. Reported by Mr. Luiz do Rosário Real, from Pelotas-RS, in a letter to the Ministry of Aeronautics, in Brasília-DF. "16 SEPTEMBER 1976. PELOTAS - RIO GRANDE DO SUL. At approximately 01:00 am, Mrs. L.G.R. saw two strange luminous objects with the shape of a star, white light, high altitude, which followed one after the other, very fast, in the east-west direction, towards Laranjal. [Later that day] At 10:30 pm, mr. R. F., 30, married, Ciretran employee from Pelotas, observed the passage of 6 UFOs over Balneário Sto. Antônio, in Laranjal, near his residence. He said he was very surprised to see the strange moving objects, just 15 meters from the ground, lined up, 50 meters apart. They were round in shape, approximately 50 cm in diameter, and made a slight "hiss". They had a red light, very beautiful, different from the conventional red. Trajectory; they went from Northwest to Southeast, towards Lagoa dos Patos, where they later disappeared. NOTE: Due to the size observed, we assume that they would be [remotely] "guided". Mr. R. F. was interviewed by us the next day, and he was still visibly impressed with what he saw. He informed that at the moment he saw the objects, he even sat on the floor to better observe them. He could not see details of them, due to the strong light which emanated from them. The fact was made public a few minutes later, by Radio Cultura of Pelotas, thanks to a call received from a neighbor of Mr. R. F." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: "A beautiful and very rare spectacle" - ATCs and a FAB pilot spotted a UFO near Vitória-ES [1977]
description: DEC 16th, 1977 . At 20:00, near the region of Vitória, State of Espírito Santo, the FAB C-95 2162 plane reported an unidentified flying object sighted about 20 NM and 20,000 ft from Vitória -ES. Translation of "Transcription of occurrence in Mission Order Report - Device not identified". "Salvador, December 23, 1977. From : Commander of the Air Base of Salvador-BAHIA. To: Mr. Commander of COMCOS. Subject: Transcription of Occurrence in Mission Order Report I - This Command transcribes the Occurrence of Mission Order n. 065, of 14 Dec 77, aircraft C-95 2162, / ADM Mission, bound for Rio de Janeiro / Porto Alegre, for knowledge and measures deemed necessary by Your Excellency: OPERATIONS At approximately 20:00 on December 16th, 1977 , when returning to Salvador, on the occasion of establishing contact / radio with Vitória for position message "Itapemirim" (entrance / terminal VT), we were informed by the controller in Vitória that there was a unidentified flying object , approximately 20 miles from the vertical VT and 20,000 feet of altitude (information given perhaps by a BOEING plane). The strange device , according to the information from the controller, who was observing it with binoculars with seven more people, had characteristics similar to a "Mother Ship" and was surrounded by smaller ones that were around it and curved 180 degrees, while the largest ship remained almost stationary, with varying brightness and size . The larger ship, according to the informant, sometimes had a slight tail and was a beautiful and very rare spectacle. He also informed that he called Brasília Center to try to establish radar contact. As for the crew of our plane , it was only possible to see a huge ball, the color of the stars, but much larger, which increased and decreased in size and brightness . ANV's visibility was limited due to sparse clouds that did not allow regular observation of the phenomenon. Upon leaving the terminal, we were informed that the object had begun to move slowly towards the vertical of Vitória. Ass: / CAP AV - N. - CMT DA ANV. " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: Pilots and controllers reported a strong light UFO between Bauru and Campinas [1978]
description: DEC 6th, 1978 . Time: 06:57. Duration: 25 minutes. Translation of the report: "Brasília, December 7th, 1978. "For future references regarding the event that occurred on December 06th, involving a UFO, this is what the air traffic controller CTA P..L.M. [radar approved, category A / 1] reports: Control Units and Centers involved - TWR SBSP, TWR SBKP, TWR SBBU [Control Towers of: São Paulo /Campinas-SP/Bauru-SP], APP SBSP [Approach Control - São Paulo Airport] and ACC SBBR [Control Center of Brasília-DF Airport]. Aircrafts involved - PT SBD and PT SBJ from TAM (both from SBKP to SBBU, respectively at flight levels 060 and 080 - separation of both 20 longitudinal miles). * SBKP - Airpor of Campinas-SP; SBBU - Airport of Bauru-SP*. Observation duration: approximately 25 minutes (with no actual radar contact with the object). 1. Around 06:57Z via telephone, the TWR from SBKP asked us about any radar contact of object warned by them; according to those operators, the object was of great luminosity and moved quickly in several directions. Negative answer by the ACC SBBR. 2. In a short period of time from the previous call, the TWR of SBSP also called us via telephone, asking us about an object, with the same characteristics, immediately following the question from the APP SBSP that also did not receive anything on the radar abnormal. 3. The PT SBD aircraft, first at takeoff, after activating a transponder, asked us if we were aware of other traffic on the same SBKP radial in a higher FL [level]. He had been informed of traffic by PT SBJ, which had not released the São Paulo TMA and was in QSO with APP. (the question was very strange to us, since the two aircrafts involved belonged to the same company and they fly regularly at the same time and stretch, so the commander should have knowledge of the other). 4. Around 07:10Z, PT SBJ called us freeing the TMA, informing us that there was something luminous following him since his SBKP takeoff, initially on the left and, soon after, on the right of his aircraft. We ask you to activate the transponder. ACC SBBR negative response after identification. 5. In the meantime, we request, via telephone to verify someone on duty in the video recording room, once we have tested over the telephone without contestation. The technician told us he would check. We told him that if he did, [he should also have to] alert the video recording operator to be ready for any request from us. 6. At approximately 07:20Z, PT SBD, entering the SBBU TMA, asked us to start the descent and then to call Bauru radio for descent. He informed us that the object had the ability to accelerate and decelerate in a very short time . We ask, taking advantage of the opportunity, to send us a part and / or report of the incident, addressing CISDACTA. 7. We alert the TWR of SBBU to observe anything strange coming from Campinas (RD300), that is, in the direction of 120 degrees. 8. PT SBJ, after a few minutes after contacting us, the commander seemed to us to be somewhat nervous, and we had the idea to ​​inform him that these objects are frequently seen by many other aircraft without, however, having heard of any interference with their navigation or equipment. 9. This same aircraft returning us, informed that in addition to the luminosity there was a " traffic " in the three-hours position, passing below the said luminosity. According to the pilot, it seemed like an aircraft to the reaction. (NOTE: ACC SBBR was not aware of any aircraft to the reaction in that sector, and, we reiterate that we had no primary return or transponder response from any aircraft, obviously excluding these two traffic.) 10. Approaching the SBBU TMA, he asked us to start the descent. After authorization to enter QSO with radio Bauru, he told us he still had the light on his right and much closer. At this point the message was interrupted and we then lost the QSO. 11. We call Bauru again, who informed us that he saw on the left of the aircraft something luminous looking like a different star, very close to traffic. 12. We want to emphasize, at the present time, that at no time did the pilots report any difficulty in navigating, landing, also without difficulties. We inform that although we did not obtain an effective radar contact of the probable objects reported, we noticed the beginning of tracking, however very quickly. [If these are characterized by an empty circle) there is naturally no conviction on our part that this was some sort of meteorological formation. We base our services in order to check as much information as possible according to previous instructions. / PLLM - CTA ." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: THE LEGNAIOLI CASE: report and interview. São Paulo-SP [1978]
description: Translation. Access the case file ARX.0.0.182 to see more about this case. "THE LEGNAIOLI CASE - INVESTIGATION" "The event took place on JULY 3rd, 1978, at 17:45 pm, at Rua Padre Bernardino Bandeira, Penha neighborhood - São Paulo-SP. Next to the LEGNAIOLI family residence, there is a property with approximately 12 X 40 meters, in this land there is a small building and some small trees. On that date, Mr. Odirlei Legnaioli and his son DALTON were in the kitchen of that house; at that time the boy left the kitchen to look at something outside and his dog followed him. The house is above the street level, as well as the land mentioned above. When DALTON approached the street, he saw a metallic part that showed itself from a point in the space of the neighboring terrain. He immediately thought it was a helicopter, but when he put himself in a better position he claimed to have seen a device with the following description: Format Two overlapping plates facing each other with two elevations, one at the top and one at the bottom and located in the center of it. It appeared to have a metallic surface, without portholes, visible hatches and joints. At the top there was a "hook" device. At the bottom and below, an elevation were three apparently transparent spheres revolved around themselves and emitted yellow, red and blue lights. The device was about 10 meters in diameter, and appeared to be static and suspended in the air about 02 meters from the ground. At the bottom there was a movement in the spheres that seemed to rotate and with lights already mentioned and did not emit noise. The boy froze and his dog started to bark, according to DALTON. From the upper part of the object, where there was the device in the form of a "hook", a thin beam of light came out and hit the animal. This light took over the animal's body and enveloped it and immediately the animal stopped barking and started to move away from the place. DALTON states that the outline of the animal's body was "engraved" in the light. Then in the bottom, where the spheres were, there was a flash that emitted a lilac color followed by other nuances. He felt a "breath of hot air" and said that his shirt and hair were with static. At that moment, according to DALTON, he heard a vehicle stop suddenly in the street below his house. After that supposed UFO "vehicle" took off, and then left. He was still enveloped by the light that then ceased. His impulse at that moment was to flee. Mr Odirlei Legnaioli - who was inside the residence, noticed that the animal entered the kitchen and looked frightened. Then he also heard a brake then enter the DALTON who looked in shock. Mr. Odirlei thought that DALTON had suffered a fall, but due to the boy's condition and according to his gestures (he couldn't speak) he ran down the hall to the outside. He stated that he could see the object moving in the sky (he was not able to specify the distance and height) that emitted an orange light. He also said that the street lamps had suffered interference and that they were reddish. Mr Odilei was surprised that at that moment the street, which normally has a good number of people passing by, was deserted. After hearing the report from his son, he made an inspection on the neighboring ground having informed that there was no trace of any "landing". Data obtained in the interview: - Mr Odilei, were you on the terrain afterwards and the next day? Are there marks, signs of burnt vegetation, or anything else that - it seemed abnormal? - I was, after what happened with a beacon - and even the next day doing an investigation on the spot. I didn't find any sign of marks, burnt grass tip, even in the bushes, there was nothing. - Did you notice anything different with DILTON's behavior? Did you take him to have a medical exam? - Of course the boy was scared, traumatized. I examined his body, but there were no stains and no other physical signs. - You said that when he went out to check what was happening, he saw an orange light that was moving away in the sky and that the street lights were red. During the time that the suit was with DALTON, were you inside the house? Were the lights and TV working? Was there any interference with them? - Yes, the TV was on and the lights too. The object was less than two meters from the wall and nothing happened inside, neither with the lights nor with the television. - Besides you, were there any more witnesses? - As I said, the street was deserted, which is strange, because here there is always movement of people or vehicles. I don't know if there is anyone else. Regarding the braking sound we heard; the person must have entered Rua Jiqueira Silva for Bernardino Bandeira and came across the object, and with the fright he must have stopped the car that way. Mr. Odilei Legnaioli is a Sergeant at PMESP, and at first glance he seemed very aware of the problem. The boy DALTON despite his 11 years of age is a smart boy and easy to communicate. The interview took place on 09/16/78 starting at 19:00 pm and lasted until dawn on 09/17.78." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). name: Two pilots in two different flights reported the same UFO over Governador Valadares-MG [1979]
description: November 29, 1979 . Time: 11:20pm. Duration: 6 minutes. When maneuvering his aircraft over the region between the cities of Governador Valadares and Belorizonte, in the State of Minas Gerais, at about 31,000 ft of altitude, the QD 555 pilot spotted an unidentified flying object in its "1-hour" position . At the same time, the pilot of another aircraft, the VP 377 at about 50 NM from Piraí at 24,000 ft, confirms the information from the QD-555. According to the QD-555 pilot, the UFO changed color. From red, to orange, white, and it had already changed his altitude. When already 30 NM from Belo Horizonte-MG, the pilot of the QD-555 continued to see the object in the "1-hour" position, this time, with less altitude. The other aircraft, the VP 377, when closer to Piraí, still at altitude 24.000ft, continued to confirm the information of the QD-555, seeing this time the UFO in its "2-hour" position. The VC 377 pilot reported that the UFO performed acrobatic maneuvers, changing altitude and color many times. At 11:26pm, the QD-555 pilot reported that the UFO had disappeared. Cf. name: A policeman near Itirapina-SP spotted  ‘6 groups of UFOs' over Broá dam [1978]
description: October 18, 1978 UFO sighting report according to a letter sent by the General Commander of the Military Police of São Paulo to the Commander of the Pirassununga Air Force Academy, about "foreign objects". "[...] appearance of strange objects that flew near "Praia do Broá", near Km 214 / 300 of SP-310 highway (Washington Luiz). A sergeant from the M.P. in the city of Piracicaba-SP, on October 18, 1978 , at 8:00 pm, reported having seen, "in the vicinity of the dam named "Broa", 4 (four) groups of illuminated and strange objects, followed by another 2 (two), in landing operations ". According to the reporting witness, other people observed the ‘spaceships'. The sighting location was Km 214 of the SP-310 highway. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: A night of UFO sightings, panic and misteries at Sítio do Gama-DF [1978]
description: Translation of 4 reports by a group of military men on duty at Sítio do Gama-DF, one of the main Flight Protection Departments [DPV-Telecommunication] in Brazil. The reports inform the unusual activity on June 20th, 1978 on the site, when an unidentified flying object was reported. "Sixth Regional Air Command - Information Section. Brasília-DF, on October 17, 1978. Occurrence Report. Classification: Confidential. Subject: UFO (Unidentified Flying Objects) Time: 20:30 hours. Location: Detection of Flight Protection, Detection and Telecommunications (DPV-DT / 61) - Sítio do Gama-DF. Description: On this day, a luminous object was observed flying over the Detachment, causing panic in those who were there." Following are statements by the military and civilians who observed the object: Report of the Commander of the Guard at Sítio do Gama-DF, from 20 to 21 June 1978. "The referred operation was carried out at Sítio, when at 20:30 a UFO appeared in activity near the THF with diffuse and variable luminosities, presenting various forms that accompanied the intensity of its luminosity, sometimes it seemed to be stopped. It could be noted that its speed was immense and that it changed course very easily and disappeared very quickly. When the commander of the guard was asked, and arrived at the THF station, he noticed that the object seemed to take off without being able to see it more clearly due to the variability of lights it presented and flashed, as if they were aircraft navigation lights. Another thing is that there was no noise. The main reason for the operation to be carried out with nine soldiers and all of them being eyewitnesses to the fact, is also that when the presence of the object was noticed, the THF Station was followed by a ‘rain' of stones and the Sgt. that was at the Station noticed that there were strangers present without seeing them, and he tried to protect himself. When reinforcement arrived, the Sgt of the ‘Estação' fired several shots, obtaining answers with stones. The commander of the guard Sgt. F., together with some soldiers, made his way around the whole Site, without noticing any strange presence. The fact was reported to the Air Defense, which did not notice anything on their radars, although the object passed in the vicinity of the LP-23. DPV-DT 61 officers were also eyewitnesses to the fact, as were some of the guards who actively participated in the operation. F.L. 3S QDT MT / CMT GUARD /. " Report of the 2nd Lieutenant ESP. MET. P.A.M.F "At around 23:00 on June 20th, 1978, Lieutenant V. called my residence to inform me that something serious was going on at Sítio do Gama and that I had to get ready to go there with him, and armed. I prepared myself immediately and waited for him under the building, when then, after picking me up, we headed there. There we arrived, we contacted Sgt F.L., Commander of the Guard who informed us about strange occurrences that had been happening since about 20:30, occurrences that were mainly stones that were thrown into the THF building, and an unidentified flying object that flew over the THF and the microwave at low altitude, in addition to whistles and an attempt to force the THF gate. Facts that were confirmed by the people already in the THF, mainly Sgt. O., SD. P. and the security guard S. who was also there. Around 23:55, I looked in all directions of the sky, looking for possible objects never seen before, and I noticed that a more intense light, similar to a star, shone towards the antennas of the Microwave calling the attention of the others who were with me in the THF, including Lieutenants V. and C. Regarding this light we found that it increased in intensity, moved with a certain speed, and had an aspect of a great searchlight, similar to those in airplanes which are used for landings. My attention was drawn to the fact that there was no noise despite being in a silent enviroment; also the fact that such an object had an apparently irregular trajectory, that is, it first made a semi-circle and then took a straight trajectory, and then I noticed that there was a headlight in the front and another in the rear of the object, with a red light in the middle, a light that flashed. When this object was disappearing, a second object appeared and disappeared more quickly than the first. I calculated the distance of the first object, in its closest proximity to Sítio do Gama, in about 5 km. The same object, when in profile for us, looked like a "cigar" , similar to airplanes. Brasília, 06/21/78. P.A.M.F. 1TEN ESP. MET./ " Report of the 3S QAT O. J.M.P . "Brasília, June 21st, 1978. When returning from dinner, I was warned by security guard S., that when I was at the ranch, he had heard a noise that he could not identify. Upon entering the Station, I closed the fence gate. After about 20 minutes, I heard a noise, and I identified it as the door lock being opened, because it is a little dented, working very tightly, a fact that causes the noise when opening it. I waited to see if it was someone belonging to the DPV-T staff, what did not happen. I turned off the lights of the Station and, together with the security guard S., I placed myself near the main door, and heard noises in the fence again. In order to hear better, I turned off the station's main switch, and heard a whistle. Putting the facts together, I decided to order the Sgt of the Day, 3rd Sgt F.L. asking him to come to the place. When he arrived on the scene, the 3rd Sgt F.L. together with 4 soldiers saw a luminous object in the vicinity, and below the height of the ISB Antenna for São Roque. As they approached, the object that was standing in the air began to move until it was out of sight. As a reinforcement at the Station, Mr. P., who listened together with me and the vigilante S., heard a noise that we identified as a stone thrown on the roof of the Station. I called Lieutenant P. who authorized me to use a rifle and machine gun. There was no response to my shots. I went up to the roof of the Station with the security guard S. and looking up I could see shadows moving in the bush, around the Station. Corporal P. shot in the direction indicated by me and received a stone that hit the THF wall and almost fell on his head. After the facts were reported, the Detachment Officers came and saw the object hovering in the air, and, soon after, it also disappeared. In time: the object had several lights which I was not able to tell the shape. / 3S QAT O. J.M.P /. " Report by the Head of the Security Section of Sítio do Gama-DF "I was warned at about 22:30 by Sgt. O., that was on duty at the THF Station on June 20, 1978, of the presence of an object that later I could not identify due to its elongated shape, its strong light, light that radiated to all sides, at a low height , close to the Station, with constant and sparse appearances . He also informed that everyone was inside the Detachment almost panicked by the appearance of the object. I determined that all posts had to be reinforced by the Sergeant of the Day, with the people that were inside the Department, also to maintain telephone contacts between the service posts for the security control of the internal area, as well as contact with the Air Defense to verify on your radars the previously recommended targets. After such measures, I was also warned that probably the sentinels at the post had seen suspicious movements in the vicinity and stone throws on the Station. As there is no lighting in the place that allows the presence of foreign elements to be clearly detected. I ordered the execution of HK33 automatic rifle shots into the air, so that these camouflaged targets could make themselves seen, which was done without success, allowing us to conclude that, if they existed, they were not inside the Detachment. After all the telephone contacts, I went to the Department by my own means, in order to obtain a better study of the situation. Along with the other officers, I could see the luminous object appearing in the firmament and [the object] approaching with enormous speed for an aircraft within the system's airspace. It presented itself as a star of clear and strong light that radiated in all directions with movements determined by a straight line and soon afterwards a break of direction and a change of color in its light, for the most diverse shades. Contacts were made with the Control Tower to check flights in the area, but only one aircraft had landed at the airport at the time of the event. Analysing the situation, I ordered the posts to remain on alert until this command find it is convenient. / Head of Security Section / " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: A pilot and an air traffic controller reported a UFO near Curitiba-PR [1978]
description: September 8th, 1978 . Time: 23: 30Z. The pilot of the PT-JKQ aircraft flying on the Belo Horizonte-MG to Curitiba-PR route, reported to the Air Traffic Control of Brasília-DF, that he was "seeing a very intense light with color variations, in the position '01-hour ‘, 2NM, appearing to be between 8,000 and 10,000ft with reference to his traffic". At 00:10Z, the air traffic monitoring of PT-JKQ was already under the jurisdiction of Curitiba Control, to carry out the descent and landing procedures. At that time, a TWR operator in Curitiba stated that he "was also seeing a luminous object in the west sector of the aerodrome (Radial 280) and that it gave him the impression of varying its position and luminous intensity". Contacts were made with another aircraft flying in the region, the VASP VP151C flying from São Paulo-SP to Porto Alegre-RS, and the pilot of this aircraft stated that he was viewing only "the planet Venus" at that sector and time. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: Two pilots reported UFO sightings on the same route near Brasília-DF [1978]
description: AUG 23rd, 1978 . Time: 00: 40Z. Duration: 15 minutes. The pilot of the PT KPB aircraft reported "with a wealth of details, the UFO sighting between the Paracatu and Cristalina positions" [on the route from São Paulo-SP to Brasília-DF]. The "Radar LP-23 do Gama" also detected the phenomenon, and the same happened to another plane,the Transbrasil QD-460, about an hour earlier, passing through the same position, reporting the phenomenon seen by PT KPB. Below is the translation of the Flight Controllers' report from Brasília-DF Airport on the event that occurred on August 23, 1978. "When on duty on August 22rd, 1978, we were questioned by the Commander of QD-460 [Transbrasil aircraft], about the existence of traffic in the position, in relation to the clock, 9-hours. After our denial, he informed the traffic in the aforementioned position; when asked about the existence of such traffic, he again confirmed the existence of it and later reported that it had disappeared. This happened at 65NM outside Brasília. After being transferred to the APP, he returned to our frequency and asked us about the range of our radar, which at the time generated doubts about what he wanted, if it was the position he was in relation to the supposed traffic or whether it was actually within radar coverage. We inform him that it was 65NM. After the dialogue with that aircraft ceased, we initialized a target in the vicinity claimed and managed to place in direct control a target that had quality factor "6", with speeds that varied between 133 KT / 804 KT. At no time did altitude indication appear. In the absence of traffic, we tried to keep this target in direct control, awaiting the passage of another aircraft. Approximately 35 minutes later, the PT-KPB, coming from São Paulo bound for Brasília, when authorized to start descending, did not copy the message from that Center in a timely manner and when it did, it was to inquire about the existence of traffic in the position identical to that previously informed by QD-460. Reacting to our information about what Commander QD-460 had said, the Commander of PT-KPB informed us that: "I have an object view that is not consistent with those known, a shapeless mass, as if it were a halo, which sometimes remains at the same altitude and for others above the aircraft." Frequency 125.2 has been blocked by an unidentified carrier since the QD-460 reported the existence of the alleged traffic. The QD-460 was at F310, and PT-KPB at level 280, and both came from São Paulo, the first landed in Brasilia at 00:30 hours Z and the (2nd) second at 01:15 hours Z. /L.C.M. 3S QAT CV and F.M.L.P. - CTA" Cf. name: In Guará I-DF, a man spotted an oval UFO flying over Brasília-DF [1979]
description: Brasília, November 21st, 1979 . Time: 5:58 am. Duration: 15 seconds. A Post Office worker, living in Guará I, Distrito Federal, reported "the passage of an unidentified object" of oval shape and "silver color, as if it were made of stainless steel". According to the witness, the UFO "did not emit light because its color was quite defined by the blue contrast of the sky". Also according to the description, the UFO made no noise and was seen on a trajectory from Guará I until the Brasília Airport. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: Super-8 film of a UFO in Tatuapé-SP, [1978]
description: WATCH THE VIDEO BELOW: Translation of the reported case and delivery receipt : "Mr. V.B., a lawyer, resident at [...] n. [...], Tatuapé-SP-SP, which delivered, upon receipt, a KODAK Super 8mm color film, with a projection duration of approximately 4 minutes, stating that it was filmed from the street in front of the aforementioned residence by his brother P.A.B., 53 years sales manager. The footage is, according to Mr. V., of a strange object that hovered in the sky, at 02:30 am on December 30, 1978, and there may be a possibility of being a UFO. The machine used was a SUPER 8mm, with a Zoom lens with a magnification capacity of 8 times. The assignment of the film was made for research and is a copy, since the original is in the possession of Mr. P."

name: A letter from a civilian to the Min. of Aeronautics reporting a UFO sighting in Ceres-GO [1979]
description: Correspondence from a civilian sent to the Ministry of Aeronautics reporting UFO sighting and contact. Translation below: " On the night of February 26, 1979, Monday, around 23:45/00:00, I was on the balcony of Mr. D.L.'s residence [...], in Ceres (GO ), I looked towards the direction I suppose north or northeast, about 45 degrees from the horizon, and I noticed a blue-green light that moved towards the top, at a speed comparable to that of a modern aircraft. The object stopped, and returned the same way, back to the north-northeast, without turning. Then, it made very rapid evolutions, like a luminous insect. I called my wife who was inside the house and, looking, she, too, saw the light perfectly. Mr. D.L. and his wife also came to observe, and they saw. Now, with incredible speed, the object moved from bottom to top and vice versa, in front of the four observers, an incalculable distance to us, being certain that its size was more or less of a star - that, apparently - that is situated in a higher position, but it had a phosphorescent source that at times confused our view, which was tremulous. At one point, I moved my hand (I think the right, it doesn't matter), and the object followed my gesture, but in the opposite direction: if I moved my hand up, it would go down; and vice versa. I did the experiment dozens of times, at different speeds, slowly and suddenly, and the object went in reverse. Horizontally he did not "obey" my gestures, only in the vertical sense. There was great amazement from the three present, with my wife feeling sick. I remained alone on the balcony, continuing the experience, which seemed to be charming, as is understandable. Then my wife and the friendly couple returned, who were watching the phenomenon. The owner of the house, at my request, tried to gesture to the object, but received no reply, which came only when my initiative. The show lasted dozens of minutes - I could not calculate, and it was our intention to invite neighbors; but all the houses were closed at that time, and no one was passing by to enlarge the audience and reinforce the testimony. Mr. D.L., a university student in Anápolis (GO), took a flight course on civil aircraft and, better than I, can judge that these were not conventional ships. I was absolutely sober, I am not a mystic, I have read some bibliography on these phenomena and I have no intention of publicity. I omit other details of the episode, because it gives them a purely subjective character, but they have not nevertheless altered my impressions on the event after the unexplained demonstration ended. We left the place and went to a carnival ball, at Ceres Club, in this city, where I reported what I had seen to the Mayor and to a Judge, an Accountant, a lawyer, a Doctor and dozens of others, including Lieutenant R. C., who assists this city and its surroundings. When I left the club - where I couldn't drink any alcohol, I watched the sky until the BR-153 interchange, returning to the street of the residence that had served as a stage for all that, and then went home. I saw nothing else. My emotional shock worsened yesterday, when I recalled the phenomenon in cold blood, having decided to communicate what happened to Your Excellency, who will better say how to direct any possible research interest, to which I offer myself even under psychological and detection tests. A.C.M.M./CERES-GO/. " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: Photographs taken near the Paraguay River revealed 3 stationary UFOs [1980]
description: DEC, 12th, 1980. Assunção, Paraguai / and Paranaguá, State of Paraná, Brazil. A man sent photos taken by a friend [see photos of case in ARX.0.0.202] when they were on a tour in Paraguay, at a location about 12 km from the capital Asunción. According to the man's report, a resident of Paranaguá, State of Paraná, with his friend were waiting for a boat to take them to the indigenous territory of the Maku People and before going, they decided to gather people to take some pictures of the group. Some pictures were taken and when they were developed they noticed three unidentified flying objects. Later that day, already in Maku territory, and with other tourists, a person from this other group (an American gentleman) noticed "three unidentified flying objects flying in formation and equidistant", which according to the witness's report, "appeared in the skies with amazing speed and extraordinary precision of flight, plunging in a parable over the indigenous territory "of the Maku. According to the report, only this man had noticed the three ships static in that place and then moved, because the other people were distracted talking to each other. The same man stated that, before seeing the three UFOs, he had the impression of being observed. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: UFOs in Goiânia-Go were observed and detected by pilots and air traffic controllers [1980]
description: FEB 19th, 1980. Time: 19:00. An operator working for the Control Tower at the Airport of Goiânia, State of Goiás, reported that "he saw a light in his eastern sector" deciding to ask the ACC-BS [Brasilia-DF Approach Control Center] to investigate "if there was any traffic there to inform him". Responding to the question from the TWR-GO operator, the ACC-BS reported that there was no traffic there. Then, the operator "started to see two more lights in that same sector, close to the Goianápolis position". After this second sighting, the TWR-GO operator contacted the Tower of Anápolis-GO to inform its observations of the UFOs. After being warned, the TWR-AN operator contacted the Military Operations Center [COpM], which took over the situation by obtaining information "and concrete data on the occurrence". At that same moment, a VASP plane already in the process of landing at the Goiânia Airport, decided to abort the landing after the aircraft's co-pilot observed "an unidentified light crossing in the vicinity of the plane". At the Tower of Anápolis, one of the operators reported having observed about "three plots defined in his video [radar], in the position of Goiânia". In the meantime, after visual and radar confirmations, and after an incident with the VASP plane, COpM "activated its alert officer" who requested "the video recording of the area's radar coverage", and also informed CINDACTA and the CODA. This Center "authorized the activation of two combat teams, to be on alert in Anápolis, with the pilots placed in a "ready" position on two F-103 aircraft, already prepared for the alert". Another VASP 229 plane that had already taken off from Goiânia to São Paulo "reported seeing an unidentified light in its 4-hour position, and also in its flight level, and apparently following the aircraft. At that moment, VASP 229 was at FL 290, QDR 108 degrees from Goiânia, at a distance of 80 NM ". The TWR-GO operator, who first spotted and triggered other Centers, continued to spot the lights and follow the vertical, horizontal and random movements of the UFOs, confirming the position of one of the lights that VASP 229 saw. Finally, according to the report, after analyzing the evidence, reports and radar videos, it was decided that there was no reason to order the takeoff of planes to intercept the unidentified flying objects that night of February 19th, 1980 . Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: A FAB plane carried out an evasive maneuver to avoid collision with a UFO in Rio de Janeiro [1980]
description: A plane of the Brazilian Air Force, FAB C-115 2350, on August 26th, 1980, with 4 people on board, was flying between Santa Maria, State of Rio Grande do Sul and Rio de Janeiro-RJ, and when they were near São João do Meriti, State of Rio de Janeiro, the plane had to carry out an evasive maneuver to avoid collision with a UFO. Reports from the military on board the plane FAB C-115 2350. Translation: Colonel-Av F.B.M.M . "At 5:50 pm, on the 26th of August 1980, as a crew member of the C-115 2350, when leaving the "Caxias Position", at an altitude of 2.000ft, under VFR conditions, with "Meriti" and "Afonsos" heading, aligned on the same magnetic marking, I spotted the ILS Track 09 GL Plane Trajectory, that is, 3-hour high in relation to my aircraft, with an intense yellow light that I thought was, at first, the headlight of an airplane moving in that trajectory towards me. I informed Control RJ of this observation and received a reply that at that time there was no other aircraft in the vicinity of my plane. As the "light" increased in intensity and moved in Collision Course, I alerted Cap J. L. as he was like (1P), and that he had already observed and was following the displacement of the "light". Realizing the imminence of a collision, he made a quick evasive maneuver to the right and resumed the AF bow. After this maneuver, we no longer saw "light" or any silhouette of a flying object. To avoid further speculation, I commented to the crew that we should have suffered an optical phenomenon from the refraction of sunset light, in ice crystals suspended in the atmosphere, considering that in FL 090 we had flown for more than 3 hours from Santa Maria (RS), we had found ice formations. [...]" 1ST SARGEANT L.B.M "I, 1S QRT COMM L.B.M., serving in the 1st / 1st GTT, declare that at approximately 17:35P on 08/26/80, when we were returning from Santa Maria in the aircraft C-115 2350, with crew members Cel M. (2P ), Cap JL (1P), 1S M. (1RT), 3S C. (1MC), in the stretch Galeão / Afonsos I felt a sudden deviation of the aircraft to the right, commanded by the 1P, when it was flying at about 1,000 FT. The action immediately taken was to question the ACC RJ regarding the existence of any known traffic in the area, obtaining a negative statement. Later, it came to my attention that the "sudden deviation" was caused by the existence of a shiny and unidentified object, which was on a collision course. Larger details I am not able to provide, considering that in that moment I was in the cargo compartment placing the navigation material in the briefcase. Nothing more to declare. LBM -1S / Radio-Telegraphist at FAB 2350./ 3RD SARGEANT P.C.F. I, 3S Q ANV P.C.F. currently serving on the 1st / 1st CTT, I declare that on the 26th of August 1980, when I was returning from Santa Maria [RS] at the FAB 2350, I saw something around 17:35P, near the locality of São João de Meriti [RJ] [something] unidentified with a great beam of light as if it were a large aircraft making, perhaps, a correction for the long end of runway 09 of Galeão. I also observed an almost vertical trajectory described by the object, which at the moment seemed to be hovering in the vertical direction and with a tendency to approach, since we were practically on the same axis. Suddenly when the pilot tried to deviate from his route, the light went out, leaving no trace, that is, nothing visible. Nothing more to declare./PCF 3S-Mechanic of FAB 2350./ Cf. name: A Brazilian Navy Corvette spotted UFOs in the Amazon River, in Parintins-AM [1980]
description: MAY 5th, 1980 . In the region between Vila Amazônia and Parintins, in the State of Amazonas, when the Corveta of the Brazilian Navy CV Mearim "sailed the Amazon River, in the region of Parintins-AM, between 4:00 am and 4:15 am, some objects, that were not identified by the staff in the service room, were seen; they had a yellowish focus and despite being within range of the radar, they were not captured, being only seen visually by the service personnel at the time. These objects were standing on the water's surface, initially three images appeared, and as the Corvette approached, they moved, with the center one rising and the side ones disappearing in opposite directions. In the second appearance, only two objects were seen, both moving towards the city of PARINTINS at great speed. There were assumptions by the Corveta service personnel that it was an airplane or a helicopter, however the time was not right and, in addition, the devices did not make any noise. The figures [ see file ARX.0.0.212 ] show exactly how it happened. Complementary Data: "The figures [ see file ARX.0.0.212 ] indicate the unidentified luminous objects seen by the Corveta "Mearim". Such objects had shapes of yellow headlights that were on the water surface, between Vila Amazônia and Parintins" Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. Código de Referência BR DFANBSB ARX.0.0.211. “Informe sobre avistamento de objetos voadores não identificados na região de Parintins ”. name: A Control Tower Operator reported a UFO sighting in Florianópolis-SC [1982]
description: Transcription of UFO occurrence at TWR-FL [Airport Control Tower of Florianópolis-SC] on DEC 16th,1981. "At 00:35Z I received a call from a friend asking for information if there was a helicopter over the city, [and] I informed him that negative, since the last plane had taken off for SBPA [Porto Alegre Airport- RS] more than an hour ago. The same told me he was seeing an unidentified flying object, a UFO, which was moving from the vicinity of Clube Penhasco to the south, towards Morro do Cambirela. At the time of the information, I asked the 3S D. who was on duty to turn off the internal lights of the TWR and the civilian P. of Infraero to turn off the lights of the Patio lighting poles to have a good visibility and we confirmed that there really was a UFO "parked" at about 800 mts of altitude; the light was of a high-intensity silvery yellow color; using the binocular I found that it really was of high intensity and could not be confused with "stars" as it moved slowly in the SW direction, without any noise from conventional engines. I called the Day Officer Ten B. who was at the Base on duty in his office to have a look and he confirmed that he was seeing was not a "star". The UFO remained there for about 7 minutes and then disappeared behind the Cambirela hill. We were in expectation but it didn't show up anymore./ M.A. -1S Q AT CTA / Service Operator. " Cf. name: Pilots of the same air company and route reported the same UFO 3 days in a row near B.H.-MG [1982]
description: On February 8, 1982 , there was an intense communication between the ACC-BS [Area Control Center of Brasília-DF] and the VASP aircraft of flight VP169 to report and confirm unusual traffic in the vicinity of Belo Horizonte [30 miles to the south], State of Minas Gerais. Around 06:49Z, the VP169 triggered the ACC-BS asking: "Could you report if there is any traffic on your scope there at the nine-hours position of Vasp uno Meia nine?" The ACC-BS replied that it had not detected anything yet. The VP169 pilot then describes: "We are looking at one, apparently, an aircraft but the lighting changes systematically in color; it is orange, red, or white, apparently it looked like traffic with the lights on but as there is a very marked color variation we are even suspicious that it is something different". The ACC-BS then reinforces that it does not observe anything on the radar in the sector mentioned by VP169. At 07:11, VP169 informs that the unidentified air traffic signaling "is intense, very intense as if it were an aircraft with" auwarys "on, I would like Brasilia to verify this observation for data purposes possibly, ok?" At 07:18Z, the pilot of VP 169 was already seventy miles from Barra do Piraí, in the State of Rio de Janeiro, when he could still see the brightness in the 9-hours position in relation to his aircraft. At that moment the ACC-BS informs that it is "receiving a point from fifty miles south of Belo Horizonte-MG, a point exactly at the 9-hours position, following the exact impulse of VASP 196". Also according to the ACC-BS operator, the object with intense luminosity "precisely follows the VP 169". At the same time, another aircraft of flight QD 177 [Transbrasil], fifty miles from Barra do Piraí-RJ, informs the ACC-BS that "this luminosity that the VASP has been reporting we are observing; is in our 11-hours position, ok? The next day, February 9, 1982 , at 06:51Z, an aircraft on the same VP 169 route as the previous day, contacts the ACC-BS to ask if the ACC-BS was "receiving something, accusing something in our 9-hours position ", because the pilot was" seeing a light here, very strong intensity, we would like to approach". The pilot of the VP asks for authorization to approach the direction of the light in order to verify what it was. The ACC-BS says that possibly the intense light may be the city of Montes Claros-MG, nearby, but the pilot of the VP169 says that it cannot be, because the light he saw was very high. The VP169 is then allowed to check by approaching and with a bow in the direction facing the light well ahead of the aircraft from a distance. The VP169 then reports that its radar does not report anything in that sector and the aircraft returns to its original course, but continues to perceive small fluctuations in colors, sometimes settling in a light color. VP 169 approaches Belo Horizonte and descends. The next day, February 10, 1982 , at 06:44Z on the same bow with the same flight VP169, there is a pilot's communication to investigate the occurrence of unforeseen traffic in the vicinity of his route towards Belo Horizonte. VP 169 talks to the pilot of flight QD 035 of TRANSBRASIL about the existence of a light spotted by the two aircraft at a position of 10 degrees above the horizon near the city of Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: UFO sightings occurred from April to November [1982]
description: Sightings occurred in April, July, October and November - Translation of reports. April 21, 1982 "OCCURRENCES - At 23:38Z, the ACC officer informed us that SBKP [Campinas-SP Airport] had informed him that he was seeing a bright light , to the northeast of that location. Immediately I contacted SBKP via telephone. The operator, the civilian FIOR, informed me that he saw a strong light , which was moving quickly, with no identification possible. There was a primary runway on the radar in the position indicated by Campinas (AZ 030/10 MN from SBKP), but it looked more like a meteorological formation, as it was now in the East, now in the West, varying from 34KT to 80KT, remaining so several hours. Several aircraft passed this position while this primary runway was still on, and reported nothing. The on-call officer was warned. " July 17, 1982 "At 02:40Z, 3S O. was answered by 3S E. on extension 174 whose call asked for a plot to be checked on the radar (Brasília coverage) in the Northwest sector of Brasília, nearby. Based on this position, a certain primary chain was started, the only one in the immediate vicinity, and in possession of the open telephone line, the positions were checked: The 3S O., being at SQN 113, informed the variations of heading, altitude and speed of traffic that seconds later, I, the 3S E., compared on the radar except the altitude, which, according to him, was approximately 30,000 feet and on the radar did not contain the altimetric information. At 02: 44Z, 3S P., Technical Supervisor, was asked to make the video recording starting at 02: 52Z. On alert, Ten A. became aware soon afterwards and would be informed later if the traffic became hostile. Initially, the position was azimuth 329 distance 35 miles from the range. After 343/30 position such that the 3S Osvaldo lost sight of the fact that the traffic disappeared behind the buildings. Shortly after the VP SNC, it took off from Brasília to Manaus and, informed of the traffic by the 3S C. of the APP, accused the visual saying that it seemed to be an aircraft at approximately level 20 0. (Except that having passed the traffic was in the same position ). The RG 810 (Galeão / Miami) passed in the sector of (3) three hours of traffic, at one (01) mile, at 03: 48Z, but nothing was seen for not having been informed, and the 3S O. informed the exact moment of that aircraft passing through the traffic. At 01:22, the traffic motive recording with permanent position and low variable speed (13, 22, 167, 200, 22, 13 Kt) was canceled. Loss of contact at 04: 36Z. Replenishment at 04: 42Z and final loss at 06: 41Z. " October 2 and 3, 1982 "It was also observed on the SP coverage, a track with VOLEX III radar altimetry at level 807, with a speed of 0.2 Mach, varying up to 0.7 Mach, also varying in altitude up to level 504, remaining for (01:35) a hour and thirty-five minutes with the permanence of quality factor 6 in the evolution of prows on the 155 to 52 NM radial of Bauru. " November 2, 1982 "At 22:20Z, TWR GO sent us informing that it was in VFR contact with a PVNI moving in the southeastern course approaching SBGO [Goiás Airpot], high with a medium intensity brightness of yellowish color , (there was video recording from 22:23Z, with the activation of the Ten A., on warning) After three minutes (03) the TWR of Brasília called us and they were watching a UFO, varying between radials 180 and 165 and it seemed to have a rounded shape . of the ACC to ask RG 401 that was taking off from Brasilia to do a visual search in the referred sector and nothing was seen Anápolis also saw the UFO in RD 180 approximately 10 Nm. VP 253 who was in the sector was asked to make a search , seeing nothing. After a period of (01h27m) an hour and twenty-seven minutes of observation and nothing more being seen. At 2350Z the SBGO radar recording was finished. " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: Several UFOs reported by 4 cities in São Paulo in the same night [1982]
description: MARCH 6th, 1982 . Time: 9:15 pm. A military policeman from the city of Marília, State of São Paulo, communicated via telegram to CINDACTA that at 9:15 pm on March 6, 1982 that unidentified flying objects had been observed in the cities of Presidente Prudente, Regente Feijó, Rancharia, and finally in the city of Marília, all in São Paulo state. According to the reporting witness, the UFOs moved quickly, emitting beams of light, without making any noise. After flying over the first three cities mentioned above, the UFOs moved towards Marília, having been observed by several military policemen in all of the cities mentioned. Cf. name: A round UFO was spotted at Anápolis-GO Air Base by its military personnel [1982]
description: Report issued on April 19, 1982, by the Sixth Regional Air Command. Translation below: "On March 23, 1982 , at about 11:00 am, when the P-103 aircraft was carrying out evolutions on the ANÁPOLIS AIRBASE aerodrome, a UFO was observed by several military personnel of that OM. The object, which could be seen with the naked eye, had a circular shape and was white in color, tending to silver. Through binoculars its shape was the same, but brighter, and the color was sometimes reddish. It was initially seen almost vertically from the Aerodrome, moving in an estimated 280 degrees. The altitude has not been determined. Although the CINDACTA Military Operations Center (COpM) has not been able to reach radar, the alert aircraft that triggered a visual search to the FL 500 was triggered, without success. " Attached report : 1 - Initial observation: The object was seen on 23 Mar 82, at approximately 11:00 am, at the time when an F-103 aircraft was performing "loops" over the aerodrome (thus marking Cap Av ELIZEU's 1,000 hours of fighter flights). The acrobatics of the aircraft drew everyone's attention upwards. 2 - Description of the object: With the naked eye (it was possible to see it that way), the object had a circular (apparently spherical) shape, white in color, tending to silver. Seen with binoculars, the shape was the same, but brighter, sometimes appearing red, with a tendency to gold. 3 - Geographic position: It was initially seen almost over the Aerodrome (heading 300 degrees, approximately 10 miles). It moved subtly, having been perceived up to 270 °. Quite high, it was not possible to estimate the height. 4 - Observers: The curiosity of some made the majority of people at the Anápolis Air Base see the object, including the author of this document. 5 - Measures taken: As determined by Mr. Cmt of the Anápolis Air Base, the following measures were taken: a) Research with the SRPV-6 to find out whether or not balloons, probes, artificial satellites, etc, [were around that area] b) Telephone contact with COPM to learn about the efficiency of radar contact. Both measures did not bring concrete results. c) Taking advantage of the situation (it would not be otherwise) the COPM requested (certainly with the participation of CODA) the activation of the alert aircraft in order to identify the object, which was done until the FL 500, without success . ZNM - Cap Av / Head of the Air Operations Center ". Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. Código de Referência BR DFANBSB ARX.0.0.221. “Informe acompanhado de relatório sobre avistamento de objeto voador não identificado sobre a Base Aérea de Anápolis, Estado de Goiás ”. name: Two FAB pilots reported close eye contact with a UFO in the Uberlândia-MG region [1982]
description: Translation of FAB Pilots 1 and 2 reports. FAB Pilot 2 Report: "At 00:45P on the 17th of June 82 , we were doing the Porto Alegre / Brasília flight with VS of 420 KT. We were passing the vertical of UBERLÂNDIA at level 370 and maintaining the radial 200 degrees of Brasília. Flying as 2P, I observed on our left side, slightly higher, a ball of light that was approaching, I warned the 1P, we darkened the nacelle to observe better and the object that initially looked like one, [and] while passing besides us, it splited itself into 6 pieces. We called the mechanic to come to the cabin and observe it. We were able to observe the object (s) for approximately 01 minute. Its trajectory was more or less parallel to ours and horizontally. It disappeared from our vision just ahead of us slightly to the left of Brasilia. The fact was observed as reported by three more aircraft that were flying at the same time coming to Brasilia. / Brasília-DF, June 1, 1982./C.P. Feijó - Cap AV." FAB Pilot 1 Report : "At 00: 45 on 17th of June 82 , during the journey from Porto Alegre to Brasília, we observed an UFO, whose phenomenon we now describe: "Passing the vertical of Uberlândia at level 370, our HS-125 aircraft was at a speed of 420 Kt, radial 200° to Brasilia, approximately 170 miles away, when 2P suddenly called our attention to observe an object of great luminosity shifting. The first sensation was of an aircraft on fire and then came the idea of ​​a COMET, because the object had a huge incandescent tail and of great luminosity. There was enough time for us to darken the nacelle and call the mechanic so that the entire crew could observe. The object was seen for the first time through the First Pilot's DV window, at approximately high at 10-hours position, apparently FL 430. After being seen through the windshield, it began to fragment, dividing itself into six bright spots, which were fading, one by one. The phenomenon lasted approximately 01 minute, its displacement was from southwest to northeast, more or less towards 030 degrees parallel to the horizon line. The fact was observed by three more aircrafts flying at the same time, who informed the Brasília Center that they were observing this phenomenon and inquired about it, while the Brasília Center replied that nothing had been observed by the radars. VC Son / Cp AV." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: Several UFO sightings and radar detections 2 weeks in a row in Anápolis-GO [1982]
description: The following reports describe several UFO sightings and radar detections 2 weeks in a row in Anápolis-GO [1982] at the ANÁPOLIS Air Base between 28 APRIL and 16 MAY 1982. First report: April 28, 1982. Time: 22:25. At 22:25 on April 28, 1982 , the Approach Control of Anápolis-GO, visualized "in the scope of the TA-10, several moving targets, between the radial 080/110 degrees, all with heading approximately 290 degrees". According to the report, "due to the speed, it gave the impression of being a squadron of helicopters", heading towards the Anápolis Air Base. A FAB plane [15 F-34] that was on a mission at that time was activated to "check what was causing the radar detection" [..] on the 235 degree radial, at 8NM from Anápolis. "Another aircraft, the JG NG "was transferred to TABA, being vectored by this Control over the radar contacts". After "several attempts, the JG NG 2 spotted one of the targets and, when approaching, the alleged object turned off the lights, causing the loss of visual contact ". After the aircraft landed, the pilots went to see the object sighted on TABA's radar and found" a very large target of something unidentified ". Complementary data : "The targets continued to appear on the aforementioned radials, and to disappear between the radials 260/290 degrees, at 14NM: some radar contact information cited by TABA, coincided with the COpM radar detections (11-23), and, due to these coincidences, the COpM "requested that, when the JG AM took off, for the 15F34 mission, a verification of these contacts be carried out under TABA vectoring. TABA informed that the JG [..] that took off at 23:40, obtained Radar contact during 02 (two) scans with a target in the position informed by TABA, without, however, obtaining visual. COpM requested that the video be recorded for the period in which all of this unfolded, and later found that the video recorded was from São Paulo coverage. " Second report: April 29, 1982 On April 29, 1982, at 22:15, the Military Operations Center [COpM] recorded on its radar that "something" was moving within the South and Southeast sector of Anápolis, "on the 210 degree radial, at 18NM from Anápolis-GO. According to the report, the detection lasted 2 hours and 15 minutes. The TABA of Anápolis, which had not detected the first apparition, "informed that it was obtaining radar contact in its radial 270 degrees, at 15NM". according to the report, there was a “third radar contact that was accused by TABA in its 060 degree radial, at 12NM and that the COpM also obtained.” An aircraft that performed interception training on the FL300 was asked to verify the fact, but the pilot of this one saw nothing in the indicated sector. Third report: April 30, 1982 On April 30, 1982 , at 22:47, when TABA of Anápolis reported that it was detecting a "radar contact" that was dangerously "on a collision course with FAB 2305 that was on the final approach to runway 06, at 10NM of the headboard". Initially, the COpM radar did not detect the contact reported by Anápolis, but afterwards it obtained visualization, reporting that the unidentified flying object was "01NM south of Anápolis, heading 290 degrees, and an approximate speed of 185 km/h. To the plane the FAB 2305 was asked to inspect the informed sector, but the commander of the plane saw nothing at that initial moment, then, with the TABA of Anápolis detecting the UFO on the radar again in "another echo radar almost in the same original position as the previous echo" the FAB 2305 plane reported that the UFO was passing "side by side" with him and that "the FAB 2305 crew spotted a flashing white light" at the FAB's 3-o'clock position, about 4NM. Complementary Data : "According to TABA, most of the time, the displacement of the objects (about 09 objects, was in the East / West direction, and that the radar contacts with them remained until just before midnight. COpM did not request video recording, because he did not get positive radar contact with the objects " Fourth report: May 5, 1982 In the same way that happened a week before, on May 5, 1982 , at 22:05 the TABA of Anápolis "detected an object that moved from the radial 115 degrees, heading 270 degrees and, approximately, distance of 03 NM". According to the report, the unidentified flying object "disappeared in the radial 250 degrees, the same bow, 13NM" away. It was reported that simultaneously "numerous other echoes [radar]" appeared in the same position and crossed in the East/West direction, with slow speed and brightness. "When crossing" the imaginary axis of runway 06, in such a way that at least 03 were detected "by another" PAR radar "and flying at an altitude of about 5,700 feet. The COpM then reported that it had detected radar contacts with similar position, altitude and speed indicators. A pilot of the FAB F-103 plane in flight close to the region , it was requested to find out, in the sectors of radar detections, if there were "highways, railways or hills in these sectors." The pilot informed that "about 10NM from Anápolis that there are high voltage wires and hills installed" in the place. Complementary Data : "Conclusion: After a precise search (during the appearances) made by the Radar Technicians of this DPV, it was found that it was not a RADAR crash." More reports: "Between 03 days 06-05 MAY-82 / 16-MAY-82 , it was plotted in a representation of the "scope", the unidentified objects, with their origin, trajectory and disappearance (see annex). On May 12, 1982, a meeting was held at CINDACTA [...] in order to discuss the problem. After discussing the problem, it was admitted by the companions of this meeting that it was not a RADAR crash, nor a reflection of moving objects on the ground." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: An air traffic controller reported the sighting of a UFO in Vitória-ES [1984]
description: March 28, 1984. Time: 9:59 pm . Report by the Head of APP / TWR of Vitória-ES. [Control of Approach to the Control Tower at the Airport of Vitória, State of Espírito Santo]. Translation below : At approximately 21:59 (local time), I spotted a flying object in the South / North direction, flying across the continent. The body was slightly flattened and rectangular, almost oval and surrounded by strong green lighting. The light was strong around the body and left a small but considerable luminous tail. It was all green. The speed with which it was moving in the South / North direction from the radial 260, when I saw it, approximately, was amazing. It disappeared on the horizon in less than 10 (ten) seconds. The altitude I suppose it flew would be in the range of 1,500 meters to 2,000 meters, if not higher. Several people also spotted in the City when the object passed over the TV Tower / Airport and later called this Control Tower. At the moment I contacted the ACC Brasília, which was hard to answer my call for an interception by Radar. When the ACC BS looked at the area he said that there was nothing to report. It was a lightning shift and the object had its own means of propulsion, moving along a straight path and at a constant altitude. It was a real spectacle. Great lighting around the body and visible tail. No sound of turbines or vibration was observed, although the body moved at a relatively low altitude. The body was all light. I transcribe the fact for the necessary measures. That was the picture. (Below is a sketch of the object) in TWR's LRO. [see document link]. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: A cigar-shaped metallic UFO was observed in Brasília-DF [1984]
description: April 7th, 1984 . Time: 13:20. Duration: 10 minutes. A resident of Brasilia, Distrito Federal, reported seeing an unidentified flying object, with his wife and children, in the direction of the Central Bank in Brasilia, about 4 km away from the observer. According to the witness, the UFO was approximately 500 meters from the ground. The UFO had a cylindrical shape, with concave ends (finished with half spheres) and identical. The UFO' was 100 meters wide, with tis cylinder having 20 meters in diameter, its color was dark, matte aluminum, and its speed was the same as that of a jet. The unknown object did not emit sound or leave a trail of displacement. Complementary data: according to the witness, to estimate the speed of the UFO, he observed "an aircraft taking off" in the vicinity and this "served as a basis to estimate the speed and size of the object". When the object went up, "its color got darker". Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. description: OCT 21st, 1984 . Time: 20:35. Duration: not determined.
