name: "They're surrounding São Paulo" - air traffic controllers detected UFOs flying around the state. [1984]
description: On November 11, 1984, from 00:30 to 01:36 , 1 aircraft and 4 air traffic control centers in a region close to the city of São Paulo-SP communicated with each other to deal with sightings and detections of several unidentified flying objects over the State of São Paulo. First, the APP-SP [São Paulo-SP Approach Control] called the ACC-BS [Brasília Area Control Center] reporting that it was detecting an object on the radar at 5NM São Paulo-SP, in the position Southeast. The ACC-BS replied that it had no aircraft flying, but that they also had detected an object flying very slowly, around "13 knots" and changing direction several times. The Brasília Center triggered the Air Defense that confirmed the detection and was informed that the São Paulo Center had also detected it first. The person in charge of the ACC-BS tells the COpM [Military Operations Center] that it could not be just a confusion with the cloud, at that speed, because "the cloud changing the bow all the time is difficult, right?". The Control Tower at the Airport of São Paulo-SP [Congonhas] stated, when contacted, that it was also not an aircraft, as there were no flights there at that time. The ACC-BS then reports that the previously "very slow" object varied rapidly from 15 knots to 500 knots. This provoked reactions and comments from the São Paulo Tower Operator and the ACC-BS: ACC-BS: Yes, it has changed. TWR-SP: Suddenly? ACC-BS: Suddenly, man. TWR-SP: Ah my brother so you can be sure of that ... ACC-BS : That is some... TWR-SP: ... who is, Jesus Christ wanting to visit the Earth? ACC-BS : Yeah, I think so too. TWR-SP: No, you can be sure that one day he will come, my brother. Now. ACC-BS : Yes. TWR-SP: Believe whoever wants it right ACC-BS : Not because ... ACC-BS : Whether it will come from flying saucer or not is our problem. ACC-BS: Yeah, I noticed. After disappearing from the radar screens in Brasília and São Paulo for a few moments, the Center of São Paulo informs that it was detecting the object above the city of São Paulo. And the operator of the Tower of São Paulo says at that time that several calls were being made there without him being able to answer them all, even confessing to having turned the phone off for a moment. In communication with another operator in Brasília, the operator of the São Paulo Tower [Congonhas] states that he viewed the UFO with binoculars and that he was 17 miles from Congonhas Airport. Then it would be 1 mile from the Congonhas VOR. At this time, more telephone calls are made to TWR-SP, and the operator reports to the center of Brasilia that he had already served 3 civilians. 2 women and a man looking for information about the UFO they were sighting too. Then, when the TWR-SP operator with the radar detects a UFO over Santana-SP and another over Itanhém-SP, the ACC-BS operator in Brasília states that a UFO was over the Jaraguá neighborhood. At the same time, the TWR-SP operator had already realized that there were not only two, but several UFOs. ACC-BS and ACC-SP communicated and exchanged information passed on by TWR-SP. At one point, one of the operators reported that he already had a UFO in the region 13 miles from Campinas-SP and in the northern sector of São Paulo. The ACC-BS operator commented that "they are surrounding São Paulo", and warns that a Boeing 737 aircraft was approaching São Paulo so, that the ACC-SP should contact Brasilia in case "this gang flies over him" and that if that happened it was for him to warn. The UFO detections then appear in other areas such as Ubatuba-SP and São José dos Campos-SP, and the ACC-BS Operator informed that there is a UFO "well bonded with VARIG 956" approaching São Paulo. In the end, São Paulo Control Center came to detect "8 primary, clear targets, one far from the other" Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). name: In Brasília-DF and São Paulo-SP, air traffic controllers detected several UFOs [1984]
description: NOV 1st, 1984. Time: 00:31. Duration: not determined. At 00:31 on November 1, 1984, the Brasília-DF Area Control Center [ACC-BS] activates the São Paulo-SP Approach Control [APP-SP] to find out if there were any aircraft flying, because they were "detecting a runway 5 NM southeast of São Paulo, at a speed of 13kt [24km/h], constantly varying from the bow". At that time, APP-SP had not yet detected anything. At 00:40, the ACC-BS was already detecting 2 "plots": one to the southeast of Itanhaém-SP and the other to the vertical of São Paulo-SP. This time the APP-SP confirms the contacts. Meanwhile, at TWR-SP [São Paulo Airport Control Tower] operators were seeing "with a binocular, a white and yellow light". The TWR-SP, by that time, had already registered 3 phone calls reporting the UFO, and APP-SP " detected not only 2, but several unidentified ‘plots ‘". 00:40 - "APP-SP has 2 contacts: one on the 155º radial, 8 to 9NM; and the other was on top of Santana-SP and moved to the 340/343 radial at 16/17NM", while the ACC -BS now had a plot near São Paulo, without Santana. "APP-SP even had 4 large primary ‘plots' in the northern sector between 8 to 16 NM outside São Paulo". At that time, the two control centers in Brasília and São Paulo "simultaneously lost and recovered contact with UFOs". However, at 00:46, APP-SP had 7 ‘plots' in the São Paulo region and 4 ‘plots' in the north, up to 8NM. According to the report, the primary ‘plots' were the size of a Boeing . Radar contacts have also been reported to the south of Santos-SP. Gradually the reports were diminished until nothing was reported from aircrafts or control centers that day. Cf. name: Four aircrafts and an operator reported a metallic UFO in Foz do Iguaçu-PR and nearby [1985]
description: Foz do Iguaçu, State of Paraná. AUG 22nd, 1985 Military report on the ground and reports of 4 aircraft in flight in the region. AUG 22nd, 1985. Time: 08:36. Duration: 20 minutes [for the military]; several hours [for the population] . At 8:36 am, an unidentified flying object was observed by several people from the city of Foz do Iguaçu, in the state of Paraná. The reporting witness, a military operator of the Control Tower at Foz do Iguaçu Airport, reported "that he was seeing an unidentified flying object in the vicinity of the airport". According to the Operator's report, he saw, with binoculars, at 11:30 am, a UFO "in the form of a plate with a kind of "pigtail", and the triangular upper part, containing two antennas". The UFO was orange in color and was sometimes stationary, sometimes moving slowly. Complementary Data: a) PPCLA - The 300-SC 902, took off at 10:32h destination: Asunción [Paraguay], FL220, observed through binoculars, a metallic object, apparently spherical, before the FL 220/280, and requested ascent to PL 280 for better observation: the object moved vertically upwards at incalculable speed, not allowing its identification. b) TR463, arriving at FL 280 flying from LO to FI, 60NM outside, reported that the object was beyond FL 500 (12: 45h). 12: 55h - Reported that the object was vertical, at 17 NM Aerodrome. 12: 57h - Apparently downloading. 15: 59Z - TR 463 made 360°, and the object chased him to his right. At 3:40 pm, Sergeant Pacheco reported the following report of the PT LFT aircraft (LEAR JBT-25); RG 161 and TR463. a) PT coming from SBSP destination SBPI, at 2:15 pm reported seeing an apparently circular object with a metallic color tail, on radius 086 of the SBFI VOR at 44NM. b) The same aircraft took off from SB FI at 2:59 pm to SB SP and saw the object in the same radial at 61 NM from SB FI. c) TR 463 SBUD / SBFI when in the procedure, at 11:00am for landing at 4,500 feet, he spotted the object. The aircraft reported that it made a turn to the left of 360º and the object during the turn remained on its right, after which the object moved much faster than his aircraft; reported that it was a circular object with a metallic tail. d) RG 161 SB PI / SBCT DBP 12:30h requested to keep the object's bow. When leveled FL 270 reported that the object was high, he also reported that the object was circular, with a metallic-colored tail. IV - According to information from the Sergeant, the object still remained to be seen with the naked eye./JCM - 1TEN ESP CTA /. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: Protocols of procedures issued by the Min. of Aeronautics to document reports of UFO sightings [July 1985]
description: "Protocol of procedures of the Ministry of Aeronautics to document reports of UFO sightings [July 1985]" - translation below: Ministry of Aeronautics - First Integrated Center for Air Defense and Air Traffic Control [CINDACTA I] Issued: 15 July / Effective: 19 July Subject: Information on Unidentified Flying Objects Annex: Questionnaire "Whenever sightings of Unidentified Flying Objects are reported, the following procedures must be adopted: 1) Call the ACC-BS Chief Operational Team Officer; 2) Determine to the Treatment Supervisor the immediate recording of radar video; 3) Recognize in the PPI the plots possible to be correlated to UFOs, if chains initialize them; 4) Track the chains (tracks) associated with UFOs; 5) Survey all available weather information for the area: AID CPA - TF-4 197 CM1-BR -TF-3 444 CM1-SP - TF-9-361 CM1-RJ -TF-3 0-63 Meteo Gamma Radar - TF-3 1-37 Meteo S Radar. Roque - TF-3 9-375 Meteo Couto Radar - TF-3 0-34 6) Obtain, through visualization, as much data as possible. AID Gamma Radar Radar Sao Roque Couto Radar Radar Anápolis Radar Brasilia Congonhas Radar Galeão Radar Santa Cruz Radar Radar Belo Horizonte 7) Note the activation and end times of the activity; 8) For TF conversations, try to use only one console, if you receive TF on another console, note the sector and the time of the conversation; 9) Note the aircraft involved, as well as the ACC frequency used for reporting; 10) Determine that the radar operators of the Site, check the presence or not of plots on the "antenna foot"; 11) Request the Commanders of the aircraft as much data as possible; 12) Request data to fill in the attached questionnaire data; NOTE: All documentation related to these facts will have the classification "CONFIDENTIAL", therefore, it should not be registered in the LRO [Occurrence Book]. WWF-CAP ESP CTA / Head of CCTA / Approve: PRCV - TCEL AV-Operational Sub-commander. Questionnaire [model] How and when did you first notice the objects? How many were there and in what position were they? Can you describe the object? Form? Size? Color? Speed? Formation? Sound? Trail? Trajectory? Depth? Observation period and duration? Did the object change in appearance? changed color? Was he alone or accompanied? if so, by how many people? Distance from the observation point to the UFO? Existence of physical evidence (photography, film, samples)? Observation with the naked eye or with an optical device? Present weather conditions ? Observer's personal data: Name Address Age Degree of Education Main occupation Do you have technical knowledge [UFOs], if so, which ones? NOTE: This questionnaire refers to information on the ground. When an aircraft reports, it must do so succinctly. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: Letter reporting experiments and paranormal contacts with UFOs in Rio Branco-AC in 1981 [1985]
description: SEPT 19th, 1985 . In a letter addressed to the Ministry of Aeronautics, from the city of São José do Rio Preto, State of São Paulo, a man writes to report "paranormal contacts with unidentified flying objects" during and after a seminar taken place in Rio Branco-AC. Following is the translation of the letter: São José do Rio Preto, September 19, 1985. This conditioning led us to come into contact with the UFO Phenomenon, that is, we witnessed an Unidentified Flying Object and thus it aroused in us the paranormal through a type of telepathic contact that started to happen through the provocation by the UFOs of successive discharges of electricity in the cloudless atmosphere, at night. We were taken over by the phenomenon empire until very recently; we have already undergone psychiatric and psychotherapeutic treatment and have been able to withstand these paranormal contacts through neuroleptic drugs. Today, after three years of contact with the phenomenon, we have learned to live with the unknown; we no longer need medication because the paranormal has become bearable, but contacts through electrical discharges continue to answer my questions. We have communicated EMFA and now we are communicating the Air Force that led us to the phenomenon; we are aware of the existence of the SIOANI created confidentially by the FAB, which becomes the SYSTEM OF INVESTIGATION OF UNIDENTIFIED AIR OBJECTS. Since 1982 we have dedicated ourselves to research and now we request the possibility to research the phenomenon together with SIOANI in an official way. Would this be possible, since I am officially connected to the phenomenon? Without further ado, we are grateful for your attention and look forward to communicating with you. Kind regards, EJG / São José do Rio Preto-SP. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: Three aircrafts reported simultaneous UFO sightings in the State of São Paulo[1986]
description: SEPT 21st, 1986. Time: 21:15. Three aircrafts [one military] reported UFO sightings in São Paulo. FAB 2176 (SBRJ / SBSJ in FL 090). Duration: not determined. The pilot of the Brazilian Air Force FAB 2176 plane reported the sighting of an unidentified flying object at 12-hours in relation to his aircraft. According to the witness, the UFO was "similar to Venus when this planet is at its brightest. Yellowish in color. It said, however, that it was not Venus. The UFO was round, yellow and was apparently stationary. According to the pilot's report, "in the first sighting, the object was 6° from the horizon. Upon reaching FL090, the object was about 1° from the horizon. Apparently the object had rotational movements around the axis itself. Everyone aboard [FAB] 2176 was military ". The pilot said he noticed the UFO the first time when he crossed the altitude level "7,000ft / 7,500ft (top layer) at TMA-RJ, intercepted at ROR 274 of the VOR MRC". As for the size, the pilot stated that he had no way of estimating it, but" it gave the impression of greatness ". TF 406 (SBRJ / SBRP - FL 100 at about 20NM behind FAB 2176). Duration: 20 minutes. The pilot of TF 406, flying on the same route as the FAB 2176, positioned just behind about 20 NM [nautical miles] away, near the city of Marília-SP, also reported seeing a large unidentified flying object "probably 45 meters wide, which is equivalent to a DC10 approximately". According to the TF 406 pilot, the UFO was also positioned at 12 o'clock in relation to his aircraft. The object was white and red, and had "two headlights together and a red rotating headlight on the top". The UFO, according to his description, "was oval or rectangular, because there were two lights, one next to the other", and it maintained the same speed as the TF 406 aircraft. The object remained at a distance of 10 to 15 NM from the aircraft, and "only when it moved away to the sea side it was observed that it decreased in size". Along with the pilot on TF 406 was just one more person. Complementary Observations: "Almost simultaneously, the TR 462 D (SBGL / SBBR FL 350 - 80NM from Confins, sector NNW - 9 o'clock position) when flying at about 80 NM [nautical miles] from Confins [Belo Horizonte-MG Airport ], reported a 9-hour sector UFO sighting". Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. Código de Referência BR DFANBSB ARX.0.0.248. “Relato de ocorrência com objeto voador não identificado [ovni] entre Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo ”. Brasília, DF. 1952 a 2015. name: Four aircrafts reported UFO sightings at the same time [1986]
description: August 12, 1986 . Time: 6:45 pm. The ACC-BS [Area Control Center of Brasília-DF] received a call from a military man reporting that "04 aircrafts were seeing lights in very high positions". According to the report, the aircraft that observed the unidentified flying objects were the SC 881 , PT KPB , TF-536 and SC 144 . All in different locations, in the Southeast region of Brazil. The pilots of the SC 114 and TF 536 aircraft reported their sightings. Duration: 5 minutes. The SC 114 pilot reported that he first observed the unidentified flying objects at 18:50, in the "3-hour position of the aircraft and very far away". First, the witness "believed" it was a "reflection of sunlight", but the object changed "from white to opaque". The UFO, still according to the pilot's report, carried out a "trajectory in the vertical direction". Duration: 3 minutes. The TF 536 pilot reported that he first observed two UFOs at 18:40, with one white UFO "at 12 o'clock, 30° above the horizon, and the second [UFO] to the right of the aircraft. According to the pilot, the UFOs were "like a star, increasing in size, forming a halo (as if burning); [also] there was sunlight illuminating the halo." In the pilot's description, the second UFO only left a small trail of displacement and both UFOs performed horizontal trajectories. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: A pilot and co-pilot reported that they were followed by a UFO [1986]
description: August 28, 1986 . Time: 20:40. Duration: 40 minutes. Two pilots from two different planes flying between the region of Franca [State of São Paulo] and Triângulo Mineiro [State of Minas Gerais], reported sightings of an unidentified flying object. According to the Brasília-DF Approach Control report, TAM's TF-585 flight, at around 9:00 pm, "was seeing unidentified flying objects near its aircraft when it was flying over Uberaba, in the state of Minas Gerais. A pilot from another aircraft, PP-EFC, spotted around 8:00 pm the "light" in the same position. The TF-585 pilot reported that he noticed "an object in the aircraft's 3-hour position; before Araguari", State of Minas Gerais. The UFO was "similar to a landing gear headlight", white in color and flying at an estimated speed of 400 km/h, following the TF-585. The UFO followed the pilot's aircraft while "quickly varying in level and the light flashed when the Bandeirante [TF-585] flashed the lights." The pilot reported that, with him, the sighting was also made by the co-pilot and 11 other people on the aircraft. The TF-585 co-pilot reported that the UFO had an oval shape, was the size of a Bandeirante model airplane [like the TF-585] and that it was about 5km away from his aircraft and that the same unknown object "maintained the 3-hour position for 40 minutes - heading 195° and moved away in São Joaquim da Barra [State of São Paulo]". Like the pilot, his TF-585 colleague also reported that "when the Bandeirante turned the lights on and off, the object did the same", that is, it copied various actions of the TAM aircraft. Cf. name: Three air traffic controllers reported a very low star-like UFO at São José dos Campos-SP [1986]
description: MAY 29th, 1986 . Time: 21:10. Duration: 20 minutes. Three military on duty from the Control Tower at São José dos Campos Airport, State of São Paulo, reported the sighting of an unidentified flying object with a star shape that initially was "confused with a satellite moving in the sky but was very low". According to the witness's report, the UFO was on Radial 010 of the VOR SJC, had a "flashing white" color and flew at a speed of 80 to 100 kt. Also according to the witness, the UFO "crossed the axis of the runway and moved on bow 260, reaching about 15 NM from the observers. Additional data: "II - Ten D. also informed that the operator of TWR Santos-SP reported that he had seen such objects at the same time, but as TWR-Santos was already closed, it was not possible to question the operator. III - I also inform you that I called the APP-SP, to confirm if the operator had detected something on the radar, however the service team had already been surrendered, and according to the hour operator there was nothing recorded in the incident book of the APP."/ JCM - 1TEN ESP CTA. name: Pilots and controllers reported supersonic UFOs near Bragança Paulista-SP [1986]
description: MAY 27th, 1986 . Time: 23:36. Duration: not determined. An aircraft pilot flying from São Paulo-SP to Varginha-MG, the TF 402, having taken off at 22:07, reported having seen a "bright light, in its 9-hour position" about 33NM from the city of Bragança Paulista-SP. At that same time, according to a report, the "ACC-BS [Brasília-DF] was capturing a primary "plot" with a speed of 813 kt [1,540 km / h] and a course of 208 degrees in that position". Another aircraft, the flight "VARIG RG256A [SBGR / SBCF - São Paulo-Guarulhos Airport to Belo Horizonte-Confins Airport - FL330, DEP 23:18]" reported sightings in the same region, even asking for permission to divert of the route to avoid collision with the UFO. Complementary data: "Transcript of occurrence posted in the Chief Controller's assistant book: At 11:36 pm RG 256 (GR / CF) reported to ACC (F8) that it was being accompanied by lights on the BGC / BHZ (UR1) section. Such a situation it lasted until 11:49 pm, without obtaining radar contact with those objects." The ACC-BS did not capture anything on the radar, nor did the APP-BH. At 00:20 TWR-BH (Sct MA) reported me that he saw green, red and white lights, approximately over Carlos Prates city (near Belo Horizonte-MG]. [...] At 00:03, FAB 2177 (laboratory aircraft) took off from SBBH [Aeroporto da Pampulha-BH-MG] and, when questioned by APP-BH, reported seeing 2 balloons. RG 256A, after Confins took off for SBBR as RG256B, nothing reporting on that stretch." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). name: A family in Brasília-DF sighted star-like UFOs moving erratically [1986]
description: May 26th, 1986. Time: 2:30pm. Duration: 3 minutes. In Brasília, four people from the same family reported the sighting of "4 or 5 unidentified flying objects", in the form of "blinking stars". According to the witnesses, the UFOs had "faint, undefined colors, silver and white, changing color. The unknown objects flew at slow speed and in "disorderly formation", moving "to the right from the point of view of observation" , in a position of about "60° to 80° in relation to the horizon". The sighting was carried out with binoculars in good weather and visibility. Observation of the report: "video recording was not necessary because nothing unusual was observed in the radar covers". name: UFO sightings in 4 different states on the same night [May 23, 1986]
description: First case: May 23, 1986. Time: 20:10. Duration: 20 minutes. Two people in Brasília, Distrito Federal , observed an unidentified flying object in a round shape, "luminous, brighter than the stars, changing color" that remained stationary while it was observed. According to the witnesses, the UFO was towards the west, and emitted, predominantly, sparkling orange and blue colors. The reporting witness was unable to estimate the altitude or distance from the UFO. According to information in the report, "nothing was observed on the radars, dispensing the recording." The sighting was done with the naked eye and in good conditions of visibility for the observation of the sky, which was clear that night. Second case: May 23, 1986. Time: 21:40. Report: "Phone call (DDD) received at 00:40Z on May 24, 1986 from Ten Cel Dias (COMAT) informing that his subordinates (a sgt. and a corporal), on duty, would be seeing UFOs over Corcovado and Niterói (RJ) . Bright colors and standing out in the starry sky, We informed Lt. Col. DIAS the content of the questionnaire used by CINDACTA I and left it up to him to determine the validity of its application in this case. " Third case: May 23, 1986 - 21:50 Report: "3S Barros (ACC-BS) received a TF3 call at the Operational Team Chief's desk at 00:50Z on May 24, 1986. The person identified himself as belonging to BAST (probably the Day Officer and / or BAST Operations) informing that it was receiving numerous calls from people residing in Santos and reporting cases of UFO sighting. Nothing abnormal was observed in the Radar coverage ". Fourth case: May 23, 1986 - 22:15. Duration: 10 minutes. Two military men on duty in the city of Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, observed an unidentified flying object that looked like a "luminous point, colored green, red, blinking alternately. According to witnesses, the UFO remained stationary in sector QDR 240 of Ribeirão Preto. The sighting occurred in clear sky and was performed with the naked eye and also with binoculars. Observations: "Contact received via [telephone] by 2S Itice in the period of 02: 27/02: 38 of May 24, 1986 reporting UFO sighting in SBRP . Using the questionnaire provided for in IS / 018 / CCTA. More cases on the same day: Observations: 1) Upon sighting the object, he contacted the ACC-BS [ Brasília-DF ] and TWR-YS [ Pirassununga-SP ] to find out if there was any traffic in the sector or if there was radar detection. The response from both bodies was negative. 2) At about 10 pm, 3S Gelson received a call from Ms. Eda who said she was observing a "foreign object" in the company of a few more people. 3) Nothing was observed on the radars without the need for video recording". OTHER CASES: Service controllers on May 23, 1986, 2nd shift, received several calls from people who reported UFO sightings. This information was lost due to the lack of doctrine of the Operational Team in dealing with this matter. In the same way, we received several calls from the press organs (always answered or transferred to the Chief of Staff) trying to obtain information and / or statements from CINDACTA I. All were instructed to go to CEREPA. JAA / 1TEN ESP CTA. —- Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: "THE UFOS' NIGHT IN BRAZIL" [1986] #7 - Time-line
description: Internal military correspondence. Brasília-DF, June 2, 1986 From: COMDA Commander / NuCOMDABRA To: ExmB Sr Commander of the General Air Command Subject: Occurrence Report Ref: Note N9 C QQ2 / MIM / ADM, of 13 Apr 78 Annex: 01 (one) Report Occurrence Report I - INTRODUCTION The purpose of the this report is to inform the authorities of the Ministry of Aeronautics, especially to the Honorable Minister, of the events that took place on the night of May 19, 1986, with regard to the information of the Air Traffic Control and Air Defense Bodies, as well as interceptor pilots involved in the events. Due to the limitations of time and specialized knowledge in facts of this nature, this Command was well advised, within the operational sphere, to limit itself to the simple narration of the facts, so as not to give rise to speculations involving the Ministry of Aeronautics. II - Initial considerations The Brazilian Aerospace Defense System with regard to the RDAl, so far has radar-based detention equipment whose primary purpose is intended for air traffic control, and is therefore not specific for use in Air Defense. Its technical limitations make the surveillance of the Airspace deficient in relation to the detection of targets, whose initialization is done in a normal way, that is, the interference of the controller is necessary constantly, in order to maintain the radar contact visualized for periods in which it is thorough evaluation is possible. As a consequence, the monitoring of the movements detected at the time was severely impaired, due to the fact that we were unable to maintain the visualization, even with the work of the controllers, as the contacts obtained were not strong enough to form an initialization work. The information transmitted to the pilots by the Military Operations Center, was made through the evaluation and experience of the Air Defense Controllers, until the onboard equipment offered conditions to the pilots to continue in the interceptions. Regarding the interceptions carried out in the Anápolis area, at some point contacts were obtained through the radar of the DACTA network (LP-23 DPV-DT 61) and the vectors were only possible due to the detections made by the area radar of the Air Base of Annapolis. III - Description of the Facts In this part, all the facts will be described in chronological order, with measures adopted by the Air Defense Air Command. 11:15pm [MAY 19] - The Brasília Area Control Center informs COpM1 that the operator of the São José dos Campos Control Tower had seen lights moving over the city. The lights, although predominantly red, showed changes to yellow, green and orange. The TWR-SJ operator simultaneously informs APP-SP, which confirms the contacts to be in the São José dos Campos area. 00: 08Z - [MAY 20] - The PT-MBZ pilot sees lights on the radial 150 of the São José dos Campos VOR, moving from East to West. The lights, according to the pilot's own information, looked like big, red stars. The pilot, on his own initiative, made an observation of these lights and was unable to approach them. 00: 41Z - The COpM Alert Officer was called. 00: 23Z - The Alert Officer at the Air Defense Operations Center (CODA) was called. 00: 39Z - As determined by the Chief of CODA, the alert aircraft of the Santa Cruz Air Base was activated. The determination to activate the aircraft was due to the radar detection of some "PLOTS", in the São José dos Campos area. Such detections, although not constituted in defined radar echoes, were used in the vectoring of the intercepting aircraft in order to position the vectors, so that they would be able to continue in the interception, using the on-board radar. 01: 10Z - APP-AN reports that it is detecting some echoes on its radar. The Radar echoes reported by the APP-AN were not being viewed by the COpM equipment. 01: 11Z - Anápolis Air Base alert triggered. This activation, determined by CODA, took place due to the information from the APP-AN operator about the permanence of the Radar echoes, with definitions of bow and speed. 01: 18Z CODA requests the Santa Cruz Air Base to activate two more airplanes on alert. This request was made, taking into account that only one aircraft remains at the disposal of the Air Defense Command for eventual activations, and the possible permanence in flight of this aircraft for a longer time than its autonomy, which later happened, causing the its collection, being replaced by another vector. 01: 32Z - Takeoff of the first aircraft from the Santa Cruz Air Base. From this moment on, after the necessary transfers of control, the Military Operations Center began to vector the referred aircraft for sector W, where some Radar echoes were obtained in the São José dos Campos area. The pilot of the aircraft informed when stabilized in the FL 170 that he is seeing a white light below his level and that later it was rising, remaining 10° above his aircraft. The monitoring was carried out until FL 330. He also informed that for a moment the light changed from white to prevailing this color. During the follow-up, he obtained contact with the on-board equipment that indicated he was between 10 and 12 miles away, confirming visual contact. The monitoring took place towards the sea until approximately 180 miles from Santa Cruz, when the abandonment was made due to the positive approach of the lights and because it was close to the Minimum Fuel for Abandonment (CMA). 01: 48Z - Takeoff of the Anápolis Air Base Alert Aircraft. After the necessary transfers of control, the aircraft was vectored to a point, whose detection was being made by the APP-AN radar, which transmitted the information to the COpM which transmitted it to the pilot. This procedure was adopted, as no echo radar was being seen on the COpM equipment. The pilot made five presentations, obtaining contact and acquisition with his on-board radar, but not obtaining any visual contact. From all presentations, he arrived at 2 miles from the radar contact once, whose trajectory was sometimes in a zigzag, sometimes in a sharp curve on the right. Its speed varied in order to allow an approach as it also moved away suddenly, even though the interceptor was at supersonic speed, which caused the loss of contact, and the chase was then abandoned. 01: 50Z - Takeoff of the second aircraft from the Santa Cruz Air Base. After normal control procedures, the aircraft was vectored to the same area south of São José dos Campos. The pilot reported seeing a red light at the position informed by the COpM, thus confirming the ground radar detection. After a few minutes, he found that the light was not approaching and that it then went out, at the same time that radar contact was lost. A striking fact during this vectoring was the appearance for a moment of thirteen "plots" at the tail [behind] of the aircraft, which was commanded a 180° curve, however having not obtained any visual or on-board radar contact. 02: 17Z - Takeoff of the second aircraft from Anápolis Air Base. This aircraft did not obtain any kind of visual contact or radar. 02: 36Z - Takeoff of the third aircraft from Anápolis Air Base. Also, following the example of the second, he did not get any contact. 02: 37Z - Landing of the first BASC aircraft; 02: 46Z - Landing of the first BAAN aircraft; 03: 05Z - Landing of the second BASC aircraft; 03: 07Z - Landing of the second BAAN aircraft; 03: 30Z - Landing of the third BAAN aircraft; All withdrawals and landings were carried out normally. IV - Final Considerations 1 - From the analysis of the events, this Command is of the opinion, according to the information from the controllers, pilots and reports previously prepared by the I CINDACTA, that some points are coincident with respect to the radar echo, acceleration, lighting, speeds and behavior , both by technical detection and visualization. 2 - Some that we can mention are the phenomena that present certain constant characteristics, namely: a) produce radar echoes not only from the Air Defense System, but also from intercepting aircraft simultaneously, with visual comparison. b) They vary their speeds from the subsonic to the supersonic range, as well as remain in hover flight. c) They vary their altitudes below FL-050 to altitudes higher than FL-400. d) Sometimes they are visualized due to the lights of white, green, red colors, other times there is no luminous indication. e) They have the ability to accelerate and decelerate abruptly. f) Ability to make curves with constant radii and other times with indefinite radii. 3 - As a conclusion of the constant facts observed, in almost all presentations, this Command is of the opinion that the phenomena are solid and reflect, in a certain way, intelligence, due to the ability to follow and keep distance from observers as well as flying in formation, not necessarily manned. 4- Timely, it is worth mentioning the efficiency of the Aerial Unities engaged in the operation, because according to the plan, each of these units maintains an alert aircraft at 45 minutes and with less than 30 minutes after activation, 7 (seven) vectors armed forces were available for employment. / Brigadier JPCA / COMDA Commander / NuCOMDABRA Cf. name: "THE UFOS' NIGHT IN BRAZIL" [1986] - Documents #6
description: Military Internal Correspondence Santa Cruz, May 28, 1986 From : 1st Ten Av Kleber Caldas Marinho To : Commander of the Lo Gp Av Ca Subject: Report of the fact occurred on 05/19/86 (Monday) The first eye contact occurred after THOR commanded 180°. The objective was in the position of one to two hours low, at this moment, by order of LINCE I approved the objective and started an attempt of approach in the bow 240°. At a certain moment, as my search had only been visual until then, I turned on my on-board radar and got a contact at 12 o'clock (which matched the visual) at a distance ranging from 10 to 12 NM. From then on, I just felt that the object was moving away and when the order to turn on the radar to search was already out of reach of 20NM. From the first visual contact on FL 170 until the last FL330 observation, the object went from one situation, one to two hours. low, to 12-hour high. At a certain moment when I started to observe the object again, because I had stopped fixing my vision for a few moments, to avoid any kind of night illusion, I was able to observe 3 different colors, green, red and white that pulsed, prevailing for [...] the white. Regarding the on-board instruments, the only one that gave any change was the HSI, as ADF was selected (with this selection the DME continues to indicate normally) and at a certain moment when already at the bow 240° at about 200NM in the water (where the DME window should already have the red flag) I got pointer indications of the [...] object varying from 10 to 20° to the right and DMR indications equal to 35 / 36NM and on the back when already at the bow 70° o the same instrument normalized, with the red window appearing. The items that most marked the mission were the following: - After reaching 180° the eye contact coincided with Thor's instructions. - When at 12 o'clock and a little closer, the onboard radar received a plot with the same situation 12h, 10 to 12MN. - From a situation of one to two hours it went to 12 pm, 10° high. - DME indication when 200 MN is indicating 35/36 DME and the hand the ADF is indicating in the bow varying 10 to 20° to the right. / KCM - 1TEN AV- Jambock17 . name: "THE UFOS' NIGHT IN BRAZIL" [1986] - Documents #5
description: Military Internal Correspondence Ministry of Aeronautics Santa Cruz Air Base 1st Fighter Aviation Group Santa Cruz, May 28, 1986 From: Cap Av - M.B J. To: Commander of the 1st Gp Av Ca Subject: Report of the Fact Occurred on 19/05/86 (Monday) I - On the night of May 19, 1986, I was ordered to immediate take off for identification of radar contacts visualized by THOR. During the displacement, I was informed by the Air Defense, that approximately 5 contacts, were approaching my 12-hours at 20 MN. I inform you that the night was clear, cloudless and with a full moon. I did not obtain eye contact with the contacts who were 5 miles away at 12 o'clock, my 6 hours and 2 miles remained. THOR drove a 180 ‘turn on the right, when I was informed that the contacts were gone. After 30 minutes of searching with a large number of contacts informed by THOR, I saw a red light towards the sea from São José dos Campos. I communicated to the Air Defense and the controller confirmed the contact. I was instructed to approach the light and try to get closer, which was done without success. After reaching my minimum checking account, I abandoned the interception and started returning to the base. With nothing more to declare. MBJ -Cap AV / Jambock 07 Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: "THE UFOS' NIGHT IN BRAZIL" [1986] - Documents #4
description: Military internal correspondence. ANÁPOLIS-GO AIR BASE, May 27, 1986. From: BAAN Commander To: Your Excellency Mr. Commander of COMDA I - I forward the personal reports to you, cleared by the team involved in triggering the Air Defense Alert, of 19 May 86 Occurrence transcript of May 19/20, 1986. At approximately at 01:20Z, we were informed by the OPO that the alert aircraft would be triggered. At 01:48Z, the JG 116 took off to intercept a target that appeared on the radar screen, at 8 NM, on the radial 240 with 270°. With the assistance of the TABA operator, THOR vectored the JG 116 many times in order to intercept the cited target. The two pilots, both of the "hunter" in question, as well as the target mentioned above, ‘merged' and after the merger of the plots, the target maintained its bow. As there were other plots inside our terminal, the JG 98 and JG 107 took off at 02: 17Z and 02: 35Z, respectively. Subsequently, other plots appeared on the radials: 180° to 8NM, 240° to 6NM and 360° which were always kept moving to the west sector. However, jaguars 98 and 107 saw no object. After a certain permanence on our screens, the targets soon disappeared, reappearing afterwards; leaving an apparent trace. / 3Ssgt BCT PRRA — Report of the facts that occurred in the Alert flight carried out on MAY 19, 1986. The takeoff was carried out at 23:17hs. After takeoff, I took bow 270° up to FL100. The patrol sector had as its basic axis the radial 235 of the VOR of Anápolis, going through the city of Anápolis through the city of Gioânia. During the flight, several interceptions were attempted by THOR on the target that evolved in this sector. In all of them, the hunter's radar and visual contact was negative. Interceptions were attempted by varying the flight level from FL 60 to 150, with visual search and radar up and down, all with negative results. As the ground radar contacts were being obtained by TABA which transmitted to THOR, which relayed to the hunter, it was difficult to determine the target's heading and speed. Apparently, this target evolved without a defined pattern, from the sector already described above. Its estimated speed during the interception was a maximum of 200kt until the ground radar had "plots" confused. Afterwards, it reappeared at a position 20 to 30 NM away from the last "plot". After 45 minutes of flight, the collection was made. After landing, I asked the runway mechanics if they had seen or heard anything other than an F-103 flying over the runway or in the vicinity of the Base. The answer was no. The atmospheric conditions were good, with clear skies, good visibility and the moon. - RSS.CAP AV / Pilot of Alert - JG 98. — Report of the facts that occurred in the Alert flight carried out on MAY 19, 1986. I took off as a third alert aircraft, maintaining the runway heading until contact with THOR, climbed to the FL160 and started orbit maintaining the level and the prows 060° and 240° with legs of approximately 50 NM and the +/- 30 NM of MALOCA. About three times I was moved in interception of a target that was maneuvering in the vicinity of BAAN, having even been at a distance of 1 MN from the target without obtaining radar or visual contact, which was repeated the other times. Visual search and radar were performed for all sectors indicated by THOR without seeing anything. / JCR CAP AV / JG 107. — Activation of the Alert on May 19, 1986 As alert 1, I was triggered at 10:15 pm on May 19. I gave the "ready ‘for the OPO at 22: 32P and the rocket takeoff took place at 22:45 approximately. I had as a climb order: PPS and SBAN reblocking at level 180. After the reblocking I kept heading 270°, when THOR gave me the first visual search order in the 10-hour sector, without anything being seen. THOR commanded me 180° left turn and, when stabilizing in the 9C bow, I had a contact at 13 MN on my 130° antenna approximately. I got "JUDITH" right after that and started to pursue contact with both the pilot orders and the video. At this moment I maintained .9 speed and the target maneuvered in a zigzag pattern and the distance either remained constant, sometimes decreased or increased, until the 6 MN of the objective (I was already supersonic - M 1.05) importance ran to increase very quickly until there was the loss of "JUDITH". Other contacts and "JUDITHS" were obtained, but lost shortly thereafter. The closest distance I was able to reach was 2 MN and constantly turning on the right, without however obtaining eye contact. The meteorology did not influence, it would even facilitate the visualization of any aircraft due to the moon's light. description: Internal military correspondence Brasília-DF, June 24, 1986. From : Controlling Chief Assistant To : Captain Franciscangelis Subject : Occurrence I - Transcription of the Operational Occurrence book of the Chief Controlling Assistant: "At 23:39Z the JBAZ carrying out an interception mission, 44FI09 position 70 NM on the radial 360 VOR AN, reported contact with an object and asked if it was a "ghost". "THOR" had no radar contact with the reported object. Both aircrafts had visual contact and then on-board radar contact. They reported having contact at about 08 NM. "THOR" was asked to approve the object. The authorization was granted and the chase started with acceleration up to 1.2 of Mach. There was a small approach, and then the object was moving away increasing the speed and left the limit of the onboard radar. The chase was canceled and the mission proceeded normally. During the pursuit the pilots noted the change of the object's color, varying from green to white and red. In the last presentation, already with a return bow, JBAZ reported that he was being accompanied by the object. Video recording was provided, but without any contact with the object, informed. (23:39Z to 23:59Z). When "debriefing", the pilot commented that on the descent he accelerated to 1.2 Mach and noticed a great speed of the object, as it changed from 08 to 20 NM in about 5 seconds. description: Brasília-DF, May 27, 1986. From: 1st TEN ESP CTA F. H.N. FREITAS. To: Mr. HEAD OF COpM1 INFORMATION SECTION. Subject: Possible appearance of UFOs in SBSJ and SBAN. I - I report to you, for the appropriate purposes, the events of 19 MAY 86 - 23: 15Z to 20 MAY 86 03: 32Z: "ACC BR (CTA BUENO) informed COpMI that the operator of TWRSJ, 2S QSS BCT S.M. DA SILVA, was seeing lights over the city and close to the external marker of RWY 15. The ACC BS also reported that APP-SP obtained radar contact with some targets in the vicinity of SBSJ. - COpM I (SGT EMILIO) contacted TWR SJ and received the following information from 2S SERGIO: "At 21: 30Z I noticed a spotlight on the city in the NW sector of the aerodrome and two other spots close to the external marker The foci appeared to be the size of the "head of a matchstick", the color red predominated, but there were changes to yellow, green and orange. They were standing still. The observation was made with binoculars and the naked eye. The sky was clear , with 2/8 of cirrus, the N / NE there was a layer of fog at low height". - Subsequently, the ACC-BS informed COpM I that TWR-SJ had informed that the "objects" evolved close to PT-MBZ, coming from SBBR to SBSJ, interfering in their landing. Later, also, TWR-SJ reported that there were several points of light moving and changing colors. - PT-MBZ pilot, Mr A. P. DA SILVA, residing in São José dos Campos, [...], EMBRAER employee, declared that when approaching SBSJ he observed two points of red light in radial 150 of the VOR SJC, over the coast, moving from East to West; it was not possible to evaluate the speed of the objects. These looked like big, red stars. The aircraft has not suffered any interference with its flight or equipment. The sky was clear. The initiative to observe the objects came from the pilot himself who was unable to approach the objects. - In the meantime, COpM I received information from the APP-AN operator, SGT MÁRCIO, that he detected on the "Anápolis radar" an "echo" that was traveling at low speed on the 2709 radial of the ANP VOR with bow 270°. Such echoes were not detected by the Gama radar although some "PLOTS" appeared in TMA AN but did not even form "chains". The information from the APP-AN operator determined the triggering of the Anápolis alert at 01: 01 Z. II - Aircraft activated and results obtained: - JB 17, LC 76 controller, activated at 01: 27Z DEP 01: 34Z ARR 02: 37Z of the 20th MAY 86. The JB17 after being vectored for heading 180°, following instructions from COpM I that had obtained a "PLOT" in that position, he saw a white light and tried to get closer without being able to reach his goal. Only once was he able to contact "onboard radar" between 10 and 12 NM. The "object" appeared to be a white colored spot of light and only once, when the pilot looked into the ANV, did the object change color to red, green and again white, prevailing this color. In the first visual contact, the object was below the flight level of JB 17, FL 170, and later it was kept rising 10 ° above the plane of JB 17 that accompanied it until FL 330. The JB 17 received indications from the VOR / DME SC when it was already out of reach of that equipment. He returned to SBSC for being close to the minimum fuel and not observing "reason" of approach with the objective. - JB 07, LC 45 controller, was activated 01: 45Z, DEP 01: 50Z ARR 03: 05Z on May 20, 86. JB 07 saw a red light that coincided with antenna information given by THOR ("PLOT"); JB 07 tried to approach but the light went out. The striking fact in this mission was the appearance of thirteen "PLOTS" on the tail of the JB07 that made a 180 ° turn to observe, but did not visualize or detect anything. - JG 116, LC 80 controller, activated 01.-45Z, DEP 01: 48Z ARR 02: 46Z. He made five presentations, in all he obtained "JUDITE" but no visual account. In one of the presentations, it reached two miles from the goal. In all presentations, antenna and distance information was provided by the Anápolis TA-10 radar. COpM I did not obtain radar contact with the objective although it observed the formation of "PLOTS" on the Gama radar. The JG 116 was unable to approach the goal as it moved away at great speed when the hunter approached. - JG98, LC53 controller, activated 02: 10Z, DEP 02: 17Z, ARR 03:07, did not make any presentation. - JG 107, LC 87 controller, activated 02: 30Z, DEP 02: 36Z, ARR 03: 30Z, did not make any presentation. - JB 09 in SBSC and JG 103 in SBAN were deployed but did not take off, which remained on standby. III - SEQUENCE OF EVENTS: May 19th. 1986 23: 15Z : ACC BS triggers COpM I. 00: 08Z : PT-MBZ sees lights near SBSJ. 00: 11Z : Request to record video from São Roque . 00: 14Z : The COpM I warning is triggered. 00: 23Z : CODA's warning is triggered. 00: 30Z : Request to record Couto's video. 00: 39Z : SBSC alert triggered. May 20th, 2016 01: 10Z : APP AN reported detecting plots on its radar. Not viewed on the Gamma radar. 01: 11Z : SBAN alert is triggered. 01: 15Z : SBSC alerts ready pass the alert to "posts". 01: 18Z : CODA requests that SBSC put two more ANVs on alert. 01: 24Z : CODA tries to trigger KC-130's crew possible possible need for revo. 01: 34Z : DEP JB 17. 01: 48Z : DEP JG 116. 01: 50Z : DEP JB 07. 02 : 17Z: DEP JG98. 02: 36Z : DEP JG 107 02: 37Z : ARR JB 17. 02: 42Z : Request to record Gama's video. 02: 46Z : ARR JG 116. 03: 05Z : ARR JB 07. 03: 07Z : ARR JG98. 03: 30Z : ARR JG 107. NOTE: 1) The times of viewing the "object" by JB 17 and the radar contact obtained by JG 116 were estimated due to the fact that the recorder did not record the times on the tape. 2) The São Roque video was not recorded due to technical problems. 3) Gama's video recording was delayed because one of the recorders went into a panic. IV - Conclusion: The radar observations made by COpM I, were all in the form of "PLOTS", they did not even constitute clues. There were a large number of "PLOTS" in the region of São José dos Campos and a smaller number in the region ‘of Anápolis. The information from the Anápolis radar did not coincide with that of the Gama radars, the activations therefore, were based more on information from the radar of that TMA than from the Gama radars. - The intercept vectors were unable to fulfill the identification mission for the reasons previously reported. - In the areas of Anápolis and São José dos Campos, about twenty "PLOTS" were observed, the largest number in São José dos Campos. / FHNF - 1 TEN ESP CTA / Chief Controller of COpM1 Cf. name: A flight Controller observed and detected 5 UFOs near Guarulhos-SP [1987]
description: DEC 13th, 1987 . Time: 00:50 am. Duration: 10 minutes. A flight controller from Guarulhos Airport, State of São Paulo, observed with the naked eye and then checked on the radar "approximately 5 (five) small and close targets". The military realized that "the position matched the visual observation". According to the reporting witness, the UFOs "changed positions, but 2 (two) of them were seen at the end of lanes 09 and 27, respectively". As for the location, the UFOs were in the "Southeast of Guarulhos, close to the BONSUCESSO position". Visually, the UFOs had an "oval" shape, moved slowly and [when] "seen in the binoculars were the size of the thumbnails. Without the binoculars they were quite small". Regarding the quantity, "the largest amount seen was 5 (five) objects. Sometimes one decreased when some other disappeared". The UFOs flew sometimes close, sometimes separate, as when 1 (one) was seen at the headboard 09 and seconds later the same one, or perhaps another, at the headboard 27. The objects made "most of the time straight and sometimes circular trajectories". Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). name: In Nova Viçosa-BA, a woman reported a close encounter, alien interference and rumors of sex with extraterrestrials [1987]
description: FEB 26th, 1987. Time: 10:30 pm. Duration: 6 hours . A couple and two friends in the city of Nova Viçosa, State of Bahia, had a close contact with several UFOs that were positioned 20 meters from them. According to the witnesses, the UFOs were shaped like a "plate", emitted the colors red, yellow and blue, and were "faster than a bullet". Also according to the reporting witness, the unidentified flying objects flew "in a straight line, towards the sea, more precisely, towards a ship. (According to the witness, the ship does research for Petrobras). ADDITIONAL COMMENTS PROVIDED BY THE WITNESS : The information was given by the STF-RF Sgt [...]. The observer informed that the mayor of PRADO-BA, also saw objects and transmitted them to SBSV. It was also recorded that at 14:00 on 05 March 87, his neighbor saw an object with the shape of a boomerang, black in color, "flying" towards the "ship" doing research for PETROBRAS. It was reported that the husband drew a firearm, and it did not work; the car (BUGGY) did not start. The observer also reported that the lights flashed and when they reached the ship they multiplied and stopped flashing. The luminosity of the objects was sufficient to illuminate the entire ship. The lady says she is "terrified" because her maid and two other girls had sex with 3 crew members, and noticed that the 3 had a red spot as if it were a tattoo or mark, on the left leg, next to the groin. She said that the crew, around 25 people, did not eat, refused to eat and were "furious" to the point of being violent. " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: After taking off from Salvador-BA, the crew of VASP 251 spotted a round white UFO [1988]
description: Interrelated with previous case . Flight VSP 251 - October 3, 1988. Time: 20:45. Duration: 10 minutes . The crew of flight VASP 251 spotted a "luminous object on the horizon" in the northwest position, when the aircraft was approaching the city of Brasília, Distrito Federal, from Salvador Airport, State of Bahia. According to the pilot's report, the UFO was a "luminous circle with varying intensity", whose size was variable, sometimes small, sometimes large. "In the largest size, [the pilot] estimated [it was] ten times the size of a full moon", presenting itself in "white color, sometimes transparent, sometimes opaque". Also according to the reporting witness, the UFO was traveling "at the bow 280 *. The aircraft flew from Salvador to Brasília at bow 259°, Sector 1-hour [from the] Aircraft. The sighting was carried out with the naked eye and with good visibility conditions ["unlimited visibility"]. Complementary data from COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "He guaranteed that this is not a meteorological phenomenon or any celestial star." name: The crew of VASP 374 observed a round white UFO near Goiânia-GO [1988]
description: *Interrelated case [see the next post]* Flight VSP 374 - October 3, 1988. Time: 20:30. Duration: 12 minutes. When flying over the region of Goiânia, State of Goiás, during flight VASP 374 from Confins Airport [Belo Horizonte-MG] to the Airport of Goiânia-GO, the aircraft crew spotted an unidentified flying object with a round shape, which " gave the impression of solidity. Twice the size of a full moon. A compact block of light ". The UFO had a solid white color, and its speed gave an "impression" of being close to the speed of the aircraft, and perhaps "higher than it." According to the reporting witness, the UFO was about 3,000 feet high, making a West-to-Northwest trajectory. The object "at first [kept] the bow opposite to that of the aircraft. Then it moved to [the position] ‘1-hour' of the aircraft at bow 330°, having been observed until it disappeared from the side of the aircraft. The aircraft was Confins-Goiânia bow". The reporting witness noted in the report that he "never saw anything like it". Complementary data from COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "I request a recording reservation in the period of 23:28/23:50Z [for] purposes of hearing aircraft reports about UFOs. VRG335 PL/BR FL310 and VSP251 SV / BR FL350 uW10 aircraft Freq. 125.2 MHz. Information received approximately 110NM BRS. VSP 374 CF / GO FL 310 DCT GO / Freq. 124.4 MHz approximately 145 NM GOI ". "[...] Requested contact with CMT VSP 251 and VSP 374 in TF2 348 [for] the purpose of further information and clarification about the fact". Brasilia, 03 OCT 88. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: "[…] the evidence of certain inexplicable phenomena no longer allows us to ignore them." [M.of A., Brasília, March 1989]
description: A military internal communication regarding the UFO subject. [ see observation below, after the text ] Ministry of Aeronautics - General Air Command Brasília, March 15, 1989. From: Commander To: Mr. Commander of the Nucleus of the Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command. Subject: UFO record I - I forward to Your Excellency the Ministerial Notice in which the Most Excellent Minister of Aeronautics attributes to this Command the responsibility for dealing with matters related to UFOs. II - In this sense, I request Your Excellency the pertinent measures for the fulfillment of the referred attribution. Lieutenant Brigadier of Air [...] Commander of COMGAR UFO Record To the Chiefs of Staff of the Air Force, Commander-in-Chief of the Air, Commander-in-Chief of Personnel, Commander-in-Chief of Support, Director-General of the Department of Civil Aviation, Director-General of the Department of Research and Development, Director-General General of the Department of Education and Chief of Staff of the Minister of Aeronautics. The occurrences made public about the appearance of "Unidentified Flying Objects" - UFOs - in Brazilian airspace have, lately, increased in frequency and seem to be backed by witnesses of relative suspicion. The phase of fear of ridicule that, until recently, silenced the most responsible witnesses of the country's technical and scientific elite, gradually gives way to a treatment more responsible for the mysterious problem, since the evidence of certain unexplained phenomena no longer allows to ignore them . It is necessary to recognize that something strange has been worrying the attention of the general public, the authorities and the scientific world, given the frequent incursions of UFOs in the Earth's atmosphere . In spite of the arguments that such phenomena - as they are described - are open to the physical laws and scientific knowledge of the world today, we are under a duty to register them, document and analyze them systematically. For various reasons, the Aeronautics should not be unaware of the problem, although avoiding, explaining them without a scientific basis or exposing themselves to ridicule, unnecessarily. In view of the above, it was recommended, through Note n. C-002 / MIN / ADM, of April 13th, 1978, to the General Staff to organize a "UFO Register", of a confidential nature, in which the phenomena eventually observed in Brazilian airspace were archived, with all the data available, including those obtained by subsequent official investigations. At the same time, an Evaluation Committee should assign the respective degree of reliability to each registry. Observations or separate records that may exist in this General Staff should be submitted to the Evaluation Committee, for competent classification and filing. The search for archived data should allow several "entries", such as: degree of reliability, date, location, and particular aspects of the record. In view of the current competence and capacity of NUCOMDABRA to articulate, systematically and at a national level, with military and civil organizations on aerospace and civil defense issues and activities, I inform Your Excellency that I have decided: I - To transfer the responsibility for dealing with the UFO issue to NUCOMDABRA, in the same manner determined for EMAER, through the Ministerial Note already referenced. II - Determine to EMAER to transfer to NUCOMDABRA the memory of the subject existing in the 4th Subchefia. III - Authorize direct contact with NUCOMDABRA to all Commands and Departments for dealing with the subject matter of this Notice. IV - Authorize NUCOMDABRA direct contact with all related entities, national and international, military and civil, when necessary. V - Recommend total exemption or pre-conceived personal opinions, as well as confidentiality. Brasilia-DF, February 28, 1989. OBS. : J.M.Lima - Minister of Aeronautics, quoting the former minister J.C.A.Macedo who wrote it on April 13, 1978 [see ARX.0.0. 220] Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). description: Salvador, [Bairro de Itapoan], State of Bahia. Date: March 13, 1989. Time: 11:50 pm. Duration: more than one hour. name: A fast yellow UFO was spotted by a pilot and 11 people during a flight near Aracati-CE [1989]
description: SEPT 15th, 1989 . Time: 20:25. Duration: 17 minutes. A TAM pilot and 11 other people observed an unidentified flying object, in the form of a yellow light that increased and decreased in size. According to the reporting pilot, "at 20 NM [nautical miles] from the aircraft", the UFO had an "estimated size of 40cm" as if it were a "large wall clock". The UFO was traveling at a "very high speed; unable to estimate; evolving vertically following the aircraft" from FL 080 [8,000 feet] in the South position. Still according to the pilot's report, the unknown object was positioned "from 1-hour to 4-hour "in relation to your aircraft. Supplementary notes in the report made by COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "Beginning of observation, around 23: 25Z, approximately RDL 330 ° / 15NM ARX [Aeroporto de Aracati-CE]; ending, around 23:42, RDL 260 / 20NM "ARX". The pilot is also a parachutist and estimated a rate of descent of the object around 20 times more than the fall of a "PQD" in free fall. The observation section was more or less from the Irino position to Uberaba." The pilot also said that this is the "fourth time in two years" that he observes UFOs. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: Letter addressed to the M.A., about the occurrence of UFOs in Curitiba [1990]
description: "Letter addressed to the Minister of Aeronautics, about the occurrence of unidentified flying objects in the region of Curitiba on October 5, 1990" To the Ministry of Aeronautics Social Communication Center A / C: Mr. Minister Esplanada dos Ministérios Block: M-7th Floor ZIP code 70045 BRASILIA - Distrito Federal Mr. Minister, I would like to provide a public service to this establishment, and this service is as follows: On 10/05/90, at approximately 19:45, I observed a phenomenon in the sky that was the following: There were five spheres in the shape of a light; these spheres moved in the following way as shown in the drawing I made. This central luminous sphere did not move; those that moved were the four spheres around, these spheres, all of them, emitted a light, it was not a very strong light; it gave the impression that this light was a little dull as if it were covered with a fine mist. These luminous spheres moved in the following way: they circulated in different positions and disappeared in this central; this fact I was able to observe for approximately forty-five minutes. I don't know if it is allowed to comment on this to third parties, but I would like to know what those moving lights were; I have heard many people say that they have seen flying saucers but what people observe is a little different. These lights always moved up to a certain angle; they were nothing more than that, always making a wheel shape . If possible, Mr. Minister, if ethics allow, I would like to know what this object should be; the reason for my interest is that I really like aviation and everything about it. I once received a magazine called Aerovisão n. 179 and I really liked it; I would like to know if this magazine has a subscription for us to do; if you would like to make one. In advance, Mr. Minister, thank you very much for your attention. I subscribe: On October 5th, at approximately 7:45 pm, four lights were observed in the sky, moved in a circle and then joined together disappearing. These lights remained for about 15 minutes or more. I don't know if it was an unidentified radar or flying object, these lights were not very bright; as for the position, they were in the North position; because from my house I stand with my back to where the sun sets. I tried to communicate with these lights, making signs, but they did not respond; these objects. I had never seen anything so interesting in the sky; I was not afraid to try communication, because these lights did not respond. It is not the light that illuminates Bacacheri Airport [Curitiba-PR] , as this light is positioned in a circular line and is just a ray of light. These that I noticed were four circular lights that moved from outside to inside. "/ RMC BR_DFANBSB_ARX_0_0_0297_d0001de0001 Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. name: Correspondence on the possible occurrence of a UFO in Mogi das Cruzes-SP [1991]
description: MARCH 18th, 1991. "Correspondence on the possible occurrence of an unidentified flying object on February 4, 1982, in Mogi das Cruzes, state of São Paulo." Dear Mr . Brigadier [...] [...] On 2/2/82, more precisely at 8:05 pm, I was in a local neighborhood, where I lived, observing the weather conditions when I noticed a strange violet light flying at 10° above the horizon in the East-West direction. At first I thought it was an airplane, yet I kept watching it. Suddenly this light u-turned and started to come towards me (South-North). It was a 90° curve "made in a fraction of a second. As it approached, some colored lights started to light up, apparently, at the bottom. After crossing the whole neighborhood, the object stopped above the railway nearby; after about 30 seconds, it followed its initial East-West course, again in violet color and always at medium speed. Certainly the Armed Forces and the Brazilian Government itself would compare to some known object, but some points cannot be ignored: its movements prevent it from being a satellite because, as we know, their trajectory is straight. The same movements prevent it from being a balloon because it was visibly controlled. The curve and the strange stop that were made do not allow it to be an airplane. It is also not a heliopter because the object passed over my house and no sound was heard. Or we were invaded by another nation, which would be ridiculous to think about it, it's time to publicly admit the existence of these controversial Flying Saucers. This was not the only one sighted in my city. In 1982 alone, two other similar cases occurred, not mentioning the events before and after this year; including photos. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: Several UFOs near Brasília-DF detected by radar [1991]
description: APRIL 18th, 1991 . Time: 05:50. Duration: 25 minutes. A miltary in service at the COPM1 [Military Operations Center] of CINDACTA [Integrated Center for Air Defense and Air Traffic Control] reported the detection of several unidentified flying objects that interfered with the route of a passenger plane. According to the information from the reporting witness, the UFO was "visualized in 2 displacements on the APP-BR TA 10M radar, starting from NE (RD 050) + 45NM towards BR until 5NM and afterwards, moving away to the South until it disappeared". " The position of the unknown objects was "AZ 050 / 40NM BR up to 50NM", at a speed "estimated at .9 Mach". According to the witness, "5 radar contacts at a time" appeared, making a "2309 course up to 5NM from Brasilia, stopped and after another shift to the South" Complementary data from COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "Arriving at COPM1 at 08: 45Z, I was asked to appear at APP-BR. Upon arriving, 1S [...] informed me that I had already observed a radar contact 3 times primary that appeared at 45NM on radial 050, approached up to 5NM from Brasilia, stopped for a few snapshots and resumed its displacement with bow 1809 until it disappeared. I observed the fact, confirming it twice. I estimated the speed at .9 Mach (35 seconds for 5W) In the second observation the contact came at 8 am (+ 8NM) of the VRG 291, coming from SBTE, going down, crossing FL 160. 0 VRG 291 was instructed to keep the SSR in STBY and turn right, having bypassed by the radar contact at + 10NM. Coincidentally, when it was overtaken by the unknown radar contact, the VRG 291 complained that the transmission of the APP BR (119.2) was accompanied by loud noise, by comparison, the unknown contact and the B737 contact of the VRG 291 had the same brightness. " "There was video recording of LP-23 do Gama, but the contacts corresponding to the contact position of the TA-10 appeared only in the form of plots, not becoming chains". name: In Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro, seven people observed two round multicolor UFOs over the sea [1991]
description: MAY 19th, 1991 . Time: 8:30 pm. Duration: 110 minutes. From the roof of a building in the region of Ipanema, city of Rio de Janeiro-RJ, seven people observed for almost two hours two unidentified flying objects next to each other over the high seas, "right in front of Posto 9 - Ipanema". According to the witnesses, the UFOs were "two luminous balls of green, red and yellow color" that did not move, performing "only rotation movements". The objects were positioned "relatively lower than the stars" and were moving away "progressively during the period observed towards the high seas directly ahead, decreasing in size due to the increasing distance". The sighting was carried out with the naked eye and with binoculars, under good visibility conditions with "the stars clearly visible". Complementary data from COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "Two aircraft were flying close to the objects, in an attitude of approaching them. One aircraft passed over, and the other underneath. This, when (in the eyes of the observer) approached the objects, it would have caused them to deviate upwards. That aircraft proceeded normally. Surely, it was neither stars nor aircraft (UFOs). At 22:17, one could still observe the fact, but more distant and weaker (smaller). The new information should be passed on to COPM1. " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. Código de Referência BR DFANBSB ARX.0.0.316. “Questionário sobre ocorrência de objeto voador não identificado no bairro de Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro-RJ ”. Brasília, DF. 1952 a 2015. name: A large UFO followed a military aircraft near Maricá-RJ [1991]
description: JUNE, 26th 1991 . Time: 13:53. Duration: 10 minutes. Four military men of the Brazilian Air Force, when flying over the region of Maricá, in the State of Rio de Janeiro, observed an unidentified flying object with the shape of a "very large, pointed star, 8 to 10 times brighter than the VARIG [an airliner]". Also according to the reporting witness, the UFO emitted intense white lights, but after the Campos [RJ] region until it reached the Vitória [ES] region it turned red. The UFO moved at the same speed as the military aircraft, about 3NM [nautical miles] away, at an altitude of 1,000 meters above the aircraft, and always in the same "11 o'clock" position in relation to the right wing (Northwest) "of the military aircraft". Also according to the report, the UFO "when its color changed, the intensity of its brightness decreased". The sighting was done in good visibility conditions, with "clear sky above and a very clear moon" and "it was photographed by CTA TEN [...] with objective lens". These photo files have not been shared with this file case. Complementary data from COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "There was also observation by VARIG 320 in FL 310 [31.000ft] UA 314 (P-95) in contact with ACC-BRASILIA at 127.3 VARIG 124.2 Constant lights - only monochromatic light." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)’. Código de Referência BR DFANBSB ARX.0.0.319. “Questionário sobre ocorrência de objeto voador não identificado na região de Maricá, Estado do Rio de Janeiro ”. Brasília, DF. 1952 a 2015. name: A woman reported a large multicolor UFO in Araçatuba-SP [1991]
description: JULY 7th, 1991 . Time: 9:30 pm. Duration: 30 minutes. The witness was unable to estimate the altitude of the UFO but said it was close. The sighting was photographed, but the photos were not shared with this file. The unknown object was observed with the naked eye and in good visibility conditions. Complementary data from COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "At the request of SGT [...], the observer will send photos to CINDACTA I. name: In Paracatu-MG, nine people sighted a star-like UFO 3 times faster than a jet [1992]
description: JAN 10th, 1992 . Time: 9:15 pm. Duration: 1 minute. Nine people spotted an unidentified flying object zigzagging in Paracatu, State of Minas Gerais. The witness described the UFO as a star-shaped object, white in color and "very fast, more than three times faster than a jet". According to the reporting witness, the object went from the Southeast to the Northwest, "on the Rio de Janeiro-Brasilia route, in the usual route of the jets", at the same altitude. The reporter said that a neighbor of his "observed the object and noticed excessive speed in it and called him". The UFO phenomenon was observed when the weather conditions were: "partly cloudy, but [it was] possible to observe the stars and other aircraft". The sighting was carried out with the naked eye. Complementary data from COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "The object has a white light that pointed up and down, and also to the sides. Its trajectory was in a zigzag (SE/NW). The observer is used to seeing aircrafts flying over the city, ensuring that the object was not an aircraft, or a shooting star ". Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: Letter from a civilian to the Commander of CINDACTA II in Curitiba about UFOs [1993]
description: MARCH 15th, 1993. "Letter from a civilian to the Commander of CINDACTA II in Curitiba, State of Paraná. Subject: Unidentified flying objects. Curitiba, April 9, 1993. To Cindacta II, Av. Mayor Erasto Gaertner, 1000 Curitiba PR Dear Mrs.: On [ erased ] at [ erased ] (dawn of [ erased ]), with a variation of no more than 00:05 more or less, I was in the north of [ erased ], in the region of Rio Macuco (Fazenda Macuco), with approximate coordinates of 50 18 30 W and 11 15 00 S, with four more comrades, when, from west to east, a luminous point passed, comparable to the largest visible "stars". Maybe bigger. Appearing at a much lower altitude than any artificial satellite or artifact resulting from the space race and in orbit. It moved very fast. After 30 seconds, two aircrafts the size of a passenger/cargo Boeing passed, side by side, both in the same direction, north south, with no more than a few kilometers apart. Maybe 2 or 3, if that. Exactly over our heads, they cross the trajectory of the "previous object". We could see the aircraft with surprising clarity, as they were fully illuminated, that is, with all the lights on, with the one on the right, immediately afterwards, turning off the lights, and returning to normal lighting. It was still very dark on the ground and the moon was almost in waning quarter (03/15/93). Then we lost sight of them because we were in a clearing inside the forest. The Fact itself may not be of greater significance, after a more consistent analysis, but, thinking it may be of some use, I leave this testimony. Best regards, O.E.K. Curitiba-PR " Cf. name: A pilot reports 3 UFO sightings during flights between Brasília-DF and Curitiba-PR [1993]
description: JUNE 24th, 1993. A commercial pilot on the aircraft prefix PT LSF reported three sightings, on three different days, from UFO during three flights from Brasília-DF to Curitiba-PR. According to the pilot, the UFO varied in colors red, green, white and blue. Such lights and its high speed were the only characteristics that the pilot was able to describe from the unidentified flying object. In the first sighting, the UFO remained above the aircraft of the reporting pilot, in the Northwest/West position, on the horizon, then below and then disappearing. Duration: 30 minutes. People on board: 4. Visibility conditions: top FL 370 [37,000 feet]. In the second sighting, according to the pilot, the same thing happened. Duration: 30 minutes. People on board: 2. Visibility conditions: clear sky. In the third sighting, the UFO positioned itself to the Northeast then to the North and Northeast again. Duration: the entire flight on the Brasília/Curitiba route. People on board: 2. Visibility conditions: clear sky. Regarding the UFO's speed, the object followed the displacement of the Pilot's plane = 320 kt [576 km / h]. According to the complementary data of the report made by the pilot for COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "Bright lights. The beginning of the observation [...] after takeoff from SBBR [Brasília Airport] and when passing at Abm AN. First observation : 70 NM Sul SBGO [Airport of Goiás], ACC-BS [Air Traffic Controllers of Brasília Area Control Center] reported having RADAR detection speed 130 kt [240 km / h] to supersonic; Second observation : the same position as the first; went to W and disappeared; Third observation : right after SBBR takeoff. Followed the entire displacement of the aircraft on the SBBR / SBCT Route. Position 02 hours to 12 hours (lowered FL from aircraft 350). Close to Curitiba, it headed towards Ponta Grossa, Campo Largo and disappeared. * Pilot called from Sis CT (to Afonso Pena [Curitiba Airport])." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). description: SEPT 16th, 1993 . Time 20:44. Duration: 3 minutes. name: 4 reports, 53 people and multiple sightings around Brasília-DF [1994]
description: Between 18:00 and 21:42 on February 2nd, 1994, 53 people from 4 different locations in the Distrito Federal region observed an unidentified flying object moving very slowly, and sometimes remaining stationary.
