name: A high speed UFO made a 360° turn and disappeared [2008]
description: DEC 18th, 2008 . TIME: 9:00 pm. Duration: 30 seconds. A flight attendant, off duty, spotted a rond unidentified flying object with intense white color [among other undefined colors] from its residence in the city of Florianópolis, State of Santa Catarina. The UFO was flying at an altitude just below 30,000ft. According to the witness, the unknown object was traveling at a high speed towards the direction of the observer, when it took a 360° degree turn and suddenly disappeared. name: An airline pilot sees a triangular UFO 20 meters above his aircraft near Curitiba [2009]
description: APRIL 18, 2009. Time: 1:45 pm. Duration: 10 seconds. During a flight from the city of Curitiba, Paraná, to São Paulo, SP, a TAM pilot saw an unidentified flying object in the shape of a metallic triangle, about three meters wide and only 20 meters above of his aircraft. According to the witness, the UFO "flew with stability, defined bow" making "not so fast crossing". He also stated that the object was flying in the same trajectory as the pilot's flight, with a slightly lower speed than his plane's, but both at an altitude of 37,000ft. Finally, the report by COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] reports that "the pilot informed that the sighted object resembles an aerophotometry model." The weather and visibility condition were described as being very good. Below is a reproduction of the drawing made in the report with the shape of the UFO seen and reported by the witness. Cf. name: 2 star-like UFOs caused power failure near a lagoon in Nísia Floresta [2009]
description: JULY 19th, 2009 . Time: 18h50. Duration: 90 minutes. In Lagoa de Carcará, City of Nísia Floresta, State of Rio Grande do Norte, a witness observed for 90 minutes two unidentified flying objects with blue and red color, and star-like appearance. The two objects were sighted East of Lagoa do Carcará and heading South. The UFOs moved at variable speeds in a zigzag motion and at high altitude. A power failure was reported by the witness as a parallel phenomenon caused by the UFOs during the sighting. The additional observations in the COMDABRA's report [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] further state that UFOs "were far apart, [and they] could be mistaken for stars". Cf. name: A UFO at supersonic speed detected by 2 aircraft radars near Anapolis Air Base [2010]
description: JULY 12th, 2010 . Time: 16h15pm. Duration: 15 seconds. The pilot of an F5M fighter jet reported the detection of an unidentified flying object through the radar of his aircraft in the vicinity of the Anápolis Air Base, State of Goiás. According to the pilot, the UFO was heading North at an altitude of 38.000ft, and moving at a supersonic speed of 1.6 Ma [Mach] in front of the F5M at a distance of 20 NM [nautical miles]. Also according to the report by COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "The F5M pilot reported that he obtained radar contact with the UFO that was approximately on the FL380 in a 180° presentation (face to face). The F5M pilot interpreted that it was the Mirage alert from the Anápolis Air Base, however, after realizing the distance from the base, he disregarded it and the contact had already been lost. He informed that the number 3 of the Smoke Squadron also had contact on the F5M radar, but it was not possible to make the recording. " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: A zigzagging ufo observed by flight controllers and airport personell [2010]
description: JULY 16th, 2010 . Time: 9:20 pm. Duration: 20 minutes. A flight controller in service at the Teresina Airport Control Tower, State of Piauí, along with 6 other witnesses, had visual contact with a small round silver and red unidentified flying object, moving fast vertically to reach an altitude of approximately 5,000ft. The UFO moved in a zigzag manner without leaving traces of condensation. Additional information from the COMDABRA's [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] report describes that: "The observer was in SVC [service] at TWR-TE [Air Control Tower] and was alerted by observers in the maneuvering area and started to observe the phenomenon with the help of binoculars, with his service partner as a witness. He contacted the ACC-RE [Recife Approach Control] to ask him about the knowledge of any plots on the radar or plane in the area and after hearing a negative answer the ACC-RE passed the information to COPM while still seeing the object " Cf. name: A spinning, flashing UFO spotted in Alegrete at low speed [2010]
description: SEPT 18th, 2010. Time: 16h36pm. Duration: 02m06s. On an open and cloudless day, a resident of Alegrete, Rio Grande do Sul, spotted an unidentified flying object with a round shape and silver color, flying at low speed. The UFO was about 2km from the witness who described its size as larger than a car. The object flew slowly at an altitude of approximately 3km and moved from Northeast to Southeast. The report states that the UFO witness recorded the sighting on film, but the file was not made available. According to the additional observations in the COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] report: "There was no registration record on the fuselage. description: NOV 13th, 2010 . Time: 05:20 am. Duration: approximately 5 minutes. name: UFO of "variable size" and fast vertical moves spotted by 20 people in Londrina [2011]
description: MAR 16th, 2011. Time: 11:00 am. For 90 minutes, on the Campus of the State University of Londrina, in the State of Paraná, about 20 people spotted a bright white UFO of "variable size", which alternated vertical movements at high speed with stops along its trajectory. According to the witnesses, the visibility conditions were good and the object left no trails, tracks or displacement marks. name: A UFO follows and mirrors a plane's movements 2 days in a row on the same route [2011]
description: JUN 30th, 2011. At 21:45z. For two days in a row, on the same route, a pilot from Total Linhas Aéreas flight TTL 9930 reported sightings of an unidentified flying object in the stretch between Carauari Airport and Porto Urucu District Airport [in Coari], both cities of the state of Amazonas. The pilot reported having identified the UFO two days with the ACAS [Onboard Anticollision System], always on the same route, and always positioning itself about 7 Nautical Miles in front of the pilot's aircraft, following it, and copying the movements made of the pilot's aircraft for about 7 minutes. The report by COMDABRA [ Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] brings the following observations according to the pilot's testemony: "It was reported by the pilot of the TTL 9930, whose route was from SWCA [Carauari Airport] to SBUY [Porto Urucu Airport, in Coari], that when his cruise level stabilized, a plote appeared on his 7-inch anti-collision radar equipment miles in front of his aircraft and accompanied him and that any movement made by his ACFT to unknown ACFT also did the same procedures and shortly after 7 min it disappeared. The pilot also reported that this is not the first time this fact has happened, the fact occurred between 21: 30z DEP time and 21:54 ETA ACFT TTL 9930 registration: PR-TTK The same fact occurred the previous day, 06/29/2011, the target appeared again accusing resolution on the TTL 9930 ACAS equipment in the same route." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)'. Código de Referência BR DFANBSB ARX.0.0.677. description: JULY 16th, 2011 . At 8:15 pm. Three witnesses spotted an unidentified flying object "practically stopped" about 20 nautical miles from the east sector of Londrina Airport. I WAS ABLE TO SEE MANY DETAILS. THE TIB-5641, FROM SBGR [Guarulhos Airport] TO SBLO [Londrina Airport], ALSO SAW THE UFO, AS IT APPROACHED LONDRINA'S AIRSTRIP 31. description: JULY 30th, 2011. At about noon, two witnesses residing in the Cruzeiro Novo neighborhood, in Brasília-DF, observed for sixty minutes two unidentified flying objects hovering over the city at an airplane's cruising altitude. According to the report, the two bright white UFOs were smaller and longer than an average plane and were heading slowly towards the Lago Sul direction. One of the witnesses informed COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command], "that they saw two bright spots in the distance around noon. The elongated dots were moving in a random fashion and disappearing a few times." Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). name: A bright UFO over Boa Viagem beach in Recife-PE [2011]
description: OCTOBER 8th, 2011. From the balcony of his residence, in the Boa Viagem neighborhood, city of Recife, State of Pernambuco, an aircraft pilot spotted an unidentified flying object with intense light, moving above the Boa Viagem beach, from 5:25pm to 5:30pm, and performing an unusual maneuver. The witness promptly reported the sighting to the ACC-Recife [Recife-PE Area Control Center] which registered it. According to the document filled by COMDABRA’s representative [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command], the witness: "REPORTED THAT HE SAW A STRONG LIGHT IN A PARALLEL ROUTE TO THE BOA VIAGEM BEACH IN THE NORTH DIRECTION, APPARENTLY AS FAST AS A COMMON AIRCRAFT. HOWEVER, AFTER APPROACHING AVENIDA BOA VIAGEM, 4520 (NEXT TO THE CASTLE) TURNED RIGHT AT A HIGH SPEED AND MAINTAINED ITS INTENSE LIGHT UNTIL IT SINKED IN THE HORIZON. " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: A UFO over Palmas-TO forced a pilot to make an evasive maneuver [2012]
description: FEB 10th, 2012. At 2:50 pm, during a flight from Belém, in the State of Pará, to Brasília, DF, a pilot of a TAM Airliner reported to the Amazon Area Control Center (ACC-AZ) the detection of an unidentified flying object by the TCAS (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) of his aircraft, what forced him to make a preventive detour for safety reasons. The TAM aircraft was flying over Palmas, in the State of Tocantins when the TCAS warned. The report by COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] states that: "The pilot of flight TAM3715 from Belém to Brasília, level 310, reported having seen an unknown traffic at 20nm, one hour position, by the aircraft's TCAS equipment. It was necessary an evasive maneuver to the left. Upon informing the ACC-AZ of the occurrence, it was verified by the operator, that there was a multiplicity of targets on the radar console screen. " Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)'. Código de Referência BR DFANBSB ARX.0.0.681. name: 12 UFOs with luminous halos spotted over Alegrete [2012]
description: MAR 3rd, 2012 . In downtown Alegrete, a city in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, on a clear night, a witness observed twelve (12) unidentified flying objects with a round shape and orange color. The UFOs resembled small stars when viewed with the naked eye and were approximately 200m apart from each other. For about two minutes, the witness observed the deslocation of the twelve UFOs to the Northeast direction, at a presumed altitude of 7km. The witness also reported that "there were 12 objects separated into 2 groups. The first with 6 or 7, and the second with the other objects", and also that "the objects resembled small stars with luminous halos, with 2 or 3 of them pulsing quickly and becoming white. " Cf. name: A hypersonic UFO spotted in Curitiba [2013]
description: JAN 29th, 2013 . Under visibility conditions described as "perfect", around 04:30 pm, in the city of Curitiba, Paraná, a witness spotted for 30 seconds an unidentified spherical flying object of yellowish red color. According to the report collected by the representative of COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command], the witness, an electrical industrial engineer, stated that the UFO was large and it was traveling at a "very high speed, above 10,000 km / h" [*above hypersonic speed, 6,150km/h, and thus much higher than the fastest planes ever built], going west/east, in the direction of Quatro Barras, a city in the metropolitan region of Curitiba close to the Iraí Dam. There is no information about the altitude of the observed object or the distance between the observer and the observed UFO. The report in this COMDABRA file also contains information that the witness "already made other observations in the 1970s, in Guaratuba, of an object" moving in a zigzag ", in addition to, in 1980, observing" several small objects , [o] which has also been observed by several people ". name: A round white UFO spotted swinging like a pendulum for 80 min in Guarujá [2014]
description: MAY 4th. 2014. During a clear afternoon, at Praia da Enseada do Guarujá, State of São Paulo, from the window of her apartment at 04h20pm, a witness observed, for an hour and twenty minutes, an unidentified flying object with a round shape and of a strong white color, at an altitude "much lower than [the] altitude of the plane" making her think it was a helicopter. The object was "at the altitude of a helicopter", but the witness ruled out this possibility because the object remained "still" and seemed to "swing like a pendulum". Also in the report collected by the representative of COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] there is information that the witness recorded the sighting in photo and video, however such records were not made available in the file of this report. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)'. Código de Referência BR DFANBSB ARX.0.0.721. name: A pilot and a passenger saw a UFO for 15 minutes near Fortaleza [2014]
description: July 12th, 2014. Halfway between Juazeiro do Norte Airport and Fortaleza Airport, both in the State of Ceará, 2 people, including the pilot of the flight PTWRG aircraft, observed at 8:00 pm, under a clear sky and good visibility, a low-speed movement of a white and red unidentified flying object with a circular shape. The sighting lasted fifteen minutes. The relatively large object, according to witnesses, was approximately 9,000 feet high and about 15 MN [nautical miles] away from the observers' plane. In the report of the same pilot, who also informed having seen this type of light before, there are observations on the report collected by the representative of COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "The PTWRG from SBJU to SBFZ saw a red light below a white that resembled the beacon light of an airplane. He considered that he has little knowledge about UFOs ". Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)'. name: Anti-collision system of a military aircraft detects a UFO and suffers interference in Rondônia [2014]
description: MAR 13th, 2014. At 9:00 am, near Porto Velho, Rondônia, a Brazilian Air Force R-99 aircraft reported the detection of an unidentified flying object at about 10 NM [Nautical Miles] by its ACAS [Onboard Anticollision System]. During the 5 minute duration of object detection, an interference in the ACAS / TCAS equipment was reported. The following are the comments on the report collected by the representative of COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command]: "It was reported by the Guardian 96 tri [crew], a TCAS / ACAS [Onboard Anticollision System] conflict with an unknown object in the vicinity of the SCO Porto Velho specified in item Z, in which identification by COPM-4 was not possible, by the ACC-AZ and crew of the R-99-Guardian 96. It was found that the nearest aircraft was 100NM from the observer, viewed on the rador. The information was obtained through radio and telephone (debriefing) ". Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). name: Three aircrafts report the same UFO between Quixadá-CE and João Pessoa-PB [2014]
description: JAN 24th, 2014. One big white UFO was sighted by three different flying aircrafts in two locations within 50 minutes. FIRST SIGHT: at 09h10am, the aircraft of flight GLO 9109 from Brasília to Fortaleza, at 09h10am, in descent to the airport of Fortaleza, Ceará, reported by its TCAS (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) a fast object, in a zigzag movement, and at a dangerous low altitude of 300 ft, which forced the GLO 9109 pilot to make an evasive maneuver to avoid collision with the UFO. SECOND SIGHT: at 9:15 am, the aircraft on flight ONE 6372 from Guarulhos to Fortaleza, at 9:15 am, descending to Fortaleza, Ceará, also reported the same occurrence on its TCAS and at an altitude of 350 ft. THIRD SIGHT: at 09h53am, the PRXVA flight from Alagoas Aerodrome, at 09h53 am, to João Pessoa Airport, PB, reported a visual contact with the unidentified flying object, in a dangerous proximity of 300ft, and moving up at supersonic speed, according to the pilot’s report who was also forced to perform an evasive maneuver to avoid collision with the white UFO at 10.5000 ft. name: Five oval UFOs sighted over São Paulo-SP for an entire hour [2014]
description: DEC 20th, 2014. For an entire hour, from 11:00 pm to 12:00 am, in the Cambuci neighborhood, city of São Paulo-SP, two people observed five (5) unidentified flying objects with oval shape and in red, white and blue lights that varied in intensity. The objects were the size of an airliner, but faster than this aeroplane, keeping the approximate distance of 1 km between themselves. The witnesses who reported the event to the representative of COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command], stated that the objects sighted were at a distance of approximately 20 km from the point where they were, moving along the same trajectory, and alternating with ascents and descents, in the south/north direction. The witness also reported the use of non-professional binoculars in the observation of unidentified flying objects. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). name: 11 people witnessed a UFO making sudden moves on New Year's Day [2015]
description: JAN 1st, 2015. At 03h04am, in Guaratiba, Rio de Janeiro-RJ, in the vicinity of the Michelin factory, eleven (11) people reported seeing an unidentified flying object with a round shape and white and blue lights. According to the report given by one of the witnesses to the representative of COMDABRA [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command], a student pilot, the object's shape was of "an inaccurate point", moving "faster than an approaching aircraft". The same student pilot described that the object's approximate altitude was 3,000 feet and that it performed sudden movements. The same witness claimed to have observed the object with binoculars, and also to have tried to film the object, but without success. The entire sighting by the 11 witnesses lasted about one minute under good weather conditions. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). name: Two oval shaped metallic UFOs spotted downtown Curitiba by 5 people [2015]
description: JAN 15th, 2015. In Curitiba, Paraná, at 19h51pm a mechanical engineer with knowledge in UFO field research and four more people spotted, with good visibility, two unidentified metallic objects, oval in shape, with about 50 meters of size each, and traveling at about 100km/h. According to witnesses, the objects were at an altitude of approximately 3 km, and, during the 10 minutes of the sighting, they repeatedly moved closer and further away from each other. The UFOs went from the vicinity of the Oscar Niemayer Museum to the city center of Curitiba, in a trajectory reported as from east to west. One of the witnesses recorded the video sighting on his/her cell phone and attached it to the COMDABRA's [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] report, but this video file was not made available in the Declassified Files by the military. name: Aircraft pilot performs evasive maneuvers after detecting UFO just 2,500 feet away [2015]
description: JUNE 17, 2015. At 8h52pm, a pilot with an aircraft 129 km from Recife, capital of Pernambuco, was alerted by the TCAS (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) of his plane that an object was dangerously close to his aircraft moving back and forth. According to the pilot's descriptions, the visibility and flight conditions were "CAVOK" (Ceiling and Visibility Okay). The report wrote by the COMDABRA's representative [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] brings the following observations made by the pilot: "Hotel traffic [a military codename for UFO] viewed only at TCAS 2,500 feet below the observer. He needed to perform evasive maneuver. [He] saw in the TCAS sudden movements going from right to left repeatedly; after having overtaken the Traffic [UFO], he noticed [that] the "UFO" abruptly increased its speed, again overtaking him, and disappeared from the equipment. The contact took place in RDL311 at 70NM from REC [Recife- PE Airport]. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). description: JULY 4th, 2015. name: Three different airliners report the same UFO sighting [2015]
description: JULY, 23rd, 2015. 11:15 am. In a clear sky night over the city of Palmas, capital of the State of Tocantins, a flashing luminous object with no defined shape with colors oscillating between blue and green was spotted by four witnesses from three different airliners. According to them, the object was at an altitude of approximately 34,000 feet, moving in a straight line in the SE / NE direction following air traffic. The sighting lasted about 20 minutes. The official report also included complementary observations made by COMDABRA's representative [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] based on the information provided by the witnesses present on the flights of the airlines involved, and attached to the official report as follows: "AZU ### [flight info omitted] first reported to this Center that it observed traffic at its 3 o'clock position, not informing the distance, it reported a trajectory similar to its and with variation in colors and maneuvers. Then, we were informed by RIO ### [flight info omitted] that it also saw unknown traffic, and that the information passed by AZU ### [flight info omitted] was consistent with what its crew could observe. And the same thing happened to GLO ### [flight info omitted], which also spotted the traffic. AZU ### [flight info omitted] was asked about the weather conditions at the time, [and] it was said that the sky was clear from the position where the traffic was spotted. Finally, AZU ### [flight info omitted], after reporting being followed by more than 100 NM, realized it no longer could observe the traffic to the northeast of the PMS VOR " Cf. name: A long tubular black object seen from a force fighter jet [2015]
description: JULY 29th, 2015 - 14h25. While flying over the southern region of the State of Minas Gerais, about to enter the airspace of the State of São Paulo, a fighter jet pilot from the Brazilian Air Force spotted an unidentified flying object for about a minute. The occurrence was reported to COMDABRA's representative [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command] in the following terms: "the presence of a long tubular black object at approximately 33,000 feet of altitude, positioned to the left and close to the path of our descent (.. .) ". The report also informs that the object left no marks or trails in the sky, and does not inform the presumable distance between the military aircraft and the probable object. Cf. name: A round white flashing UFO moving slowly over Manaus' Air Base [2015]
description: According to a report given to COMDABRA's representative [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command], on August the 17th, 2015 at 11:20pm, three people saw a round flashing white object right above Manaus' Air Base, moving slowly at approximately 700 miles of altitude. The witnesses, as reported, had meteorological and aviation knowledge. It was a clear sky night and they requested a rescue vehicle from the Air Force Base to check the object, but as soon as the vehicle was ready, the light started to turn off slowly. The object made no noise and left no marks or trails in the sky. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)'. name: Two spherical ufos spotted at incredible speed in Ivaiporã. [2015]
description: AUGUST 31st, 2015 - In downtown Ivaiporã, a small city in the state of Paraná, at 7:45pm, a civil servant observed two white and spherical objects deslocating about 10 miles apart from each other, and at an altitude of approximately 15 miles high. The two unidentified flying objects, according to the report given to COMDABRA's representative [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command], were heading North at an approximate speed of 1,000 mph. name: Bright white zigzagging UFO sighted in Manaus - AM [2015]
description: SEPTEMBER 4th, 2015. From 11h25pm to 11h37pm at Ponta Pelada Airport in the city of Manaus, Amazonas, an air traffic controller and two military, one of them a FAB pilot [Brazilian Air Force], saw an unidentified flying object, which looked like a white bright light, zigzagging after being stationary for a while at about 3.000ft, positioned right at the takeoff extension area. According to the sargeant, also an air traffic controller [the one who gave the report to COMDABRA’s representative [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command], “that was not the first time this light was observed”. The witness also reported that the weather conditions were great that particular night, with clear sky. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). name: Three blinking lights in Rio de Janeiro spotted by a pilot after takeoff [2015]
description: OCTOBER 4th, 2015. Five minutes after taking off with a plane from Rio de Janeiro Tom Jobim International Airport, a pilot resident in the city of Jundiaí, São Paulo reported seeing three agglutinated blinking lights. Their colors were red, blue and ambar and they were apparently stationary at an altitude of approximately 23.000 ft. The sight, according to the pilot's report, occurried over Santa Cruz district, in the west zone of Rio de Janeiro city. The pilot also reported to COMDABRA's representative [Brazilian Aerospace Defense Command], his own impressions about the event: "It is strange the fact that they were between two layers, and [the fact that] the three lights were together, what unabled them to be characterized as normal a aircraft. The pilot also suspected they were a drone or some kind of balloon. Cf. ARQUIVO NACIONAL (Brasil). Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional (SIAN). Fundo ‘Objeto Voador Não Identificado (OVNI)'.
